name.en: Euler double rarefaction: positivity at every stage

note.ja: 既存の強い二重希薄波を128/256/512セルで計算し、平均保存型の正値性スケーリングをMUSCL・大域LF流束・SSPRK(3,3)へ接続します。各前進Euler段と各SSP凸結合の密度・圧力・境界保存収支を記録します。
note.en: Evolve the existing strong double rarefaction on 128/256/512 cells, connecting mean-preserving positivity scaling to MUSCL, global LF fluxes and SSPRK(3,3). Log density, pressure and boundary budgets for every FE substep and SSP convex combination.

name.ja: 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証
name.en: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification

note.ja: 同じ非線形2次元Euler渦をN=16/32/64、背景Mach数.1/.01でT=.1まで進め、通常RoeとMiczek型の空間流束前処理を比較します。全12計算で、速度・動圧スケールの圧力誤差、保存収支、音響刻み、実段状態を調べます。
note.en: The same nonlinear 2D Euler vortex is evolved to T=0.1 on N=16/32/64 at background Mach 0.1/0.01, comparing ordinary Roe with Miczek spatial flux preconditioning. Twelve fixed runs retain velocity and dynamically scaled pressure errors, conserved budgets, acoustic steps and actual stage states.

name.ja: Zalesak型2D回転輸送：保存・有界性・形状誤差
name.en: Zalesak-type 2D rotation: conservation, bounds and shape error

note.ja: スロット付き円盤を実際の2次元有限体積法で一回転させ、donor-cellとminmod MUSCLを比較します。3格子と、半セルの中心ずらし・45度の初期向きを含む8計算で、保存・各SSP段の有界性・形状誤差とスロットの埋まりを測ります。
note.en: Rotate a slotted disk through one full turn with an actual 2D finite-volume solver, comparing donor-cell and minmod MUSCL. Eight runs combine three grids with half-cell-center and 45-degree-start probes; measure conservation, bounds at every SSP stage, shape error and slot filling.

name.ja: SRHDの対称二衝撃波衝突
name.en: SRHD symmetric two-shock collision

note.ja: 相対論的な対称衝突を、独立なTaub関係から得る厳密な保存量セル平均と比較し、実際の1D時空間場を保存します。
note.en: Compare a relativistic symmetric collision with independent exact Taub-based conserved cell means; save actual1D x–t fields.

name.ja: SRMHDの有限振幅円偏極Alfvén波
name.en: SRMHD finite-amplitude circularly polarized Alfvén wave

note.ja: 完全な磁気応力と誘導を含むSRMHDで非線形有限振幅波を1周期進め、厳密セル平均、位相、振幅と細分化を検査します。
note.en: Evolve a nonlinear finite-amplitude wave for one period with full SRMHD magnetic stress and induction; check exact cell means,phase,amplitude and refinement.

name.ja: Fisher–KPP：特殊波速の厳密前線
name.en: Fisher–KPP: a special-speed exact front

note.en: Separate profile, phase, grid, time and finite-boundary errors.

name.ja: Keller–Segel：連成流束の製造解
name.en: Keller–Segel: a manufactured coupled-flux solution

note.ja: 滑らかな2D厳密場で、交差流束・段時刻・収支を検証します。
note.en: Use smooth exact2D fields to test cross fluxes, stage timing and mass ledgers.

name.ja: WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較
name.en: WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison

note.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
note.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

name.ja: ロジスティック増殖：解析解と刻み幅の収束
name.en: Logistic growth: analytic solution and time refinement

note.ja: 無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
note.en: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

name.ja: SIR：独立DOP853参照・人口保存・収束
name.en: SIR: independent DOP853 reference, conservation and convergence

note.ja: 閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

name.ja: 反応拡散：空間2次と時間4次を分けて測る
name.en: Reaction-diffusion: separate second-order space and fourth-order time

note.ja: 線形の拡散・反応演算子を、連続と半離散のFourier厳密解を用いて小規模に検証します。
note.en: Validate a small linear diffusion-reaction operator against continuous and semidiscrete Fourier solutions.

name.ja: Turing不安定性：線形成長率と小振幅パターン
name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

note.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
note.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumo：パルス興奮・回復と独立ODE参照
name.en: FitzHugh-Nagumo: pulse excitation, recovery and an independent ODE reference

note.ja: 2変数の膜興奮縮約ODEを電流パルスで励起し、DOP853との全出力時刻の誤差・時間収束・回復を確認します。
note.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

name.ja: 2D C-grid回転浅水波の実時間発展
name.en: Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance

note.ja: 実際の2D staggered場を時間積分し、連続波と離散symbolの参照を分けて比較します。
note.en: Time-advance actual2D staggered fields and distinguish continuous-wave references from semidiscrete symbols.

name.ja: 振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化
name.en: Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum

note.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。
note.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似
name.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA

note.ja: 全4状態と準定常近似を比較し、初期層と積分誤差を分けます。
note.en: Separate the initial layer, integration error and QSSA modeling error in a four-state enzyme mechanism.

name.ja: Lotka–Volterra不変量と正値性
name.en: Lotka–Volterra invariant and positivity

note.ja: 正の軌道を独立な対数座標参照と比較します。
note.en: Compare a positive orbit against an independently integrated log-coordinate reference.

name.ja: SEIR保存則と初期線形化
name.en: SEIR conservation and initial linearization

note.ja: 人口保存と2モードの初期線形化を別々に検査します。
note.en: Check population conservation and the full two-mode initial linearization separately.

name.ja: Hodgkin–Huxley：電位固定・静止平衡・発火
name.en: Hodgkin–Huxley: clamps, rest and firing

note.ja: 固定電位の解析ゲート解と、区分電流下の4状態系を照合します。
note.en: Compare analytic clamp gates and a four-state system with segment-owned current.

name.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称定常釣合いを時間積分
name.en: Time evolution of axisymmetric spherical shallow-water balance

note.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称な無次元定常状態を実際に時間積分し、釣合い残差と格子依存を分ける。
note.en: NondimensionalWilliamson2-type axisymmetricsubproblem. Analyticstaticstatevsactualtimeintegration; not fullglobaldynamicalcore/PVclaim.

name.ja: 古典的RK4：コード・検証
name.en: Classical RK4 — code and checks

note.ja: 手法固有の配布版と関連ソースを案内します。固定入力例は別の項目で区別します。
note.en: Method-specific editions and related sources; fixed-input runs are listed separately.

name.ja: SSPRK(5,4)：コード・検証
name.en: SSPRK(5,4) — code and checks

note.ja: 手法固有の配布版と関連ソースを案内します。固定入力例は別の項目で区別します。
note.en: Method-specific editions and related sources; fixed-input runs are listed separately.

name.ja: Schnakenberg有限振幅過渡：非線形性と独立参照
name.en: Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference

note.ja: t=8までの有限振幅反応拡散を、独立なFourier–Galerkin参照・格子と時間刻み収束・新しい高調波で検証します。
note.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

name.ja: Schnakenberg飽和パターン：近定常性と格子・時間収束
name.en: Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence

note.ja: t=100の1D選択パターンを独立参照で照合。参照の90→100の変化・全PDE残差と、有限刻みprimaryのFD残差を分けて測ります。
note.en: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual.

name.ja: Lorentz分散板へのs/p斜め入射
name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

note.ja: 有限波束の実進行から複素r/t・R/T・直接散逸を求め、複素Fresnel参照と比較します。
note.en: Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references.

name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

note.ja: 80度の中心位相角を持つ有限波束をT=700まで進め、境界誤差を同格子の無PML参照から分離します。
note.en: Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid.

name.ja: 陰的中点則：コード・検証
name.en: Implicit midpoint — code and checks

note.ja: 手法固有の配布版と関連ソースを案内します。固定入力例は別の項目で区別します。
note.en: Method-specific editions and related sources; fixed-input runs are listed separately.

name.ja: 2D誘電体円柱のMie散乱幅
name.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

note.ja: 実際の2D散乱場を進め、閉曲線Poynting流束と独立な円柱級数を比較します。
note.en: Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series.

name.ja: 2ステップleapfrog法：コード・検証
name.en: Two-step leapfrog — code and checks

note.ja: 手法固有の配布版と関連ソースを案内します。固定入力例は別の項目で区別します。
note.en: Method-specific editions and related sources; fixed-input runs are listed separately.

name.ja: 調和振動子：Verletの位相誤差とエネルギー
name.en: Harmonic oscillator: Verlet phase error and energy

note.ja: 既存の単位質量・単位角振動数の調和振動子をvelocity Verletで進める。20時間単位、200/400/800刻みの解析解比較、元のエネルギー偏差、時間反転を出力。
note.en: Advance the existing unit-mass, unit-frequency harmonic oscillator with velocity Verlet. Compare analytic states over 20 time units at 200/400/800 steps, original-energy deviation and reversal.

note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。

name.ja: 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照
name.en: Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references

note.ja: 解析解 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps. The objective has an h-weighted terminal error and specified quadratic penalties. Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
name.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

text.en: Fixed interpolation, spline and Haar controls Small fixed examples separate nodes, representation and rounding; C2 continuity and shape preservation; and boundary extension and shifts. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-approximation-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Runge interpolation: nodes, representation and rounding Interpolate the Runge and absolute-value functions on fixed equispaced and Lobatto-like nodes, and compare with Clenshaw evaluation. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless interval [-1,1], degrees 8, 16 and 32, and 2048 fixed midpoints. Actual binary64 nodes, data and weights define the discrete problem. Editorial clarification A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made. Adopted numerical method Implement the second barycentric formula and a full-coefficient Clenshaw recurrence. Retain the closed weights and finite Chebyshev transform on rounded nodes. p(x)=sumjyj∗prod(k!=j)((x−xk)/(xj−xk)) R(x)=(sumjwj∗yj/(x−xj))/(sumjwj/(x−xj)) C(x)=sum(k=0)nak∗Tk(x);bk=ak+2∗x∗b(k+1)−b(k+2) References and measured quantities Separate the stored-data polynomial P, closed-weight rational expression R, stored-coefficient series C and target f. Check exact rational references at 17 probes, operation-based error bounds, node identities and fixed Runge trends. Verification limits and failures A sampled maximum error is not a proof of a continuous uniform norm. Closed weights and discrete orthogonality on rounded nodes are not treated as exact. No arbitrary-degree or all-point stability guarantee is made. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. text.en: Independent validation of nonlinear reaction–diffusion and pattern formation Follow a 1D periodic Schnakenberg system from finite-amplitude transients to post-growth patterns. Compare with a separate numerical reference and distinguish grid, time-step and reference errors. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-biology-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries 1D periodic x∈[0,2π), a=.1,b=.9,D=(.01,1). Common IC u=1+.08cos(2x)+.01cos(4x), v=.9−.03cos(2x)−.002cos(4x), restricted to a reflection-even, pi-periodic invariant subspace with a fixed origin. Editorial clarification Space refinement uses a separate Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference; time refinement uses an independently integrated Radau solution of the same FD semidiscrete system, not an exact continuous-PDE solution. Splitting error masked spatial error in the first coarse-step pilot. Steps were refined while keeping the acceptance criteria; the original input and failed metrics remain in the release. note.en: Strang-compose exact half-step diffusion of the FD matrix, diagonalized by FFT with symbol −4sin²(πk/N)/dx², and a full implicit-midpoint reaction step solved by local2×2 Newton iterations. note.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
note.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

text.ja: 神経膜と反応SSAの独立検証 Hodgkin–Huxleyの電位固定・静止・発火と、移入–死亡SSAの厳密過渡分布を、小さな固定入力で照合します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-biology-ode-controls-2026-11-25 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Hodgkin–Huxley：電位固定・静止平衡・発火 固定電位の解析ゲート解と、区分電流下の4状態系を照合します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 6.3°C、ms/mV/µA cm⁻²。NEURON8.2.6の解析的な絶対電位規約を固定し、4電位×3刻み、静止20 ms、10–11 msの電流パルスを扱います。 編集上の補足 1細胞膜の教育例です。元論文の電位規約、TABLE/cnexp実装、ケーブル伝播や生体実測の再現とは呼びません。区間内に括れない発火は捏造せず、静止根の一意性・区間Hurwitz安定性は主張しません。 採用した計算法 古典RK4を用い、電流の切り替わりでは全段の片側値を区間に帰属させます。ゲートの可除特異点、Decimal静止根、独立なDP5(4)/Cash–Karp参照を別に照合します。 CmV˙=I−gNam3h(V−ENa)−gKn4(V−EK)−gL(V−EL) z˙=αz(V)(1−z)−βz(V)z 何と比較し、何を測るか 全採用時刻のゲート誤差、電位・ゲート範囲、採用端点の新しい微分を使うHermite発火時刻を保存。元の1e-8ゲート目標も未達を含めて表示します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 1細胞膜の教育例です。元論文の電位規約、TABLE/cnexp実装、ケーブル伝播や生体実測の再現とは呼びません。区間内に括れない発火は捏造せず、静止根の一意性・区間Hurwitz安定性は主張しません。 保存した実測値と判定 text.ja: 生物反応拡散の2次元・境界検証 Fisherの特殊速度前線、2次元Schnakenbergの境界別過渡、外力付きKeller–Segelのセル平均・流束を独立参照と比べます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-biology-space-controls-2026-11-25 text.en: Biological reaction–diffusion: two-dimensional and boundary controls Compare a special-speed Fisher front, boundary-specific two-dimensional Schnakenberg transients and forced Keller–Segel cell averages and fluxes with independent references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-biology-space-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use D=r=1,T=1 and the special speed5/√6. Fix spatial/time series on L12 and constant-endpoint boundary rows at L6/12/24. Editorial clarification The special front is distinct from the minimum linear speed2. This is not a steep-data speed-selection study, long-time propagation result or certified machine-error barrier proof. Adopted numerical method Use centered second-order differences and SSPRK3 with exact Dirichlet values at every stage. Compare time errors to an independent reference for the same95-unknown semidiscreteODE. ut=uxx+u(1−u) u(x,t)=[1+exp⁡((x−5t/6)/6)]−2 References and measured quantities Save exact-profile and quarter-contour errors, same-grid time convergence and full/core boundary errors. Distinguish a real-arithmetic discrete barrier from the observed floating-point margin. Verification limits and failures The special front is distinct from the minimum linear speed2. This is not a steep-data speed-selection study, long-time propagation result or certified machine-error barrier proof. note.ja: 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Fisher–KPP：特殊波速の厳密前線 D=r=1、T=1。Ablowitz–Zeppetella型の特殊波速5/√6、L=12の空間・時間系列、定数端点L=6/12/24の境界比較を固定します。
note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Fisher–KPP: a special-speed exact front Use D=r=1,T=1 and the special speed5/√6. Fix spatial/time series on L12 and constant-endpoint boundary rows at L6/12/24.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード [0,2π]²、T=2、a=0.1,b=0.9,Du=0.01,Dv=1。平衡(1,0.9)のまわりで3初期値と12/24/48セル、一定の非周期境界を使います。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes On[0,2π]² toT2,use a.1,b.9,Du.01,Dv1. Compare three perturbations of(1,.9),12/24/48cell grids and fixed nonperiodic boundary conditions.

name.ja: Keller–Segel走化性
name.en: Keller–Segel chemotaxis

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Keller–Segel：連成流束の製造解 単位正方形、T=0.25。n=1+0.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy、c=1+0.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πyに合う強制項と接線方向の発散ゼロ移流を与えます。
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Keller–Segel: a manufactured coupled-flux solution On the unit square toT.25,manufacture forcing for n=1+.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy,c=1+.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πy with divergence-free tangential advection.

text.ja: Bratuのfold継続とJacobian不要Newton–Krylov 同じ1次元Bratu境界値問題で、foldを越える継続とJacobianを組み立てない反復を独立解析族へ照合します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-bratu-continuation-jfnk-2026-11-24-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest text.en: Bratu fold continuation and Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov The same one-dimensional Bratu problem compares fold continuation and matrix-free iteration against an independently evaluated analytic family. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-bratu-continuation-jfnk-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation Follow the lower and upper branches of the same one-dimensional Bratu boundary-value problem; check tangents, the fold and spatial error against an independent analytic family. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time. Editorial clarification A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim. Adopted numerical method Use a unit tangent in h-sum(du squared)+d-lambda squared, a predictor and a tangent-hyperplane Newton corrector. A separate augmented system locates the fold and a normalized null vector. This case deliberately assembles sparse Jacobians. −u′′=λeu,u(0)=u(1)=0 uθ=2log⁡cosh⁡(θ/2)cosh⁡(θ(x−1/2)),λ(θ)=2θ2/cosh⁡2(θ/2) References and measured quantities The preserved R3 run passed the shared 27 pytest tests and this case’s 67 fixed gates. Discrete residuals, tangent orientation/normalization, fold/null/transversality conditions, an independent Decimal80 family and fixed three-grid errors are checked separately. Verification limits and failures A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products Solve both Bratu branches with three Jv choices without assembling the nonlinear Jacobian; retain forcing, actual residuals and evaluation counts. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9. Editorial clarification An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee. Adopted numerical method Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults. −u′′=λeu,u(0)=u(1)=0 uθ=2log⁡cosh⁡(θ/2)cosh⁡(θ(x−1/2)),λ(θ)=2θ2/cosh⁡2(θ/2) J(u)v=Ahv−λeu⊙v ηk=min⁡{0.5,max⁡{0.001,0.9(∥Fk∥2/∥Fk−1∥2)1.5}} References and measured quantities The preserved R3 run passed the shared27 pytest tests and this case’s129 fixed gates: nonzero analytic Jv qualification, discrete residuals, independent analytic branches, mode agreement, forcing, evaluation ledgers, Krylov storage, Armijo and the constant-eta control. name.ja: Bratu非線形境界値問題
name.en: Bratu nonlinear boundary-value problem

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

name.ja: Bratu非線形境界値問題
name.en: Bratu nonlinear boundary-value problem

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 同じ無次元1次元Dirichlet問題でλ=3、内点63/127、初期値0または4sin(πx)。3Jv×2格子×2枝の12解法と固定η=1e-8の解析Jv対照1本。GMRES restart24/max96、Newton最大24、残差許容1e-9です。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9.

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。

text.ja: 係数ジャンプ・回転異方性のMG／AMG 同じ行列の幾何MG・SA-AMG・直接解と、連続問題の解析解・別離散参照を分けて比較します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-coefficient-diffusion-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG 不連続係数のFV解を独立なP1参照と比較し、線形系の残差・前進誤差と連続問題の誤差を分けます。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 text.en: MG/AMG for coefficient jumps and rotated anisotropy Compare geometric MG,SA-AMG and direct solves of identical matrices, separately from analytic or independently discretized continuum references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-coefficient-diffusion-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG Compare discontinuous-coefficient FV with independent P1 reference fields, separating linear-system residual/forward errors from continuum error. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Unit square, zero Dirichlet, f=1, diagonal quadrants100/others1, N16/32/64; reference P1 meshes128/192. Editorial clarification Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. Adopted numerical method Orthogonal FV with shared harmonic transmissibility. Symmetric Galerkin geometric and coordinate-free SA cycles precondition PCG on identical matrices. −∇⋅(a∇u)=1,a∈{1,100} Tf=∣f∣/(dL/aL+dR/aR) References and measured quantities Nonzero two-material flux patch, residual-aware budget, direct forward/energy errors and independent triangular-P1 grid sensitivity. Verification limits and failures Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. text.ja: ALEピストン・球面輸送・SPH/GSPHの限定検証 所与ALEの有限圧力ピストン、限定球面輸送と軸対称釣合い、実GSPHとSPH対照を固定入力で検証します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. text.en: DAE initialization, conservation and constraint drift Compare consistent initialization, an index-one conservation DAE, and an underlying ODE for an index-three pendulum. Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinguished from newly executed independent ODE references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-dae-controls-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE Separate initialization, backward-Euler error and residuals on a known positive index-one DAE branch. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless positive branch; differential and algebraic row scales are both one, with the maximum norm. Editorial clarification One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Use coupled Newton with an Armijo search in the same scaled norm, retaining rather than repairing a singular initial guess. F1=ydot+y−z+exp(−2t/3),F2=z3−y2 y=exp(−t),z=exp(−2t/3) References and measured quantities Compare independent Decimal manufactured states, three discrete roots and three fixed grids, checking first-order error and the algebraic constraint. Verification limits and failures One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity. Editorial clarification No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

text.ja: Double Mach反射：多格子の軽量検証 既存のDouble Mach反射と同じ初期値・境界を使い、64×16・128×32・256×64の実2D Euler有限体積計算をT=.2まで実行します。別実装の有限格子参照との差、実際の境界流束収支、上部の入射衝撃位置と壁近傍を比較します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-double-mach-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Double Mach反射：多格子の軽量検証 既存のDouble Mach反射と同じ初期値・境界を使い、64×16・128×32・256×64の実2D Euler有限体積計算をT=.2まで実行します。別実装の有限格子参照との差、実際の境界流束収支、上部の入射衝撃位置と壁近傍を比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元[0,4]×[0,1]、γ=1.4、Mach10。衝撃脚x=1/6、角度60度、後方状態(ρ,u,v,p)=(8,8.25√3/2,−4.125,116.5)、前方(1.4,0,0,1)。初期セルは衝撃のセル中心側で分類し、切断セルの厳密平均ではありません。左は後方流入、右はゼロ勾配、底はx<1/6で後方状態・他は滑り壁、上はx<1/6+(1+20t)/√3で後方状態を与えます。 編集上の補足 独立な有限格子の数値参照と比較する軽量例であり、2次元全場の厳密解ではありません。少数格子で測った衝撃位置・保存収支・wall jetの診断と、細い壁面噴流の収束を区別します。前向きステップは今回の実行対象に含めません。 採用した計算法 既存Numartの区分定数HLL流束と非分割x/y発散、Heun/SSPRK(2,2)を独立した小型配布物にし、両段の境界流束・状態確認を追加しました。CFL=.4を各方向の最大音響速度の和に適用し、上辺は各RK段の実時刻で更新します。状態floor、セル修復、隠れた刻み再試行はなく、不正段の生配列と履歴を残して失敗します。 ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T xs(y,t)=16+y+20t3,γ=1.4,Ms=10 Δt=0.4[max⁡(∣u∣+c)/Δx+max⁡(∣v∣+c)/Δy]−1 ∑ij∣Cij∣(Uˉijn+1−Uˉijn)=Δt2(B(Un,tn)+B(U(1),tn+Δt)) 何と比較し、何を測るか 初回事前契約の20単体検査は合格。全3格子の実行前の読み取りレビューで、衝撃探索窓に前線が無い場合を拒否する診断ガードと1検査を追加し、旧契約・ソースを保持して改訂契約を固定しました。その21検査と全3計算・40判定が-W errorで合格しました。参照はRKDGキットで既に独立実行済みの、別実装primitive MUSCL/generalized-minmod text.en: Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification Full 2D Euler finite volumes evolve the existing Double Mach initial/boundary data to T=.2 on64x16,128x32 and256x64 cells. Compare a separately written finite-grid reference, actual boundary-flux budgets, an upper incident-front position and a fixed near-wall region. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-double-mach-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification Full 2D Euler finite volumes evolve the existing Double Mach initial/boundary data to T=.2 on64x16,128x32 and256x64 cells. Compare a separately written finite-grid reference, actual boundary-flux budgets, an upper incident-front position and a fixed near-wall region. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional[0,4]x[0,1], gamma1.4, Mach10. Shock footx=1/6, angle60degrees; postshock(rho,u,v,p)=(8,8.25sqrt(3)/2,-4.125,116.5), upstream(1.4,0,0,1). Initial cells are classified by their centers, not exact cut-cell means. Left postshock inflow, right zero-gradient, bottom postshock forx<1/6 and slip wall otherwise; top postshock forx<1/6+(1+20t)/sqrt(3). Editorial clarification A lightweight comparison with an independent finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact2D full-field solution. Separate measured shock location, conservation budgets and wall-jet diagnostics from convergence of the thin wall jet. Forward-facing step is outside this execution scope. Adopted numerical method The published Numart piecewise-constant HLL flux, unsplit x/y divergence and Heun/SSPRK(2,2) form a small standalone package with both-stage boundary accounting and state checks. CFL.4 uses the sum of directional maximum acoustic rates; the top boundary uses each actual RK stage time. No state floor, repair or hidden retry. Invalid stages retain raw arrays/history and fail. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T xs(y,t)=16+y+20t3,γ=1.4,Ms=10 Δt=0.4[max⁡(∣u∣+c)/Δx+max⁡(∣v∣+c)/Δy]−1 ∑ij∣Cij∣(Uˉijn+1−Uˉijn)=Δt2(B(Un,tn)+B(U(1),tn+Δt)) References and measured quantities The original preregistered20 unit tests passed. Before the full three-grid run, read-only review added an absent-front diagnostic guard and one test; the old contract/source are preserved and a revision contract was frozen. All21 tests, three final-time runs and40 gates passed with-W error. Previously independently executed Ny64/128 primitive MUSCL/generalized-minmod theta1.5/HLL/Heun data from the RKDG kit are reused; no reference PDE was rerun. Density L1 differences from conservatively restricted Ny128 are.08431/.05802/.03503 and pressure differences.09556/.06798/.04156. Reference64/128 increments are.00955/.01250, about.273/.301 of the finest primary differences. Maximum relative four-component boundary-budget residual is about4.60e-13. Verification limits and failures The reference is finite-grid numerical data, not an exact2D solution or an Athena/LAVA execution. The HLL family is shared, but reference spatial operators are separately written and not imported by the primary. The reference increment is an uncertainty diagnostic, not an error bound. Initial projection, sampled moving boundaries, discretization and finite-reference effects all enter the difference; the slope is no rigorous order or full reflection-pattern convergence proof. The upper-front discrepancy stays2cells while its physical width shrinks. Fixed near-wall ROIx in[1,2.75],y<=.25 is not feature tracking. Finest ROI maxu12.644 versus reference16.125 shows the thin wall jet/roll-up is unresolved. Forward step, other wall data, general perturbations, higher order and full-pattern convergence are unverified. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.en: Double Mach reflection — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 公開済みの低解像度HLL像を保持し、別の有限体積コードの保存参照との比較を追加します。参照も有限格子の数値解であり、全場の厳密解や誤差上界ではありません。
note.en: Preserve the previously published coarse HLL view and add comparison with a saved reference from a separate finite-volume implementation. The reference is itself a finite-grid numerical solution, not an exact full-field solution or error bound.

name.ja: Double Mach反射：保存済み独立有限格子数値参照
name.en: Double Mach reflection: saved independent finite-grid numerical reference

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 領域[0,4]×[0,1]の2次元理想気体Euler、γ=1.4、Mach10・角度60度の入射衝撃波、初期の衝撃脚x=1/6、最終時刻T=.2。保存参照は別実装の非分割primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun有限体積法（勾配制限はgeneralized minmodのθ=1.5、MC型であり標準MCのθ=2とは異なる）で、256×64と512×128セルです。主計算とHLLという流束族・Heun時間積分の数式を共有しますが、空間再構成と実装は別です。保存量を保つ制限で比較用セル平均を得ます。不変のRKDG2Dキットで以前に実行したソース・配列・記録を再利用し、今回の参照PDE・Athena・LAVAの新規実行ではありません。参照の格子差も有限分解能の感度指標で、厳密な誤差上界ではありません。厳密2D解でも細いwall jet・渦構造の収束検証でもありません。 入射不連続面の初期化はセル中心での状態判定であり、衝撃面で切られたセルの厳密平均からの初期化ではありません。 以前に独立実行した2格子の有限体積参照を保存量制限で比較します。有限格子数値参照であり、厳密2D解や誤差上界ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow on [0,4] × [0,1], with gamma = 1.4, a Mach-10 incident shock at 60 degrees, initial shock foot x = 1/6 and final time T = 0.2. The saved reference uses a separately written, unsplit primitive MUSCL/HLL/Heun finite-volume code on 256 × 64 and 512 × 128 cells. Its generalized-minmod slope parameter is theta = 1.5 (MC-type, rather than canonical MC with theta = 2). The primary and reference codes share the HLL flux family and Heun time-integration equations, while their spatial reconstruction and implementations are separate. Conservative restriction produces comparison cell means. Previously executed source, data and receipts are reused from the immutable RKDG2D kit; no reference PDE, Athena or LAVA was executed anew for this addition. Reference grid differences indicate finite-resolution sensitivity, not rigorous error bounds. This is not an analytic 2D solution or a convergence test for the thin wall jet and vortex pattern. The incident discontinuity is classified at cell centers, rather than initialized from exact cut-cell averages. Compare against two previously independently executed finite-volume reference grids using conservative restriction. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact2D solution or error bound.

name.ja: Double Mach反射：多格子の軽量検証：参照・検証
name.en: Double Mach reflection: lightweight grid verification — references and checks

note.ja: 初回事前契約の20単体検査は合格。全3格子の実行前の読み取りレビューで、衝撃探索窓に前線が無い場合を拒否する診断ガードと1検査を追加し、旧契約・ソースを保持して改訂契約を固定しました。その21検査と全3計算・40判定が-W errorで合格しました。参照はRKDGキットで既に独立実行済みの、別実装primitive MUSCL/generalized-minmod θ=1.5/HLL/HeunのNy64/128データを再利用し、今回は参照PDEを再実行していません。Ny128保存量を保守的に制限して比較した密度L1は.08431/.05802/.03503、圧力L1は.09556/.06798/.04156。参照64/128増分は.00955/.01250で、最細主計算差の約.273/.301です。4保存量の境界収支の最大相対残差は約4.60e-13でした。
note.en: The original preregistered20 unit tests passed. Before the full three-grid run, read-only review added an absent-front diagnostic guard and one test; the old contract/source are preserved and a revision contract was frozen. All21 tests, three final-time runs and40 gates passed with-W error. Previously independently executed Ny64/128 primitive MUSCL/generalized-minmod theta1.5/HLL/Heun data from the RKDG kit are reused; no reference PDE was rerun. Density L1 differences from conservatively restricted Ny128 are.08431/.05802/.03503 and pressure differences.09556/.06798/.04156. Reference64/128 increments are.00955/.01250, about.273/.301 of the finest primary differences. Maximum relative four-component boundary-budget residual is about4.60e-13.

note.ja: 既存のDouble Mach反射と同じ初期値・境界を使い、64×16・128×32・256×64の実2D Euler有限体積計算をT=.2まで実行します。別実装の有限格子参照との差、実際の境界流束収支、上部の入射衝撃位置と壁近傍を比較します。
note.en: Full 2D Euler finite volumes evolve the existing Double Mach initial/boundary data to T=.2 on64x16,128x32 and256x64 cells. Compare a separately written finite-grid reference, actual boundary-flux budgets, an upper incident-front position and a fixed near-wall region.

text.ja: 剛体球DSMCのMach2平面衝撃波 流入出を持つ1D空間・3D速度の衝撃波で、RH遠方状態と内部の独立な数値参照を区別します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-dsmc-shock-2026-11-24 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 硬球DSMCのMach2平面衝撃波 物理時間の硬球衝突と実際の分子輸送を計算し、独立SPARTAの資格確認済みモーメント場と比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 1次元位置・3次元速度、単原子硬球。Mach2、区間[0,16]、RHの開境界reservoir。192セル、粒子重み1/192、dt=.01、burn20/sample20、12seed。 編集上の補足 有限粒子・有限格子の独立確率参照との限定比較です。線形応答、連続体極限、全DSMC、VHS一般、空間次数を認証しません。RHは遠方状態・流束だけの参照で、内部構造の厳密解ではありません。図は保存した粒子位相空間であり、2D物理流れではありません。 採用した計算法 セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。 2026-11-24版は固定reservoir係数、同一vで既評価の逆CDF残差、keep→left→right順の連結の再利用と、範囲確認した整数sort keyだけの可逆uint8圧縮を行う性能修正版です。元の乱数呼出順・安定sortの同値粒子順位・衝突対・科学設定を保ち、前3点の成分資格163項目に加え、sort keyを含む別348項目でbit/RNG一致を確認しました。いずれも成分検査であり、新mainと全保存科学値の一致はまだ未判定です。 ∂tf+vx∂xf=QHS(f,f),σ=πd2=1/2 Pij=n⟨cicj⟩,qx=n2⟨cx∣c∣2⟩,c=v−u pij=aNWσgijΔt/V,aN={N−1N evenNN odd gij≤2∑i∣vi−vcm∣2 何と比較し、何を測るか 各群20pytestを事前固定。新しい固定計算は15本。境界込みの質量・運動量・エネルギー、局所λ/衝突時間、独立参照への誤差とseed精度、時間block定常性を別に判定します。 群の判定は既存81項目を保持し、新8計算の48項目を追加した129項目です。primary t95はdf11、独立参照4seedはdf3です。 Nov23保存成功と全15計算・129判定の厳密比較を行う新mainは、本契約の時点で未実行です。20pytestと全mainの外部共有上限120秒、全診断・NPZ・CSVを維持します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 有限粒子・有限格子の独立確率参照との限定比較です。線形応答、連続体極限、全DSMC、VHS一般、空間次数を認証しません。RHは遠方状態・流束だけの参照で、内部構造の厳密解ではありません。図は保存した粒子位相空間であり、2D物理流れではありません。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / text.en: Mach2 planar shock with hard-sphere DSMC For a1D-space,3D-velocity open-reservoir shock,distinguish RH far states from independent numerical internal-profile references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-dsmc-shock-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Hard-sphere DSMC Mach2 planar shock Evolve physical-time hard-sphere collisions and molecular streaming; compare actual moments with qualified independent SPARTA fields. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries {"kind":"shock","cells":192,"length":16,"weight":0.005208333333333333,"dt":0.01,"burn_in":20,"sample_time":20,"blocks":5,"bins":64,"sample_every":10,"hist_velocity":[-4,7]} Twelve independent seeds; primary fixed-weight mesh,particle-weight,and half-step companions each retain seed1. Editorial clarification Finite-particle finite-grid independent stochastic reference,empirically qualified; no rigorous continuum bound,linear-response/general-DSMC/VHS or spatial-order claim. RH validates far states/full fluxes,not an exact internal shock profile. Saved phase space is not a2D physical flow. Adopted numerical method Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories. Edition2026-11-24 only reuses immutable reservoir coefficients and an inverse-CDF residual at unchanged v,fuses concatenation in unchanged keep-left-right order,and reversibly narrows range-checked integer sort keys to uint8 before the same stable sort. Original permutation/RNG calls,equal-key particle order,collision pairs and scientific inputs remain unchanged. The first three changes passed163component checks; a separate348check study qualifies the sort-key composition with exact byte/RNG comparisons. Neither is a new main run; full saved-science equality remains pending. ∂tf+vx∂xf=QHS(f,f),σ=πd2=1/2 Pij=n⟨cicj⟩,qx=n2⟨cx∣c∣2⟩,c=v−u pij=aNWσgijΔt/V,aN={N−1N evenNN odd gij≤2∑i∣vi−vcm∣2 References and measured quantities Predeclare20pytest per group and15new fixed primary runs. Separate boundary-inclusive budgets,local lambda/collision-time diagnostics,reference error,whole-seed precision and block stationarity. Reference36runs/87qualifiers already passed; primary results remain pending until the frozen run. Preserve all81old gates and add48new-run gates=129. Primary12seed t95 usesdf11,reference4seed usesdf3; descriptive approximate-normal whole-seed intervals,not unconditional adaptive-study coverage. This new edition main has not run at contract freeze. Retain all20pytest,15runs,129gates and the original shared120s outer deadline,then compare every saved scientific array/history/metric with the immutable successful Nov23baseline. No independent reference is regenerated. text.en: Finite-Knudsen Couette and Fourier flows Compare physical-time hard-sphere collisions,flux-weighted wall reemission and budgets with independent SPARTA references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-dsmc-wall-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Hard-sphere DSMC finite-Kn Couette flow Evolve physical-time hard-sphere collisions and molecular streaming; compare actual moments with qualified independent SPARTA fields. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries {"kind":"wall","cells":16,"length":2,"weight":0.001953125,"dt":0.02,"burn_in":20,"sample_time":40,"blocks":5,"bins":8,"sample_every":10,"hist_velocity":[-6,6],"temperatures":[1,1],"speeds":[-0.5,0.5]} Four independent seeds; primary fixed-weight mesh,particle-weight,and half-step companions each retain seed1. Editorial clarification Finite-particle finite-grid independent stochastic reference,empirically qualified; no rigorous continuum bound,linear-response/general-DSMC/VHS or spatial-order claim. AtKn.5,continuum straight/no-slip profiles are not exact. Saved phase space is not a2D physical flow. Adopted numerical method Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Exact flight-to-wall and flux-conditioned diffuse/reservoir velocities with remaining flight time. ∂tf+vx∂xf=QHS(f,f),σ=πd2=1/2 Pij=n⟨cicj⟩,qx=n2⟨cx∣c∣2⟩,c=v−u pij=aNWσgijΔt/V,aN={N−1N evenNN odd gij≤2∑i∣vi−vcm∣2 References and measured quantities Predeclare18pytest per group and14new fixed primary runs. Separate boundary-inclusive budgets,local lambda/collision-time diagnostics,reference error,whole-seed precision and block stationarity. Reference36runs/87qualifiers already passed; primary results remain pending until the frozen run. Verification limits and failures Finite-particle finite-grid independent stochastic reference,empirically qualified; no rigorous continuum bound,linear-response/general-DSMC/VHS or spatial-order claim. AtKn.5,continuum straight/no-slip profiles are not exact. Saved phase space is not a2D physical flow. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Acceptance uses original fixed-input tolerances and unrounded numbers; only stored results passing every check are presented. 量 / metricMeasured value text.ja: Euler二重膨張波：段階ごとの正値性 強い二重膨張波を1次元MUSCL有限体積法・Lax–Friedrichs流束・SSPRK(3,3)で解きます。平均を保つ正値状態スケーリングを各段に接続し、許容CFL、セル平均と再構成面の密度・圧力、共有境界流束による保存収支を分けて確認します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-euler-positivity-2026-11-23-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Euler二重膨張波：段階ごとの正値性 既存の強い二重希薄波を128/256/512セルで計算し、平均保存型の正値性スケーリングをMUSCL・大域LF流束・SSPRK(3,3)へ接続します。各前進Euler段と各SSP凸結合の密度・圧力・境界保存収支を記録します。 text.en: Euler double rarefaction: positivity at every stage A one-dimensional MUSCL finite-volume Euler double rarefaction combines Lax–Friedrichs fluxes, SSPRK(3,3) and mean-preserving positive-state scaling at each stage. Check the admissible CFL, density/pressure in cell means and face states, and conservation budgets from actual shared boundary fluxes separately. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-euler-positivity-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Euler double rarefaction: positivity at every stage Evolve the existing strong double rarefaction on 128/256/512 cells, connecting mean-preserving positivity scaling to MUSCL, global LF fluxes and SSPRK(3,3). Log density, pressure and boundary budgets for every FE substep and SSP convex combination. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fix gamma1.4, x in [0,1], discontinuity x0=.5, outer primitive states(1,-2,.4)/(1,2,.4) and T=.15. The low-density central state remains strictly positive; this is not a vacuum-generating case. Use fixed global LF splitting speed a4 and dt*a/dx<=.4; assert every actual endpoint satisfies |u|+c<=a and the sufficient dt*a/dx<=1/2 condition. Editorial clarification The same fixed physical input as the existing double rarefaction uses gamma=1.4, left/right (rho,u,p)=(1,-2,.4)/(1,2,.4), [0,1], x0=.5 and t=.15. Its middle state has small positive density/pressure, unlike separate vacuum-generating data. Stage scaling is connected to sufficient CFL and Lax–Friedrichs wave-speed conditions for this scoped example, without certifying existing WENO, DG, MHD or general equations of state. Adopted numerical method Unlimited conservative central linear reconstruction is scaled toward its mean with one common theta per cell until both endpoint densities/pressures are positive. The two endpoint mean remains the original conserved mean. Shared LF FE updates are combined by SSPRK(3,3), reconstructing/limiting before every flux stage. Epsilon1e-13 is a reconstruction target, not an injected density/energy floor. No average repair or hidden time-step retries are used. ∂tU+∂xF(U)=0,U=(ρ,m,E)T,F=(m,m2/ρ+p,(E+p)m/ρ)T,p=(γ−1)(E−m2/(2ρ)) Ui±=Uˉi±δUi,U^i±=Uˉi+θi(Ui±−Uˉi),0≤θi≤1,12(U^i−+U^i+)=Uˉi F^i+1/2=12 ⁣[F(U^i+)+F(U^i+1−)−a(U^i+1−−U^i+)],EΔt(Uˉ)i=Uˉi−ΔtΔx(F^i+1/2−F^i−1/2) U(1)=EΔt(Un),U(2)=34Un+14EΔt(U(1)),Un+1=13Un+23EΔt(U(2)) a≥max⁡i,±(∣u(U^i±)∣+c(U^i±)),aΔtΔx≤12,ρ(U^i±)>0,p(U^i±)>0 References and measured quantities Freeze 27 unit tests and 73 gates over three grids before execution. text.ja: Mach 3前向きステップ：軽量な2次元検証 γ=1.4、Mach 3の一様流を、[0,3]×[0,1]からx≥.6,y<.2の段差を除いた流路でT=4まで計算します。60×20・120×40・240×80の区分定数HLL＋Heunで、段差面を含む実際の境界流束収支・正値性・衝撃波構造を比較します。角でエントロピーやエンタルピーを修正する処理は使いません。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-forward-step-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Mach 3前向きステップ：壁面収支と多格子検証 実際の2次元Euler有限体積計算を60×20・120×40・240×80でT=4まで行い、別実装のMUSCL有限格子参照と比較します。段差の垂直面・上面を含む実際の数値流束から4保存量の収支を評価し、角のエントロピー補正を加えない変種として図とコードを公開します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元[0,3]×[0,1]からx≥.6・y<.2の固体を除き、γ=1.4、初期・左流入(ρ,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1)。音速1なのでMach3です。右はゼロ勾配流出、上下と段差の両面は法線運動量を反転する滑り壁。格子Nyは5の倍数で両壁を厳密に整列し、固体記憶領域は流体ノルム・積分から除外します。Woodward–Colella型の角エントロピー・エンタルピー再設定は行いません。 編集上の補足 有限個の格子と固定入力による軽量検証です。Woodward–Colella型の段差角エントロピー・エンタルピー修正は行わず、角からの数値的なエントロピー層が下流の反射衝撃波・Mach stemに影響し得る設定です。元論文の角補正付きPPM像との一致や、微細なすべり線・渦までの収束を保証しません。 採用した計算法 既存Numartの区分定数HLL・非分割x/y発散・Heun/SSPRK(2,2)を小型配布物にし、6種類の境界ごとに両RK段で実際に使う流束を同じ重みで積算します。CFL=.4、各格子の上限20000刻み。全予測・更新段の正の密度と圧力を確認し、状態floor・修復・隠れた再試行はしません。不正段は生配列と完了履歴を保持して失敗します。 入力・受入基準・24単体検査・数値ソースを主計算の初回検査・PDE実行前に固定しました。解析的なMach3垂直衝撃波のRankine–Hugoniot関係、一様な平行流路、壁の質量・エネルギー流束ゼロ、段差の圧力力の向き、実際の4成分収支、不正段の保持を検査します。別実装のC++17 MUSCL/generalized-minmod θ1.5/HLL/HeunによるNy80/160の参照を新規に実行し、保存量を保守的に制限して密度・圧力の全流体領域L1を比較します。参照の再計算は通常の公開ZIP追試には含めず、保存データ・ソース・契約・実行記録を同梱します。 最初の参照Ny160は事前固定の120秒上限で停止した記録を保持し、診断文字列の不要なメモリ割当てだけを除く参照改訂を、主計算の初回実行前に再固定しました。入力・演算・CFL・判定値は変更していません。 24検査と全3計算・45判定が-W errorで合格。主計算の密度L1は.14754/.12878/.10265、圧力L1は.19373/.16015/.12242、密度の最後の2格子の傾きは.327。参照80/160増分は.02636/.03063で、最細主計算差の約.257/.250。全4成分の境界収支の最大相対残差は2.99e-13、全壁の積分質量・エネルギー流束は0でした。主計算3格子は元のMacで約46秒、性能改訂後の参照80/160は約8/65秒です。 確認の限界と失敗条件 参照は別実装ですがHLL流束族とHeunを共有し、外部AMROC・LAVA・RKDGを実行した意味ではありません。有限格子の数値参照であり、厳密2D解や誤差上界ではありません。角の特別処理を加えない入力では数値的なエントロピー層が下流へ運ばれうるため、補正付き原著PPMの細部一致を主張しません。全流体領域の差とL∞、固定した角近傍の密度・圧力・エントロピー診断を隠さず残します。傾きは純粋な空間次数の証明ではなく、薄いすべり線・巻き上がり・一般形状や高次精度の収束は未検証です。 正規化した密度の最大差は.592/.670/.665で減少せず、角近傍のlog(p/ρ^γ)の最小値も−.0784/−.1224/−.3510と大きく変わります。これは任意の定数を含む絶対量で、負になるほど誤差が大きいという指標ではありませんが、角の極値や点ごとのパターンが安定・収束したとは主張できません。 保存した実測値と判定 text.en: Mach-3 forward-facing step: lightweight 2D verification Evolve uniform Mach-3 flow with gamma=1.4 to T=4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the step x≥.6,y<.2. Piecewise-constant HLL plus Heun on 60×20,120×40 and240×80 grids compares actual boundary-flux budgets including the step faces, admissibility and shock structure. No corner entropy or enthalpy correction is applied. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-forward-step-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Mach3 forward step: wall budgets and grid verification Actual2D Euler finite volumes evolve60x20,120x40 and240x80 meshes toT4, comparing separately implemented MUSCL finite-grid references. Actual numerical wall fluxes, including the vertical and horizontal step faces, close all four conserved budgets. Figures and code explicitly use the variant without corner entropy correction. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional[0,3]x[0,1] minus solidx>=.6,y<.2; gamma1.4, initial/left-inflow(rho,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1), giving sound speed1 and Mach3. Right zero-gradient outflow; top,bottom and both step faces are slip walls by normal-momentum reflection. Ny multiples of5 align both walls exactly; solid storage is excluded from every fluid norm/integral. No Woodward-Colella corner entropy/enthalpy reset. Editorial clarification A lightweight verification on fixed inputs and a small number of grids. No Woodward–Colella corner entropy/enthalpy correction is applied; the numerical entropy layer from the corner can affect downstream reflected shocks and the Mach stem. It does not establish agreement with the original corner-corrected PPM picture or convergence of fine slip lines and vortices. Adopted numerical method Published Numart piecewise-constant HLL, unsplit x/y divergence and Heun/SSPRK(2,2) become a standalone package. Six boundary categories integrate the actual fluxes at both RK stages with identical weights. CFL.4, at most20000steps per grid. Every predictor/update checks positive density and pressure. No state floor, repair or hidden retry; invalid stages retain raw arrays/completed history and fail. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T Ω=([0,3]×[0,1])∖([0.6,3]×[0,0.2]),(ρ,u,v,p)∞=(1.4,3,0,1) ∑C⊂Ω∣C∣(UˉCn+1−UˉCn)=Δt2(B(Un)+B(U(1))),B=−∑∂Ω∣f∣F^n ϵ1(ρ)=∑C⊂Ω∣ρˉC−ρref‾C∣∑C⊂Ω∣ρref‾C∣ References and measured quantities Inputs, acceptance,24 unit checks and numerical source were frozen before the first primary test/PDE execution. Checks cover analytic Mach3 normal-shock Rankine-Hugoniot identities, uniform parallel-channel flow, zero stationary-wall mass/energy flux, step-pressure force orientation, actual four-component budgets and raw failure retention. Newly executed separate C++17 MUSCL/generalized-minmod theta1.5/HLL/Heun references atNy80/160 are conservatively restricted for whole-fluid density/pressure L1 comparison. Ordinary public-ZIP verification reads saved reference data; reference source, contracts and execution records are bundled. The first referenceNy160 exhausted its preregistered120second budget; that actual timeout is preserved. A reference revision removed only unnecessary diagnostic-string allocation and was repinned before first primary execution; physical inputs,arithmetic,CFL and acceptance values did not change. All24 tests, three final-time runs and45 gates passed with-W error. Primary density L1=.14754/.12878/.10265, pressure L1=.19373/.16015/.12242 and last-pair density slope=.327. Reference80/160 increments=.02636/.03063, about.257/.250 of the finest primary differences. Maximum four-component relative boundary-budget residual=2.99e-13; all integrated wall mass/energy fluxes are zero. The three primary grids took about46seconds on the original Mac; revised reference80/160 took about8/65seconds. Verification limits and failures The reference is separately implemented but shares the HLL family and Heun; no external AMROC,LAVA or RKDG engine was executed. Finite-grid numerical data are neither an exact2D solution nor an error bound. Without special corner treatment, a numerical entropy layer may be advected downstream; no agreement with corrected originalPPM fine structures is claimed. Whole-fluid differences,Linf and fixed corner density/pressure/entropy diagnostics are retained. Slopes do not prove pure spatial order; thin slip lines,roll-up,general geometries and high-order convergence remain unverified. Normalized maximum density differences=.592/.670/.665 do not decrease. Corner minima of log(p/rho^gamma)=-.0784/-.1224/-.3510 change substantially. This absolute entropy variable includes an arbitrary additive constant; a more-negative value is not itself an error increase. Neither stable corner extrema nor pointwise pattern convergence is established. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 γ=1.4の2次元Euler流れ。[0,3]×[0,1]のうちx≥.6,y<.2は固体とし、初期・入口の(ρ,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1)、上下と段差は滑り壁、右端はゼロ勾配、T=4です。参照は独立したC++17実装のprimitive MUSCL（一般化minmod θ1.5）/Davis HLL/HeunをCFL=.3、240×80・480×160で新規実行しました。境界に接する法線方向の傾きはゼロにし、再構築の傾き再調整はセル平均を変えません。Python主計算は区分定数HLL/Heunで、流束族・時間積分式は共有しますが実装と空間再構築は別です。角のエントロピー/エンタルピー補正、状態floor、刻み再試行はありません。角の数値エントロピー層が下流へ移流され得る無補正条件であり、補正付き原著PPM像の再現とは区別します。固体を除いた保存量を保守的に制限してから圧力を算出し、参照格子差・保存収支・局所診断を残します。有限格子の数値参照であり、厳密2次元解、誤差上界、細いすべり線や巻き上がりの収束証明ではありません。 新しく独立実行したC++17のMUSCL/HLL/Heun参照を保存量制限で比較します。同じHLL族・Heunと角無補正条件を共有する有限格子数値参照であり、全場の厳密解や誤差上界ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Two-dimensional ideal-gas Euler flow with gamma=1.4 in [0,3]×[0,1] excluding the solid step x>=.6,y<.2. Uniform initial/inflow primitive state (rho,u,v,p)=(1.4,3,0,1), reflecting slip channel/step walls, right zero-gradient outflow and T=4. The reference is a separately written C++17 unsplit finite-volume implementation with primitive MUSCL generalized minmod(theta=1.5), Davis HLL flux and Heun/SSPRK2 at CFL=.3 on 240×80 and480×160 cells. Normal slopes touching walls/exterior boundaries are zero; reconstructed primitive slopes may be rescaled without altering cell means. The primary Python calculation uses piecewise-constant HLL plus Heun; flux family/time equations are shared, while implementation and spatial reconstruction are separate. No Woodward–Colella corner entropy/enthalpy reset, state floors or time-step retries are used. The uncorrected corner can produce an entropy layer that affects the downstream reflected shock/Mach stem. This is a finite-grid numerical reference, not an exact solution, rigorous error bound, replication of corner-corrected original PPM figures, or proof that fine slip lines/vortices are resolved. Conservatively restrict newly independently executed C++17 MUSCL/HLL/Heun reference data. The finite-grid numerical reference shares the HLL family,Heun and the uncorrected corner; it is not an exact full-field solution or error bound.

Conservatively restrict newly independently executed C++17 MUSCL/HLL/Heun reference data. The finite-grid numerical reference shares the HLL family,Heun and the uncorrected corner; it is not an exact full-field solution or error bound.
