text.ja: AMG・行列分解・固有値・求積 小規模な固定入力で、計算法・参照・誤差・収束・失敗条件を確かめます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-foundations-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全4例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元の単位正方形、一定正係数の−Δu=f、全周同次Dirichlet境界、5点差分です。階層構築には座標・格子幅・nを渡さず、係数行列と暗黙の定数近似核だけを使います。入力は実対称正定値を前提とし、任意の不定値行列を扱うソルバーではありません。 採用した計算法 各行の最大非対角係数に対する相対強度からグラフを作り、貪欲な星型集約と余剰節点の隣接集約への付着で暫定補間Tを作ります。P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T、ω=4/(3ρ̄)、ρ̄はD⁻¹Aの絶対行和上界です。粗演算子はPᵀAP。前後2回のJacobi平滑化と最終小行列の直接解を用います。これは採用した小規模SA変種であり、原著の全構築法や収束定理の再現ではありません。 Ac=PTAP,P=(I−ωD−1A)T rk=b−Axk,ηk=∥rk∥2/∥b∥2 何と比較し、何を測るか 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 text.en: AMG, factorizations, eigenvalues and quadrature Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-foundations-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless unit square, constant-positive-coefficient −Δu=f, homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries and five-point differences. Hierarchy setup receives no coordinates, mesh width or n; it uses the coefficient matrix and an implicit constant near-null candidate. A real SPD input is assumed; arbitrary indefinite problems are outside scope. Adopted numerical method A graph based on row-relative off-diagonal strength supplies greedy star aggregates; leftover nodes attach to adjacent aggregates. Smooth tentative T via P=(I−ωD⁻¹A)T with ω=4/(3ρ̄), where ρ̄ bounds the absolute row sums of D⁻¹A. Coarse operators are PᵀAP. V-cycles use two pre/post Jacobi sweeps and a terminal dense direct solve. This is a small adopted SA variant, not every construction or convergence theorem in the original paper. Ac=PTAP,P=(I−ωD−1A)T rk=b−Axk,ηk=∥rk∥2/∥b∥2 References and measured quantities Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence. Verification limits and failures Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless smooth real functions on finite intervals. Fixed Gauss orders 2/4/8/16 and adaptive absolute tolerances 10⁻⁵/10⁻⁷/10⁻⁹ are swept separately. Endpoint singularities, discontinuities and infinite intervals are not covered by these inputs. Adopted numerical method Golub–Welsch obtains nodes from a symmetric Jacobi matrix and weights from twice the squared first eigenvector components. Adaptive Simpson bisects intervals and allocates tolerances using |Sleft+Sright−Swhole|/15 as a local estimate. Evaluation and depth limits report unmet targets explicitly. ∫−11f(x) dx≃∑j=1nwjf(xj) Eest=∣Sleft+Sright−Swhole∣/15 References and measured quantities Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands. Verification limits and failures The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK. note.ja: 独立NumPy/SciPy参照、行列再構成・直交性・特異値・階数・最小二乗残差を確認します。PDEの参照解カードとは別の線形代数検証です。 別版では条件数、右辺摂動、数値階数の閾値を変え、残差と係数の前進誤差を分けます。LAPACKと実際の二進入力から作る高精度参照の役割を区別し、QR／SVD全般や任意の悪条件行列の保証にはしません。
note.en: Check independent NumPy/SciPy references, reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, rank and least-squares residuals. This is linear-algebra validation rather than a PDE reference-solution card. A separate release varies conditioning, right-hand-side perturbations and numerical-rank thresholds while separating residual from coefficient forward error. Distinguish LAPACK from high-precision references built from actual binary input; no general QR/SVD or arbitrary ill-conditioned-matrix guarantee is implied.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束：参照・比較条件
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独立固有値参照と、各Ritz値・固有対の残差、直交性と反復収束を確認します。 別版では固有値間隔・非正規性・Krylov次元を分け、小さな残差と真の固有値誤差を区別します。近接固有値の部分空間比較を、個別ベクトルの精度や他の物理モデルの検証と同一視しません。
note.en: Check independent eigenvalue references together with Ritz/eigenpair residuals, orthogonality and iterative convergence. A separate release separates spectral spacing, nonnormality and Krylov dimension, distinguishing small residuals from true eigenvalue errors. A clustered-subspace comparison does not certify individual vectors or another physical model.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・比較条件
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 多項式モーメントの既知積分値と独立求積参照を使い、厳密性・推定誤差・評価回数制限を確認します。 別版では求積点数・許容誤差と相殺の感度を比較し、真の積分誤差と内部の推定誤差を区別します。狭い山を見逃す対照も診断対象であり、診断の合格は積分推定の成功と同じではありません。
note.en: Use known polynomial integrals and independent quadrature references to check exactness, estimated errors and evaluation budgets. A separate release compares rule order, tolerance and cancellation sensitivity while distinguishing true integration error from the internal estimate. A missed narrow bump is an intended diagnostic; passing that diagnostic does not mean the integral estimate succeeded.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける：参照・検証
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error — references and checks

note.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
note.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

name.ja: Poisson／正弦波の製造解
name.en: Poisson / manufactured sine

note.ja: 製造解 両端はゼロDirichlet条件。目標解から外力を選ぶ製造解であり、任意の外力のPoisson解ではありません。 カードは1次元sin(πx)、こちらは2次元sin(πx)sin(πy)です。次元・右辺・FEMの誤差ノルムは異なります。
note.en: Manufactured solution Zero Dirichlet endpoints. The forcing is chosen from the target solution; this is not an arbitrary-source Poisson solution. The card is 1D sin(πx); this test is 2D sin(πx)sin(πy). Dimension, forcing and FEM error norms differ.

name.ja: 2D Poisson正弦製造解：SEMとP1 FEMの共通参照
name.en: 2D Poisson sine manufactured solution: shared SEM/P1 FEM reference

note.ja: 製造解 全て無次元。−Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy)、領域[0,1]²、境界u=0。係数は一定、SEMは直交するアフィン正方形、FEMは既存の規則的な三角形分割。 全て無次元。−Δu=2π²sin(πx)sin(πy)、領域[0,1]²、境界u=0。係数は一定、SEMは直交するアフィン正方形、FEMは既存の規則的な三角形分割。
note.en: Manufactured solution Dimensionless: -Laplacian u=2pi²sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on[0,1]², u=0 on the boundary. Constant coefficient; affine Cartesian squares for SEM and the existing regular triangle mesh for P1 FEM. Dimensionless: -Laplacian u=2pi²sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on[0,1]², u=0 on the boundary. Constant coefficient; affine Cartesian squares for SEM and the existing regular triangle mesh for P1 FEM.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗：参照・検証
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares — references and checks

note.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
note.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束：参照・検証
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals — references and checks

note.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
note.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ：参照・検証
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets — references and checks

note.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
note.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

name.ja: Householder QRと片側Jacobi SVD：直交性・階数・最小二乗
name.en: Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD: orthogonality, rank and least squares

note.ja: 実の縦長行列に対するHouseholder QRと片側Jacobi SVDを自作し、通常行列・列スケール差10⁶の行列・階数落ち行列を検査します。独立LAPACKの特異値と最小ノルム最小二乗解を照合します。
note.en: Original Householder QR and one-sided Jacobi SVD for real tall matrices are checked on ordinary, 10⁶-column-scaled and rank-deficient inputs, against separate LAPACK singular values and minimum-norm least-squares solutions.

name.ja: QR/SVD：既定特異値・摂動増幅・数値階数
name.en: QR/SVD: prescribed spectra, perturbation gain and numerical rank

note.ja: 二進で厳密に表現できる16×4行列の条件数を1から2³⁶まで変え、再構成誤差と解誤差を分けます。実際のbinary64入力に対し別環境で実行した80/120桁参照とLAPACKを比較します。
note.en: Vary condition number from 1 to 2³⁶ for exactly representable 16×4 dyadic matrices, separating reconstruction from forward solution error. Compare LAPACK and separately executed 80/120-digit references for the actual binary64 inputs.

name.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束
name.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals

note.ja: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。
note.en: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references.

name.ja: Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度
name.en: Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity

note.ja: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。
note.en: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace.

name.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ
name.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets

note.ja: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。
note.en: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK.

name.ja: 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点
name.en: Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots

note.ja: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。
note.en: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK.

name.ja: 行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける
name.en: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error

note.ja: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。
note.en: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution.

title.en: Numerical foundations: conditioning, residuals, convergence and independent references

共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-foundations-conditioning-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全4例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 text.en: Numerical foundations: conditioning, residuals, convergence and independent references Compare AMG, QR/SVD, Krylov eigenvalue methods and quadrature across fixed conditioning families. Separate residuals from forward error and matrix from integral conditioning; check independent references alongside convergence limits and diagnostic blind spots. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-foundations-conditioning-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries A=T⊗I+εI⊗T with n=7/15/31 and ε=1/.1/.01. This is a known-solution algebraic diagnostic; continuum PDE validation remains in the earlier Poisson example. At fixed square n, κ₂ is independent of ε. Editorial clarification This diagnoses algebraic matrix conditioning and iteration error, separately from the earlier Poisson manufactured-solution PDE accuracy. Anisotropy and the 2-norm condition number need not vary together on a fixed grid. Distinguish residual, solution error and an exhausted iteration budget. Adopted numerical method Reuse the earlier MIT-licensed Atlas educational smoothed-aggregation AMG in a separate source release. Matrix-only hierarchy setup uses strength .08, Jacobi smoothing, fixed relative tolerance 10⁻¹⁰ and at most 180 V-cycles. Sine-transform spectral inversion is reference-side only. κ2(A)=cot⁡2 ⁣(π2(n+1)) ∥x−x^∥2∥x∥2≤κ2(A)∥b−Ax^∥2∥b∥2 References and measured quantities Store true residual, forward error, DST agreement, operator complexity and complete histories. Perturb a maximal-eigenmode RHS in the minimal-eigenmode direction and check the predicted relative amplification κ₂ with direct solves. Isotropic runs must converge; the predeclared anisotropy stress policy permits honestly reported budget exhaustion. A one-cycle control detects nonconvergence. Verification limits and failures Only a small constant-coefficient family is checked. Arbitrary coefficient jumps, unstructured grids, indefinite systems, optimal complexity and uniform convergence are outside scope. No claim that anisotropy necessarily increases κ₂ or monotonically worsens convergence. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-geometric-controls-2026-11-24 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全3例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い 単振り子の10固定軌道で、位置拘束、全時刻の接線運動量と内部点の中心化運動量を区別します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 L=m=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。C=(q·q−1)/2、T=100、h=0.04/0.02/0.01。拘束目標1e−13と粗格子の1e−10比較を固定。 編集上の補足 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。 text.en: Geometric integration of constraints, orbits and multiple frequencies Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-geometric-controls-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership Ten fixed pendulum evolutions distinguish position constraints, full-time tangent momentum and interior centered momentum. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion. Editorial clarification Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency. Version date is not an initial publication date. Common-period reduction and direct-library periodicity qualification are separate from the independent angular DOP853 state comparison. Kepler eccentricity and time-step controls Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint. Editorial clarification Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 Jacobi解析族と独立角度ODE2計算を資格確認し、場・拘束の厳密法則・エネルギー仕事収支を比較します。 独立Jacobi解析族と角度系DOP853の資格、74主判定。有限Cの中心化恒等式、2段階FDの縮約写像診断、位置対／全状態の逆積分を分離。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Qualify the Jacobi family against two independent angular ODE runs, then compare states, exact constraint laws and energy/work budgets. A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.

name.ja: 振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化
name.en: Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 半解析解 m=L=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。非整合制御では半径方向速度を明示的に加えます。 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Semi-analytic reference m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity. No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

name.ja: SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い
name.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 半解析解 L=m=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。C=(q·q−1)/2、T=100、h=0.04/0.02/0.01。拘束目標1e−13と粗格子の1e−10比較を固定。 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Semi-analytic reference L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion. Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.

name.ja: 無軟化Kepler二体の時間誤差：参照・比較条件
name.en: Unsoftened Kepler two-body time error — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 位相/時間次数、全同期stepエネルギー、P/L/COM、独立pair力とroot残差。 独立のKepler方程式brentq／二分法解析族、92主判定。全状態誤差とエネルギー・角運動量、8回以上の近日点、有限窓の順序と反転誤差を検査。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Time refinement/phase, synchronized all-step energy,P/L/COM,independent pair force and root residuals. An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects.

name.ja: 無軟化Kepler二体の時間誤差
name.en: Unsoftened Kepler two-body time error

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 解析解 G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4、epsilon0、128/256/512steps、初期COM/P0。 位相/時間次数、全同期stepエネルギー、P/L/COM、独立pair力とroot残差。 1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。 1周期・固定離心率のみ。軟化軌道や長時間安定性はこの参照の範囲外。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Analytic reference G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4,epsilon0,128/256/512steps,initialCOM/P0. One orbit at fixed eccentricity only; softened binaries and long-time behavior are outside this exact reference.

name.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み
name.en: Kepler eccentricity and time-step controls

note.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。 半解析解 a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。
note.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately. Semi-analytic reference a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint. Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.

name.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓
name.en: Coupled frequencies and finite-window resonance

note.ja: 2自由度の実結合系で、12の64刻みprobeと6の精度軌道を使い、真のモード、座標間交換、離散写像と丸めを分けます。
note.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.

name.ja: SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い
name.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

note.ja: 単振り子の10固定軌道で、位置拘束、全時刻の接線運動量と内部点の中心化運動量を区別します。
note.en: Ten fixed pendulum evolutions distinguish position constraints, full-time tangent momentum and interior centered momentum.

name.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み
name.en: Kepler eccentricity and time-step controls

note.ja: e=0.1/0.7の16固定軌道で、保存量と同時刻の位相誤差、実際の近日点時刻と逆積分を比較します。
note.en: Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-globalization-controls-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Line search and trust regions from the same difficult starts Compare Newton, Armijo and dogleg from identical fixed starts, distinguishing roots from stationary nonroots and budget exhaustion. text.ja: 重力軌道：Keplerと軟化有限粒子 厳密なKepler軌道と、同じ軟化核を使う短時間の有限粒子ODE参照を区別します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-gravity-dynamics-2026-11-23 note.ja: 孤立系のPlummer軟化力と、周期・平均密度除去のPoisson式は異なる境界問題です。公開例は静的な力と境界核の検証で、自己重力流体の時間発展ではありません。 G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4、epsilon0、128/256/512steps、初期COM/P0。 a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。
note.en: Isolated Plummer-softened forces and periodic mean-subtracted Poisson are distinct boundary problems. Public examples check static forces and kernels, not coupled self-gravitating flow evolution. G=M=a1,e.4,masses.6/.4,epsilon0,128/256/512steps,initialCOM/P0. a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint.

text.ja: Guderley収束衝撃波：球対称の軽量検証 圧力ゼロの静止上流へ進むGuderley収束衝撃波を、γ=1.4、r∈[0,.75]、t=-1から-.85、128/256/512球殻のHLL＋Heunで計算します。R_s(-1)=.6の相似場から初期化し、原点到達前の衝撃軌道・保存量の球殻平均・保存収支を半解析参照と比較します。図は1D半径結果の2D断面表示です。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-guderley-2026-11-23-r3 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Guderley収束衝撃波：球対称の軽量検証 冷たい静止気体へ内向きに進む球対称Guderley衝撃波を、128/256/512個の球殻でt=−1から−.85まで計算します。HLL流束とHeun法を、相似指数の固有値・半解析場・衝撃位置・保存収支と照合する軽量例です。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 γ=1.4、球対称3次元の半径r∈[0,.75]、衝撃半径Rs(−1)=.6、時間t∈[−1,−.85]を固定します。衝撃前方の内側はρ0=1、u0=p0=0です。外側には初めから衝撃後の相似場があり、領域全体が冷たい一様気体という初期条件ではありません。初期保存量は衝撃位置で積分区間を分けた16点Gauss球殻体積平均とし、32点と照合します。圧力参照はp(保存量平均)で、原始圧力の体積平均とは区別します。 編集上の補足 γ=1.4・冷たい一様な上流を持つ球対称Guderley相似解の収束前分岐です。相似指数の固有値探索・相似ODE積分・衝撃位置で分割した球殻求積を含む半解析参照で、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ExactPackに基づく参照実装と有限体積PDE計算の役割を分け、独立した相似解実装どうしの照合とは扱いません。原点での収束、反射後の衝撃波、一般のEOSは今回の範囲外です。 全体積の密度・圧力L1と、事前固定したr≥.8R_sの活性領域L1は3格子で減少しましたが、衝撃層の密度・圧力L∞やセル幅単位の衝撃位置差は単調減少しません。原点への収束や細部の高次収束は主張しません。冷たい上流を含め最小内部エネルギー密度は今回0で、許容帯内の音速平方根ガードも全3計算で0回でした。 通常の追試は、保存済みの固有値探索・元ExactPackの8点照合で資格確認したλを再利用し、相似ODE・球殻求積・Euler計算を新たに実行します。固有値探索と元ソース点照合の再生成は別の明示コマンドです。旧r2の公開Linux追試は33検査の後に計算グループの120秒上限へ達した記録を残し、物理入力・受入基準を保持して通常追試を軽量化しています。 採用した計算法 面積4πr²と球殻体積4πΔ(r³)/3を用いた第一次数の球対称有限体積法です。共有HLL面流束の発散に、半径方向運動量の圧力幾何項p_iΔA/Vを加え、Heun法・CFL=.4で更新します。中心は面積ゼロの反射条件、外側は各RK段の実時刻に評価した相似場です。全3保存量について実際の境界面流束と幾何ソースを同じHeun重みで積分します。状態floor、圧力修復、時間刻みの隠れた再試行はありません。 ∂tU+1r2∂r(r2F)=(0,2pr,0)T,U=(ρ,ρu,E)T Rs(t)=0.6(−t)α,α=1/λ,λ≃1.3943607844,t<0 dUˉidt=−Ai+1/2F^i+1/2−Ai−1/2F^i−1/2Vi+(0,piΔAiVi,0)T Uˉiref=∫ri−1/2ri+1/2Usim(r,t)r2 dr(ri+1/23−ri−1/23)/3,piref=p(Uˉiref) 何と比較し、何を測るか 33単体検査と3格子55判定を実行前に固定し、警告をエラーにする設定で合格しました。冷たい上流でのゼロ音速HLL分岐、幾何的な静止圧力釣合い、共有流束の収支、実際の2段の境界時刻、不正段の生配列保持を確認します。全体積L1と、あらかじめr≥.8Rsとした衝撃・非零流れ領域のL1を並べ、冷たい内側で誤差を薄めないようにします。密度・圧力の最大差と保存した時系列からの衝撃軌道も残します。半解析参照は固定LANL ExactPackの相似指数固有値ルーチンとODEを使い、反射後分岐を計算しないキャッシュ付きアダプターです。独自に再実装した相似ODEとは表示しません。別に実装したEuler有限体積計算と参照を比較します。 全体積の密度L1は.02345/.01339/.007722、圧力L1は.03277/.01743/.009477でした。r≥.8Rsの密度L1も.02414/.01378/.007948と減少します。最細の衝撃位置は.530273、相似参照は.533989で、差は約2.54セルです。最大の全3成分収支残差は8.85e-16、全段の最小内部エネルギーと音速専用丸めガード回数はともに0でした。参照のEuler差分代入残差は8.24e-9、有限オフセットの移動衝撃ジャンプ残差は4.40e-8。旧版で固有値を新規計算した全3計算は元のMacで約44.6秒でした。 公開r2のLinuxでは33検査は96.34秒で合格しましたが、検査と本計算を合わせた120秒枠の残り23.31秒で本計算が時間切れになりました。この公開追試の失敗記録と旧ソースを保持します。改訂では、既に実際のExactPack射撃法で求め、出典ソース・資格確認とSHAで結んだ固有値を再利用し、通常実行の各プロセスで射撃法を重複計算しません。臨界位相のCdiff残差と相似ODEは新しく評価します。入力・数値判定・Eulerソルバー・実行入口・120秒枠は変えません。 text.en: Guderley converging shock: lightweight spherical-radial verification HLL plus Heun follows a Guderley shock into stationary zero-pressure upstream gas at gamma=1.4, r in [0,0.75], t=-1 to -0.85 on 128/256/512 shells. Initialize the similarity field with Rs(-1)=0.6 and compare the pre-collapse trajectory, conserved shell means and budgets with a semi-analytic reference. The figure is a 2D section display of 1D radial results. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-guderley-2026-11-23-r3 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Guderley converging shock: lightweight spherical-radial verification An inward spherical Guderley shock in cold stationary gas is evolved from t=-1 to -0.85 on 128/256/512 radial shells. HLL fluxes and Heun steps are checked against a similarity eigenvalue/field, shock trajectory and discrete conservation budgets. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fix gamma=1.4, three-dimensional spherical symmetry on r in [0,0.75], Rs(-1)=0.6 and t in [-1,-0.85]. Ahead of the inward shock the inner gas is exactly rho0=1,u0=p0=0. The outer region already contains the shocked similarity field; the entire initial domain is not a uniform cold state. Initial conserved shell means use order16 Gauss integration split at the exact shock, checked against order32. Reference pressure is p(mean conserved state), not mean primitive pressure. Editorial clarification The pre-collapse branch of the spherical Guderley similarity solution at gamma=1.4 with a cold uniform upstream state. Numerical eigenvalue shooting, similarity-ODE integration and shock-split shell quadrature make this a semi-analytic reference, not closed-form exact cell means. Distinguish the ExactPack-based evaluator from the finite-volume PDE calculation; this is not a comparison between independent similarity implementations. Collapse at the origin, the reflected branch and general equations of state are outside this example. Full-volume density/pressure L1 and the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs active-region L1 decrease across the three grids, but shock-layer density/pressure Linf and shock-location error in cell widths do not decrease monotonically. No collapse or high-order shock-detail convergence is claimed. Minimum raw internal-energy density was 0, including the cold upstream, and the sound-speed square-root guard was used zero times in all three runs. Routine replay reuses lambda qualified by the retained eigenvalue shooting and eight original ExactPack probes, while freshly integrating the similarity ODE, shell quadrature and Euler evolution. Recomputing the eigenvalue/original-source probes is a separate explicit command. The r2 public Linux replay passed 33 tests before reaching the unchanged 120-second group limit; its failure record is retained, with physical inputs and acceptance criteria preserved for the lighter routine replay. Shared HLL flux divergence plus the radial-momentum pressure source p_i*delta(A)/V is advanced by Heun at CFL0.4. The center is reflecting with zero face area; the outer similarity state is evaluated at both actual RK times. All three conserved budgets integrate the actual boundary flux and geometric source using the same Heun weights. note.ja: 面積4πr²と球殻体積4πΔ(r³)/3を用いた第一次数の球対称有限体積法です。共有HLL面流束の発散に、半径方向運動量の圧力幾何項p_iΔA/Vを加え、Heun法・CFL=.4で更新します。中心は面積ゼロの反射条件、外側は各RK段の実時刻に評価した相似場です。全3保存量について実際の境界面流束と幾何ソースを同じHeun重みで積分します。状態floor、圧力修復、時間刻みの隠れた再試行はありません。
note.en: First-order spherical finite volumes use face area4pi*r^2 and shell volume4pi*delta(r^3)/3. Shared HLL flux divergence plus the radial-momentum pressure source p_i*delta(A)/V is advanced by Heun at CFL0.4. The center is reflecting with zero face area; the outer similarity state is evaluated at both actual RK times. All three conserved budgets integrate the actual boundary flux and geometric source using the same Heun weights. There are no state floors, pressure repairs or hidden step retries.

note.en: The pre-collapse branch of the spherical Guderley similarity solution at gamma=1.4 with a cold uniform upstream state. note.ja: 33単体検査と3格子55判定を実行前に固定し、警告をエラーにする設定で合格しました。冷たい上流でのゼロ音速HLL分岐、幾何的な静止圧力釣合い、共有流束の収支、実際の2段の境界時刻、不正段の生配列保持を確認します。全体積L1と、あらかじめr≥.8Rsとした衝撃・非零流れ領域のL1を並べ、冷たい内側で誤差を薄めないようにします。密度・圧力の最大差と保存した時系列からの衝撃軌道も残します。半解析参照は固定LANL ExactPackの相似指数固有値ルーチンとODEを使い、反射後分岐を計算しないキャッシュ付きアダプターです。独自に再実装した相似ODEとは表示しません。別に実装したEuler有限体積計算と参照を比較します。 全体積の密度L1は.02345/.01339/.007722、圧力L1は.03277/.01743/.009477でした。r≥.8Rsの密度L1も.02414/.01378/.007948と減少します。最細の衝撃位置は.530273、相似参照は.533989で、差は約2.54セルです。最大の全3成分収支残差は8.85e-16、全段の最小内部エネルギーと音速専用丸めガード回数はともに0でした。参照のEuler差分代入残差は8.24e-9、有限オフセットの移動衝撃ジャンプ残差は4.40e-8。旧版で固有値を新規計算した全3計算は元のMacで約44.6秒でした。 公開r2のLinuxでは33検査は96.34秒で合格しましたが、検査と本計算を合わせた120秒枠の残り23.31秒で本計算が時間切れになりました。この公開追試の失敗記録と旧ソースを保持します。改訂では、既に実際のExactPack射撃法で求め、出典ソース・資格確認とSHAで結んだ固有値を再利用し、通常実行の各プロセスで射撃法を重複計算しません。臨界位相のCdiff残差と相似ODEは新しく評価します。入力・数値判定・Eulerソルバー・実行入口・120秒枠は変えません。 改訂版では33単体検査と全3入力55判定を共通120秒枠で続け、Macで計約.912秒で完了しました。全3格子の初期値・最終値・参照値・保存履歴の配列は公開r2とビット一致し、固有値の再利用で物理結果が変わらないことを別に照合しました。
note.en: The33 unit checks and55 gates over three refinements were fixed before execution and passed with warnings treated as errors. Checks cover the zero-sound-speed cold HLL branch, geometric static-pressure balance, shared-flux budgets, actual two-stage boundary times and raw failed-stage retention. Full-volume L1 is shown alongside the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs shock/nonzero-flow region, so cold inner gas does not hide active errors. Maximum density/pressure differences and the saved shock trajectory remain visible. The semi-analytic reference uses the pinned LANL ExactPack eigenvalue routine and ODE through a cached pre-collapse-only adapter. It is not an independently reimplemented similarity ODE; the separately implemented finite-volume Euler evolution is compared against that reference. Full-volume density L1 is0.02345/0.01339/0.007722 and pressure L1 is0.03277/0.01743/0.009477. Density L1 in the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs region also decreases:0.02414/0.01378/0.007948. The finest measured shock radius is0.530273 against similarity0.533989, about2.54 cells apart. The maximum scaled three-component budget residual is8.85e-16. Minimum internal energy and sound-speed-only roundoff guard evaluations are both0. The smooth-reference Euler finite-difference residual is8.24e-9 and finite-offset moving-jump residual4.40e-8. The older three-run execution with a newly computed similarity eigenvalue took about44.6 seconds on the original Mac. Public r2 passed all33 Linux tests in96.34 seconds, but its fixed-input runner timed out after the remaining23.31 seconds of the combined120-second test-plus-run budget. That failed replay and its sources are retained. The revision reuses the eigenvalue already obtained by actual ExactPack shooting, bound by SHA to its source and qualification, instead of shooting again in both normal processes. The critical-phase Cdiff residual and similarity ODE are freshly evaluated. Inputs, numerical criteria, Euler solver, fixed-input runner and120-second budget are unchanged. In the revision,33 unit tests and all three fixed inputs with55 gates completed sequentially within one120-second budget in about0.912s on the Mac. Initial,final,reference and saved-history arrays for all three grids were bit-identical to published r2, separately checking that reuse of the eigenvalue preserved the physical results.

text.ja: KH・RTの初期成長と独立線形参照 小振幅の非線形2D計算を、別に導出した連続Fourier–Galerkin線形初期値問題と比較します。有限時間の成長、格子・時間・振幅の影響を分けます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-instability-growth-2026-11-23-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 KHの初期成長：滑らかな周期せん断層 実際の非線形2D渦度方程式を解き、独立Fourier–Galerkin線形初期値問題と有限時間の成長・格子誤差を比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 [0,2π]²周期、層厚δ=.25、ν=κ=.005、摂動ε=1e−5。32²/64²/128²格子。基底層は明示した外力で定常維持します。U=tanh(sin y/δ)、T=1。 編集上の補足 text.en: KH/RT initial growth and independent linear references Compare actual small-amplitude nonlinear2D runs with separately derived continuous Fourier–Galerkin linear IVPs. Separate finite-time growth, spatial, temporal and amplitude effects. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-instability-growth-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. KH initial growth in a smooth periodic shear layer Evolve the actual nonlinear2D vorticity PDE and compare finite-time growth and spatial errors with an independent continuous Fourier–Galerkin linear IVP. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic[0,2pi]², layer width.25, nu=kappa=.005, epsilon1e-5 and32²/64²/128² grids. Explicit forcing maintains the base. U=tanh(sin y/delta),T1. Editorial clarification Small-amplitude fixed educational cases. The independent reference changes spatial representation but linearizes the PDE; it is not a second nonlinear engine. No sharp-interface infinite-domain dispersion, original compressible McNally inputs, late roll-up or RT turbulence claim. Figures explicitly normalize computed perturbations by epsilon. Adopted numerical method Advance point-sampled perturbations using centered shared-face conservative fluxes and Heun; invert the five-point Poisson symbol by FFT. Centered derivatives define divergence-free velocity. Analytic base subtraction avoids a discretization imbalance larger than the small perturbation. −Δψ=ω,(u,v)=(∂yψ,−∂xψ) U(y)=tanh⁡(sin⁡y/δ),ωt+Uωx+U′′ψx+u⋅∇ω=νΔω σT=1Tlog⁡A(T)A(0),q^˙=LKq^ References and measured quantities Freeze22pytest tests,74case gates and10nonlinear evolutions. QualifyK24/40/56references; separately check three-grid field errors/orders, five-time growth,64²halved-step/halved-amplitude probes, Poisson residual, divergence and means. Verification limits and failures Small-amplitude fixed educational cases. The independent reference changes spatial representation but linearizes the PDE; it is not a second nonlinear engine. No sharp-interface infinite-domain dispersion, original compressible McNally inputs, late roll-up or RT turbulence claim. Figures explicitly normalize computed perturbations by epsilon. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Periodic[0,2pi]², layer width.25, nu=kappa=.005, epsilon1e-5 and32²/64²/128² grids. text.en: Optimization, noise and regularization in the Bratu inverse problem Retain existing synthetic observations and compare GN/LM, quasi-Newton methods and regularization selection on small fixed controls. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-inverse-optimization-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares Seventeen fixed fits separate parameter scaling, weights, bounds and physical-coordinate stopping conditions. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries A dimensionless one-dimensional Bratu problem with 31 interior nodes and zero Dirichlet data. The existing two-coefficient extension and saved observations are reused; objective regularization gamma and LM damping mu are distinct. Editorial clarification A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method. Adopted numerical method Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals. note.ja: 解析解 無次元・非有界の代数最適化。8次元SPD二次関数とRosenbrockの3初期値を用い、L-BFGSは現在の最大3組だけを保持します。物理PDE境界条件はありません。 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization uses an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts. L-BFGS retains only the current last three pairs. There is no physical PDE boundary condition. No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

name.ja: 雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化：参照・検証
name.en: Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths — references and checks

note.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。
note.en: Gate final residuals, physical KKT conditions and completion for all 42 fits, the selection rule, and covariance/bias/model-shift response against explicit scalar 2x2 algebra, including symmetry and PSD.

name.ja: 有限γ経路と局所線形雑音伝播のBratu参照
name.en: Bratu references for finite gamma paths and local linear noise propagation

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存の31/1023格子観測を再利用します。雑音の標準偏差σは1e-4と1e-3で、独立な基底雑音は2 seedです。尺度・格子文脈をまたぐ比較は同じ雑音ベクトルを共有します。γは固定5点です。 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Reuse existing 31/1023-grid observations. The noise standard deviations sigma are 1e-4 and 1e-3; two seeds provide independent base noises, while scaled/grid-context variants are paired. Gamma has five fixed values. Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

text.en: Annular Couette control for curved-wall LBM Refine the grid at identical physical conditions and compare interpolated/stair walls with analytic velocity,pointwise pressure and torque. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-lbm-annulus-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. text.ja: LBMのTaylor–Green渦と低Mach誤差 周期渦の解析解を使い、格子・時間刻み・Mach数が結び付く誤差と振幅依存性を調べます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-lbm-taylor-green-2026-11-24 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 LBM Taylor–Green渦：格子・刻み・Machの結合感度 周期2Dの非線形渦を実際に時間発展し、連続解析場への速度・圧力・エネルギー誤差を保存します。amplitude感度と同格子のcoupled刻み感度も分けて示します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 [0,2pi)²、ν.1、基本U.2、N24/32/64、dt=.2dx²、tau.56、T=.2pi²、144/256/1024steps。N32/U.4,.8とN32/U.2/dt=.1dx²/tau.53/512stepsを追加。初期圧力整合rhoを使用。 編集上の補足 拡散尺度では格子・時間・Machが結合し、amplitude変更はReも変えます。純空間/純時間/純Mach次数や有限Machの厳密非圧縮性を主張しません。平衡初期化のkinetic startupも実誤差へ含めます。 採用した計算法 標準BGKと完全周期streaming。p=cs²(rho−平均rho)(dx/dt)²で圧力単位とゲージを揃えます。解析場は初期値以外に注入せず、微分を独立Fourier演算で資格確認します。 u=Usin⁡xcos⁡y e−2νt,v=−Ucos⁡xsin⁡y e−2νt p=U24(cos⁡2x+cos⁡2y)e−4νt,⟨K⟩=U24e−4νt 何と比較し、何を測るか 22pytestと79判定、6固定発展。最細速度相対L2.03、圧力.08、combined速度次数1.5以上、エネルギー.03、発散・周期質量・平均運動量を判定。解析PDE5資格を区別して保存します。 最粗N16の初回エネルギー誤差5.0018%未達を保持し、同じ3%基準へ最粗だけN24へ細分化。次数は最細32/64対だけで評価します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 text.en: LBM Taylor–Green vortex and finite-Mach errors Use the exact periodic vortex to examine coupled grid/time/Mach errors and amplitude effects. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-lbm-taylor-green-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. LBM Taylor–Green vortex: coupled grid/time/Mach sensitivity Evolve a nonlinear periodic2D vortex and save velocity/pressure/energy errors against the continuous analytic field. Distinguish amplitude probes from a fixed-grid coupled-step probe. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic[0,2pi)²,nu.1,baseU.2,N24/32/64,dt=.2dx²,tau.56,T=.2pi²and144/256/1024steps. Add N32/U.4,.8andN32/U.2/dt=.1dx²/tau.53/512steps. Use pressure-consistent initial density. Editorial clarification Diffusive scaling couples grid,time andMach; amplitude changesRe. No isolated spatial/time/Mach order or exact incompressibility atfiniteMach. Kinetic equilibrium-startup transients remain part of the measured errors. Adopted numerical method Standard BGK and fully periodic streaming. Convert/gauge pressure ascs²(rho−meanrho)(dx/dt)². No analytic field injection after initialization; independently qualify the continuum field by Fourier differentiation. u=Usin⁡xcos⁡y e−2νt,v=−Ucos⁡xsin⁡y e−2νt p=U24(cos⁡2x+cos⁡2y)e−4νt,⟨K⟩=U24e−4νt References and measured quantities 22pytest and79gates,sixfixed evolutions. text.en: Linear algebra: factorizations, saddle systems, restarting and mass eigenpairs Small fixed matrices compare factorization and refinement, symmetric-indefinite solves, restarted eigenpairs and a consistent-mass string. Independent references distinguish residual from solution error, algebraic from discretization error, and counted operator actions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-linear-algebra-spectral-2026-11-24-r3 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Pivoted LU, Cholesky and iterative refinement Exact-rational comparisons separate conditioning, forward and backward error, and pivot growth. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fixed SPD matrix of size 12, a nearly singular rank-one matrix of size 8, Hilbert matrix of size 5 and Wilkinson matrix of size 12. Factors and triangular corrections use binary32; residuals use binary64, with five updates. Editorial clarification Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices. Adopted numerical method Original implementations of LU with partial pivoting, lower Cholesky factorization and triangular substitution. PA=LU A=LLT x(j+1)=xj+solvefactor32(b−A∗xj) References and measured quantities Exact-rational solutions for the actual binary64 inputs and separate LAPACK DGESV/DPOSV comparisons. Conditioning, forward error and backward error are reported separately. Each saved reference component is the exact Fraction solution rounded to binary64. Verification limits and failures Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.ja: 解析解 固定4行列の実binary64 A,bをFractionへ厳密変換し、有理数消去の解を最後にbinary64へ変換。LAPACKは別比較であり共有数値基盤を含みます。任意の悪条件行列に対する前進精度保証ではありません。 小さい固定例のみ。一般の高条件数系で混合精度の収束は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference The four fixed matrices use the actual binary64 A and b, converted exactly to Fractions. Rational elimination is exact, followed by a final binary64 rounding. Separate LAPACK comparisons share some numerical infrastructure. This is not a forward-accuracy guarantee for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices. Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices.

name.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系とSchur前処理：参照・検証
name.en: Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning — references and checks

note.ja: LAPACK全系解、理想Schurの3点スペクトル、CGの明示的負曲率対照。
note.en: Global LAPACK solutions, the analytic ideal-Schur spectrum and an explicit negative-curvature control for CG.

name.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系：独立dense解と理想Schurスペクトル
name.en: Symmetric saddles: independent dense solutions and the ideal-Schur spectrum

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 A=[[H,Bᵀ],[B,0]]、速度サイズ12/24、圧力行数5/11の代数問題。SPD理想Schurは全行列を小さく直接構成し、元の真残差とdense参照解誤差を別に判定。実Stokes境界値問題ではありません。 理想Schurは教育用の稠密制御であり、実Stokes PDEやスケーラブルな近似前処理の完成ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Algebraic saddles A=[[H,B^T],[B,0]] use velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. Explicit dense SPD ideal-Schur controls compare the original residual separately with dense-solution error. This is not a Stokes boundary-value PDE. A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner.

name.ja: 明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値：参照・検証
name.en: Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues — references and checks

note.ja: 既知の正弦スペクトルと独立な全行列LAPACK。shift解・Krylov作用・元残差作用を別計数。
note.en: The known discrete sine spectrum and an independent global LAPACK comparison. Shift-solve, Krylov and original-residual actions are counted separately.

name.ja: 再始動/shift-invert：固定離散行列の閉スペクトル
name.en: Restarting and shift-invert: the closed spectrum of a fixed discrete matrix

note.ja: 解析解 31×31 Dirichlet三重対角行列、h=1/32、再始動長8/16、shiftなし/0/950。参照はこの有限行列の固有値であり、格子細分化による連続PDE収束を認証しません。 単一対称実固有対だけ。暗黙再始動・Krylov-Schur・ロッキング・一般の非正規やクラスターは未実装。
note.en: Analytic reference A fixed 31 x 31 Dirichlet tridiagonal matrix with h=1/32, restart lengths 8 and 16, and shifts none/0/950. The references are eigenvalues of this finite matrix, not a continuum PDE grid-convergence study. One eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix only. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, or general nonnormal or clustered-spectrum capability is claimed.

name.ja: 整合質量FEM弦の一般化固有値：参照・検証
name.en: Consistent-mass FEM string eigenpairs — references and checks

note.ja: 一般化dense eigh、独立離散スペクトル、連続体(jπ)^2への細分化。M直交性と元残差は別量。
note.en: Generalized dense eigh, an independent discrete spectrum and refinement toward (j*pi)^2. M-orthogonality and original residuals are distinct quantities.

name.ja: P1整合質量弦：閉離散固有値と連続体固有値
name.en: Consistent-mass P1 string: closed discrete and continuum eigenvalues

note.ja: 解析解 長さ・張力・密度1、両端Dirichlet0、内部15/31/63点、最低3固有対。閉離散固有値とgeneralized dense LAPACKを比較し、連続(jπ)²への誤差を別に調べます。表示ベクトルは保存した数値解で、符号は任意です。 小規模1D弦のみ。SciPyが返す前の例外では入力を保存し、未返却の内部反復を保存したとはしません。 成分資格35判定は4科学例の合格を代用せず、元SciPy内部の未返却反復は保存済みとしません。
note.en: Analytic reference Unit length, tension and density, homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints, 15/31/63 interior nodes, and the lowest three eigenpairs. Compare closed discrete eigenvalues with generalized dense LAPACK, then measure error relative to (j*pi)^2 separately. Displayed vectors are saved numerical modes with arbitrary sign. A small 1D string only. If SciPy raises before returning, inputs are retained; unreturned internal iterates are not claimed to be saved. The 35 component checks do not replace the four full scientific cases.

text.ja: 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証 同じ2次元Euler等エントロピー渦を、背景Mach数.1/.01、16²・32²・64²、T=.1で計算します。両流束に無制限の中心primitive MUSCL再構築を用い、通常Roeと数値散逸をMiczek系行列で前処理するRoeをSSPRK(3,3)で比較します。物理時間項と音響CFL=.2を保つ限定例です。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-low-mach-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証 同じ非線形2次元Euler渦をN=16/32/64、背景Mach数.1/.01でT=.1まで進め、通常RoeとMiczek型の空間流束前処理を比較します。全12計算で、速度・動圧スケールの圧力誤差、保存収支、音響刻み、実段状態を調べます。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 領域[-10,10]²、周期境界、γ=1.4、β=3、背景ρ∞=1とU∞=(1,.5)。p∞=|U∞|²/(γM∞²)とし、流速と渦強度を固定して背景Mach数を変えます。M∞は局所最大Mach数ではありません。全平面の移動等エントロピー渦を最小像座標で評価し、有限周期箱のGaussian裾の継ぎ目を別に評価します。保存量のセル平均は8点Gauss求積で初期化・比較し、16点と照合します。閉形式の厳密セル平均や一般の厳密周期渦とは呼びません。 編集上の補足 実装するのは数値流束の散逸行列D=P⁻¹|PA|の前処理です。擬似時間の定常反復・二重時間積分による加速や、対流刻みでの陽的安定性を検証するものではありません。SSPRK(3,3)という名称だけから強安定性や非線形正値性の定理を適用せず、固定実行と標本化した定数状態Fourierモードの範囲を区別します。 最細のM∞=.01では速度誤差と渦の運動エネルギー保持が改善しますが、全域の動圧規格化圧力L1は通常Roeの約.01194に対し前処理側は約.01260で、圧力誤差が常に小さくなる結果ではありません。図の渦度・背景流からの速度差は中心部分の表示で、誤差判定は全域と固定coreを区別します。 採用した計算法 同じ無制限の中心原始変数MUSCL再構築・有限体積・物理Euler流束・SSPRK(3,3)を使い、Roe散逸だけをD=P⁻¹|PA|で前処理します。Roe平均の全流速Machからμ=min(1,max(Mlocal,M∞))、δ=1/μ−1とし、原始変数のMiczek行列を保存量へ変換します。行列絶対値は特性値ũn,ũn±τの2次多項式で作用させ、別の密行列固有分解と照合します。物理時間微分・音速は変えず、音響CFL=.2を使います。再構築した両面と各3段の正のρ,pを確認し、limiter・floor・状態修復・隠れた再試行・疑似時間反復はありません。前進Eulerの増幅反例を示すため、SSP・TVD・非線形安定性を名前だけで保証しません。 ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T F^=12(FL+FR)−12JP−1∣PA∣J−1(UR−UL),μ=min⁡(1,max⁡(Mlocal,M∞)),δ=μ−1−1 p∞=∣U∞∣2γM∞2,Δt=0.2Δxmax⁡(∣u∣+c)+max⁡(∣v∣+c) χ(k)=sin⁡k (3−cos⁡k)/2,ψ(k)=(1−cos⁡k)2/2,Lh=−i∑jχ(kjΔx)Aj/Δx−∑jψ(kjΔx)Dj/Δx,R(z)=I+z+z2/2+z3/6 何と比較し、何を測るか 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。 確認の限界と失敗条件 T=.1だけの短時間・少数格子の検証で、渦の一周や長時間保存を確認したものではありません。Fourier検査は指定した一様背景・離散波数・増幅回数の範囲であり、全波数や可変状態の非線形安定性・正値性の証明ではありません。実計算では音響CFLを維持し、対流刻みで進めたとは主張しません。定常解の加速、dual time、衝撃波・接触の頑健性、一般格子やMach数全域は未検証です。解析場の有限周期箱、Gauss求積、セル平均からの原始変数評価を区別し、圧力のMach依存や局所誤差を成功値だけに置き換えません。 無制限MUSCLは滑らかなこの入力の選択であり、limiter・TVD法・一般的な正値性保証ではありません。初版で現れた箱全体の圧力波を角の切り取りだけで隠さず、追加図で全領域の失敗を示します。 速度や固定コアの改善を圧力全域へ一般化できません。最細の全領域圧力L1は前処理側が少し大きく、M∞を10分の1にすると前処理の全域圧力誤差も増えています。圧力精度のMach独立性はこの実測から主張しません。運動エネルギー比は保存セル平均から求めた速度変動の診断で、連続場の運動エネルギーの厳密保存ではありません。 保存した実測値と判定 text.en: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification The same 2D Euler isentropic-vortex family is evolved at background Mach numbers .1 and .01 on 16², 32² and 64² grids to T=.1. Both Roe variants use unlimited central primitive-variable MUSCL reconstruction and SSPRK(3,3); one preconditions numerical dissipation with a Miczek-type matrix. Physical time and acoustic CFL=.2 are retained. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-low-mach-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification The same nonlinear 2D Euler vortex is evolved to T=0.1 on N=16/32/64 at background Mach 0.1/0.01, comparing ordinary Roe with Miczek spatial flux preconditioning. Twelve fixed runs retain velocity and dynamically scaled pressure errors, conserved budgets, acoustic steps and actual stage states. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic [-10,10]^2, gamma=1.4, beta=3, background density 1 and velocity (1,0.5). Set p_infinity=|U_infinity|^2/(gamma M_infinity^2), retaining the same flow and vortex strengths. Background Mach is not maximum local Mach. A whole-plane translating isentropic vortex is evaluated with minimum-image coordinates and a separately qualified Gaussian seam. Conserved cell means use eight-point tensor Gauss quadrature, checked against order 16; they are not closed-form exact means or a generic exactly periodic nonlinear vortex. Editorial clarification The implementation preconditions the numerical-flux dissipation matrix D=P⁻¹|PA|. It does not implement steady pseudo-time or dual-time acceleration, or validate an explicit convective time step. The SSPRK(3,3) name alone does not supply strong-stability or nonlinear positivity guarantees; fixed runs and sampled constant-state Fourier modes have distinct scopes. At the finest M∞=.01 grid, velocity error and vortex kinetic-energy retention improve, but whole-domain dynamically normalized pressure L1 is about .01194 for ordinary Roe and .01260 for preconditioned Roe. Pressure error is not uniformly improved. The vorticity/velocity-perturbation illustration is a central crop; diagnostics distinguish the whole box from a fixed core. Adopted numerical method Both finite-volume variants use the same unlimited centered primitive-MUSCL reconstruction, the physical Euler flux and SSPRK(3,3); only Roe dissipation is replaced by D=P^-1|PA|. At each Roe state use the total-speed Mach with mu=min(1,max(M_local,M_infinity)) and delta=1/mu-1, applying the primitive Miczek matrix through conserved-variable Jacobians. A degree-two characteristic polynomial applies the matrix absolute value; a separate dense eigendecomposition checks it. Physical time and sound speed are unchanged; acoustic CFL=0.2 remains. Reconstructed faces and all three stages check positive density and pressure, without limiters, floors, repair, hidden retries or pseudo-time iteration. A forward-Euler amplification counterexample prevents claiming SSP/TVD or general nonlinear stability from the integrator name. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T F^=12(FL+FR)−12JP−1∣PA∣J−1(UR−UL),μ=min⁡(1,max⁡(Mlocal,M∞)),δ=μ−1−1 p∞=∣U∞∣2γM∞2,Δt=0.2Δxmax⁡(∣u∣+c)+max⁡(∣v∣+c) χ(k)=sin⁡k (3−cos⁡k)/2,ψ(k)=(1−cos⁡k)2/2,Lh=−i∑jχ(kjΔx)Aj/Δx−∑jψ(kjΔx)Dj/Δx,R(z)=I+z+z2/2+z3/6 References and measured quantities The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution. Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01. Verification limits and failures This is a short T=0.1 fixed-input, few-grid test, not a full circulation or long-time preservation study. The Fourier check covers selected uniform states, wave numbers and powers; it is no proof for all modes, nonlinear variable states or general positivity. Actual integration retains the acoustic CFL and does not use the displayed convective diagnostic step. Steady convergence acceleration, dual time, shock/contact robustness, general meshes and all Mach numbers remain unverified. Finite periodic-box seams, Gauss quadrature and primitive variables evaluated from cell means remain distinct qualifications. Pressure Mach dependence and local errors are retained. Unlimited MUSCL is selected for these smooth inputs, not a limiter, TVD method or general positivity guarantee. The original box-wide pressure waves are shown in a separate full-domain failed-trial figure rather than hidden by the gallery core crop. Velocity/core improvements do not imply globally better pressure: finest whole-domain pressure L1 is slightly larger with preconditioning and grows when background Mach is reduced by ten. No Mach-independent pressure accuracy follows from these measurements. Perturbation kinetic energy is a diagnostic computed from conserved cell means, not exact conservation of continuous kinetic energy. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.en: Both finite-volume variants use the same unlimited centered primitive-MUSCL reconstruction,  the physical Euler flux and SSPRK(3,3); only Roe dissipation is replaced by D=P^-1|PA|. At each Roe state use the total-speed Mach with mu=min(1,max(M_local,M_infinity)) and delta=1/mu-1, applying the primitive Miczek matrix through conserved-variable Jacobians. A degree-two characteristic polynomial applies the matrix absolute value; a separate dense eigendecomposition checks it. Physical time and sound speed are unchanged; acoustic CFL=0.2 remains. Reconstructed faces and all three stages check positive density and pressure, without limiters, floors, repair, hidden retries or pseudo-time iteration. A forward-Euler amplification counterexample prevents claiming SSP/TVD or general nonlinear stability from the integrator name.

note.ja: 解析解 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。 同じ等エントロピー移動渦族の解析場です。保存量をGauss求積してから圧力・速度を算出し、周期の継ぎ目に残るGaussianの裾と求積誤差を明記します。
note.en: Analytic reference The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1. Analytic field for the same translating isentropic-vortex family. Pressure and velocity are evaluated after Gauss integration of conserved variables; finite-periodic Gaussian tails and quadrature error remain explicit.
