name.ja: 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証：参照・検証
name.en: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification — references and checks

note.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
note.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

text.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-maxwell-grazing-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium Evolve a finite packet with an 80-degree central phase angle to T = 700, isolating boundary error against a no-PML reference on the same grid. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed. Editorial clarification The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible. Adopted numerical method Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states. ∂tψ=−sx(ψ+Dxu),DxPMLu=Dxu+ψ ψn=bψn−1+c(Dn+Dn−1),b=1−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2,c=−sxΔt/21+sxΔt/2 ΔEmod+Wphysical−WPML=0 References and measured quantities Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged. Verification limits and failures The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-maxwell-lorentz-2026-11-24-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Lorentz分散板へのs/p斜め入射 有限波束の実進行から複素r/t・R/T・直接散逸を求め、複素Fresnel参照と比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 周期y方向のky=4に制限した2D場、c=1。板[4,5]のε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。外側は真空、PEC端は[-24,36]、T=60です。 編集上の補足 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 text.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-maxwell-lorentz-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab Measure complex r/t, power fractions and direct dissipation from actual finite-pulse evolutions and compare them with complex Fresnel slab references. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use a two-dimensional field restricted to periodic transverse wave number ky = 4 and c = 1. The slab [4, 5] has epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Outer vacuum ends at PEC caps [-24, 36]; T = 60. Editorial clarification This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible. Adopted numerical method Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy. ε∞∂tE=∇×H−σE−J,∂tP=J ∂tJ=fE−ω02P−γJ,f=Δεω02 ε(ω)=ε∞+fω02−ω2−iγω+iσω References and measured quantities Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails. Verification limits and failures This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Acceptance uses original fixed-input tolerances and unrounded numbers; only stored results passing every check are presented. 量 / metricMeasured value completed_matched_pairs6 text.ja: 多峰性MCMC：混合不良と収束診断の独立検証 二峰性分布で、局所的な閉じ込めと峰間の移動を比べます。自己相関・有効標本数・収束診断の計算を独立実装と照合し、診断値だけでは見逃す探索不足も示します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-mcmc-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元1D標的p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1)、平均0/分散37/正側占有.5。3固定seed・4鎖、burn1024、保持16384標本/鎖。prefix1024/4096/16384は入れ子で独立再試行ではありません。棄却と自己遷移を保持します。 編集上の補足 この検証の「合格」は、混合する系列の分布確認と、意図的に混合しない系列の失敗・診断の盲点を正しく示したことを表します。全系列が収束したという意味ではありません。RhatやESSは観測量・有限標本・初期値に依存し、同じ峰に閉じ込められた全鎖では良く見えることがあります。反射ジャンプは既知の対称性を利用する比較用の提案であり、一般の未知の多峰性を解く保証ではありません。 採用した計算法 局所幅.8、mixedのみ確率.1でy=−x+.8Z、それ以外y=x+.8Z。混合率は状態非依存でq(y|x)=q(x|y)のため対数標的比でMH判定。各鎖は独立PCG64 stream、提案の適応・棄却の間引きなし。 π(x)=12ϕ(x+6)+12ϕ(x−6),E[X]=0,Var⁡X=37 F(x)=12Φ(x+6)+12Φ(x−6),P(X>0)=12 ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。 確認の限界と失敗条件 固定seed・有限予算の教育用実験です。局所Gaussian text.en: Multimodal MCMC: independent checks of poor mixing and convergence diagnostics Compare local trapping and between-mode movement on a bimodal target. Check autocorrelation, effective sample size and convergence diagnostics against an independent implementation, and expose missed exploration that diagnostics alone cannot detect. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mcmc-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless1D target p=.5N(−6,1)+.5N(6,1), mean0/variance37/positive occupancy.5. Three fixed seeds, four chains,1024 warmup and16384 retained draws/chain. Prefixes1024/4096/16384 are nested, not independent replications. Rejections/self-transitions are retained. Editorial clarification Passing this validation means confirming the well-mixing run and correctly exposing failures and diagnostic blind spots in deliberately trapped runs; it does not mean every run converged. Rhat and ESS depend on the observable, finite sample and initial states, and can look reassuring when all chains miss the same mode. Reflection jumps exploit known target symmetry for this comparison and do not guarantee exploration of arbitrary unknown multimodal targets. Adopted numerical method Local scale.8; mixed uses y=−x+.8Z with probability.1, otherwise y=x+.8Z. The state-independent mixture is symmetric q(y|x)=q(x|y), so MH uses the log-target ratio. Chains use independent PCG64 streams, with no adaptation or removal of rejected states. π(x)=12ϕ(x+6)+12ϕ(x−6),E[X]=0,Var⁡X=37 F(x)=12Φ(x+6)+12Φ(x−6),P(X>0)=12 q(y∣x)=(1−p)ϕs(y−x)+pϕs(y+x)=q(x∣y),s=.8, p=.1 α(x,y)=min⁡{1,π(y)/π(x)},In=1{Xn>0} References and measured quantities Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value. Verification limits and failures An educational fixed-seed, finite-budget experiment. The local Gaussian RW is theoretically irreducible MH; finite-time trapping is not called a nonergodic algorithm. Small Rhat, large ESS and pooled-CDF agreement cannot rule out undiscovered modes. Symmetry-informed reflection is not a generic multimodal solver. No quantum calculations. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
note.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

name.ja: 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案：参照・検証
name.en: Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal — references and checks

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

note.en: 62 datasets: nine actual chains times three prefixes times x/indicator plus eight small fixtures. Regenerate and hash identical bytes; compare ordinary finite Rhat/ESS/ACF and test constants, zero within-chain variance, odd lengths, ties, shift and scale. Direct lag sums and infinite-series stationary-AR(1) tau=(1+rho)/(1−rho) provide separate checks of finite estimates. Routine runs compare stored references; live ArviZ regeneration is a separate optional procedure.

共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 text.en: Corner singularities, curved coordinates and Neumann/Robin boundaries Actually solve singular L-corner P1 FEM, annular variable-viscosity vector Q1 PDE, pure-Neumann compatibility/mean-gauge and mixed-Robin manufactured problems. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. note.ja: Cartesianの2成分を結合した線形応力発散BVPです。極座標内のQ1基底と正確な曲線Jacobianを使い、可変μの勾配と剪断応力を含みます。圧力・非圧縮拘束・対流項はありません。
note.en: Linear stress-divergence BVP coupling two Cartesian components. Q1 basis functions in polar coordinates use the exact curved Jacobian and include variable-mu gradients and shear. There is no pressure,incompressibility constraint or advective term.

note.en: Mapped polar Q1 with two Cartesian velocity components;4×4 Gauss integration of2mu epsilon uses exact r dr dtheta metric, followed by a block sparse solve. Circular traction uses r dtheta and outward normals.

note.en: Retain integrated L2/H1 errors, quadrature gaps, matched-DOF grading improvement, separate square/warp errors, minimum angle/aspect, estimated1-norm conditioning and true residuals.

name.ja: L字角の特異解：調和場と別の滑らかな製造解
name.en: L-corner singularity: harmonic field and separate smooth MMS

note.ja: 解析解 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。角の解析解と勾配を要素求積し、一様格子と事前graded格子を同じ自由度で比べます。別の単位正方形でsin(πx)sin(πy)をregular/warped格子へ置き、特異性と歪みを分けます。 特異解に正方形のL2二次を要求しません。固定の事前graded写像でありAMRソフトではありません。条件数は推定で、任意歪みへの保証はしません。
note.en: Analytic reference L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Integrate the analytic corner field and gradient over elements, comparing uniform and a-priori graded meshes at matched DOFs. A separate unit-square sine MMS on regular/warped meshes separates singularity from distortion. No smooth-square L2 order is imposed on the singular field. Fixed a-priori grading is not an AMR engine. Conditioning is estimated; arbitrary distortion is not certified.

name.ja: 環状領域の可変粘性・真2DベクトルMMS：参照・比較条件
name.en: Annular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMS — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 独自解析外力を別のCartesian応力差分で資格確認。L2速度/歪み/traction細分化、反力/体積外力と物理tractionの収支、粘性散逸と外力仕事を別々に測定。 体積外力の解析積分(756pi/5,0)も別に照合。
note.en: Qualify the derived force by separate Cartesian stress differentiation. Measure velocity/strain/traction refinement, reactions versus volume-force/physical traction budgets, and viscous dissipation versus force work. Also check the independently integrated body force (756pi/5,0).

name.ja: 環状粘性ベクトルMMS：独立応力微分で外力を確認
name.en: Annular vector-viscous MMS: force qualified by independent stress differentiation

note.ja: 製造解 1≤r≤2、theta周期、mu=1+.2r²、lambda=0、両円でu=0。A(s)=(s−1)(4−s)、u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2)。Nr8/16/32、Ntheta=2Nr。s=x²+y²、A=(s−1)(4−s)のCartesianベクトル場から応力と外力を解析的に導き、別のCartesian差分応力微分で確認します。体積外力の独立積分(756π/5,0)も照合します。 線形vector粘性BVPです。divfree拘束・圧力・非線形Navier–Stokesは含めません。原点なしのr>0であり、軸stencil検証ではありません。
note.en: Manufactured solution 1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr. Derive stress/force from the Cartesian vector field with s=x²+y²,A=(s-1)(4-s), then qualify force by separate Cartesian stress finite differentiation. Also check independent integrated body force(756pi/5,0). A linear vector viscous BVP, without divergence-free constraint, pressure or nonlinear Navier–Stokes. r>0 only; no axis stencil certification.

name.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: L2細分化、零空間、平均、CG差、source+1拒否、境界流束/体積源の収支を保存。
note.en: Retain L2 refinement, nullspace/gauge/CG gap, source+1 rejection and boundary/source budget.

name.ja: 純Neumann：解析場・互換条件・平均値ゲージ
name.en: Pure Neumann: analytic field, compatibility and mean gauge

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。u=cos(2πx)cos(2πy)、f=8π²u、外向き法線流束0を点DOFで比較します。平均0と平均.25を分け、source+1の物理的不適合を投影で隠さず拒否します。 同じ半離散系の別線形解法は独立PDE参照ではありません。既存Dirichlet MGの成功や2D任意境界へ一般化しません。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe. Use point DOFs for u=cos(2pi*x)cos(2pi*y),f=8pi²u and zero outward normal flux. Distinguish means0/.25 and explicitly reject incompatible source+1 rather than projecting it away. A different linear solver of the same matrix is not an independent PDE discretization; no general boundary/MG claim.

name.en: 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 2D解/誤差、真の残差、Robin関係残差と解析法線flux誤差、3格子細分化と積分収支を保存。
note.en: Save2D solution/errors, true residuals, Robin relation and analytic normal-flux errors, three-grid refinement and integral budget.

name.ja: 混合Robin：2次元解析場と独立な法線流束
name.en: Mixed Robin: 2D analytic field and independent normal flux

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。f=5π²cos(πx)cos(2πy)を使い、x壁は外向きNeumann±1、y壁はαu+β∂nu=gの解析値です。境界条件の代数残差と、解析的な物理法線流束の誤差を別々に測ります。 Robin問題は一意なので平均ゲージを重ねません。境界条件の代数残差と物理flux精度を区別します。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Use f=5pi²cos(pi*x)cos(2pi*y),outward Neumann±1 on x walls and analytic alpha*u+beta*dn(u)=g on y walls. Distinguish algebraic boundary-relation residual from analytic physical-normal-flux error. The unique Robin problem has no additional mean gauge. Algebraic boundary satisfaction differs from physical flux accuracy.

name.ja: 混合Robin：2次元解析場と独立な法線流束
name.en: Mixed Robin: 2D analytic field and independent normal flux

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。f=5π²cos(πx)cos(2πy)を使い、x壁は外向きNeumann±1、y壁はαu+β∂nu=gの解析値です。境界条件の代数残差と、解析的な物理法線流束の誤差を別々に測ります。 Robin問題は一意なので平均ゲージを重ねません。境界条件の代数残差と物理flux精度を区別します。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Use f=5pi²cos(pi*x)cos(2pi*y),outward Neumann±1 on x walls and analytic alpha*u+beta*dn(u)=g on y walls. Distinguish algebraic boundary-relation residual from analytic physical-normal-flux error. The unique Robin problem has no additional mean gauge. Algebraic boundary satisfaction differs from physical flux accuracy.

note.en: Actually solve variable-viscosity stress divergence on an annulus; check velocity, strain, physical traction and work.

通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-mhd-2026-11-22 --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Orszag–Tang：CT・GLMと独立Athena++比較 同じ周期Orszag–Tang初期値で、CTとGLMの密度・磁場、保存量、div Bを測り、別に実行したAthena++と比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 text.en: Independent fluid/MHD comparisons and CT/GLM Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mhd-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Orszag–Tang: CT, GLM and independent Athena++ Compare CT and GLM density, magnetic field, conservation and div B for the same periodic Orszag–Tang data, against separately executed Athena++. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Unit square, gamma=5/3, mu0=1, vz=Bz=0, t=0.05. rho=25/(36pi), p=5/(12pi), v=(-sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(-sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi). Editorial clarification The adopted GLM uses ch=3 and damping rate kappa=0.18 ch n, with n cells per axis: damping is grid dependent. Both use the same continuous initial field, final time and CFL, while actual step counts and native div B operators differ. Adopted numerical method Reuse the published first-order Rusanov/forward-Euler solvers: shared corner-EMF discrete curl for CT and cell-centered hyperbolic/parabolic GLM cleaning. Independent Athena++ uses HLLD, PLM and RK2. ∇⋅B=0,Bt+∇×E=0 References and measured quantities Measure density/By L1 error, mass/energy drift and positivity on 16²/32²/64². Check the independent 128²/256² reference and conservatively restrict its fine-cell averages. Verification limits and failures Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. text.ja: CTとGLM：同条件の独立照合・格子・時間収束 数値流束族・LLF係数・時間刻み・物理減衰率を固定し、CTとGLMの離散化を比較します。構成した滑らかな厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使い、格子誤差・時間積分誤差・参照自身の差を分けて確かめます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-mhd-convergence-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全3例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 CT・GLM：移動する磁気静力学平衡の格子・時間収束 非零の磁気力と圧力勾配が釣り合う構成厳密解を使い、同じ初期セル状態・流束の速度上界・刻み列でCT/GLMを比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 周期単位正方形、γ=5/3、μ₀=1、平面MHD。A=.05[cos2π(x−.3t)+cos2π(y−.2t)]、B=(Ay,−Ax)、ρ=1、v=(.3,.2)、p=.1+(2π)²A²/2、t=.1。保存変数の解析的セル平均を比較します。公刊の標準問題名を借りない構成検証例です。 編集上の補足 この滑らかな移流平衡はアトラスで構成した厳密解です。保存量のセル平均を比較し、そのセル平均から回復する圧力と圧力自体の厳密なセル平均を区別します。同じ半離散空間演算子に別の時間積分を適用した参照は、時間誤差の照合であり独立PDEソルバーとは呼びません。 採用した計算法 両法とも区分定数・同じ固定Rusanov速度α=3・前進Eulerです。CTは面Bと共有算術corner EMF、GLMはcell text.en: CT and GLM: matched controls, independent checks and grid/time convergence Compare CT and GLM discretizations with a matched flux family, LLF coefficient, time steps and fixed physical damping. Use a constructed smooth exact solution and independent Athena++ results to separate spatial, time-integration and reference differences. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mhd-convergence-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. CT and GLM: mesh/time convergence of a moving magnetostatic equilibrium Use a constructed exact equilibrium with nonzero magnetic force balanced by a pressure gradient, matching CT/GLM initial cell states, flux speed bound and time-step sequence. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic unit square, gamma5/3, mu0=1, planar MHD. A=.05[cos2pi(x−.3t)+cos2pi(y−.2t)], B=(Ay,−Ax), rho1, v=(.3,.2), p=.1+(2pi)²A²/2 at t=.1. Compare analytic conserved cell averages. This is a constructed verification case, not a claimed published standard benchmark. Editorial clarification This translating smooth equilibrium is an exact solution constructed for the Atlas. Compare conserved cell averages, distinguishing pressure recovered from them from the exact cell average of pressure. A separate time integrator on the same spatial semidiscretization checks time error; it is not an independent PDE solver. Adopted numerical method Both use piecewise constants, the same fixed Rusanov speed alpha3 and forward Euler. CT uses face B/shared arithmetic corner EMFs; GLM uses cell B/psi with fixed ch3 and physical damping rate kappa2. All meshes use384 steps and identical CT/GLM dt sequences; initial reconstructed CT cell B matches GLM cell B. A=a[cos⁡k(x−ut)+cos⁡k(y−vt)],B=(Ay,−Ax),Jz=−ΔA=k2A p=p0+12k2A2,∇p=Jz∇A=J×B Uˉij=1ΔxΔy∫KijU dx dy,p(Uˉ)≠pˉ Um+1=Um+Δt Lh(Um),Csum=αΔt(Δx−1+Δy−1) References and measured quantities Measure conserved-variable L1/L2/Linf errors and observed orders at16²/32²/64². Compare finest-grid step doubling with.1 of the spatial error. At fixed8², compare16/32/64/128 steps with doubly refined DOP853 tolerances/max steps. Record mass/E, positivity, native CT divergence, common cell divergence and psi. Verification limits and failures With constant LLF viscosity and periodic centered operators, the GLM div=psi=0 subspace remains invariant up to roundoff. This tests coupled-MHD accuracy; a separate nonphysical control activates cleaning. p(q-average) is not the exact averaged p. DOP853 is independent in time only and shares the spatial RHS. Step differences are empirical contamination indicators, not rigorous bounds; face/cell representation differences remain part of the comparison. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Standard periodic OT: gamma5/3, rho25/(36pi), p5/(12pi), v=(−sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(−sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi), t=.05. Both methods share192 steps on16²/32²/64². This supplements the previous immutable release. Editorial clarification Match the flux family, signal bound, time steps and physical damping, while retaining intrinsic differences in face versus cell magnetic fields and normal-field treatment. Compare the whole discretizations; do not attribute every difference solely to divergence control. Report native CT face divergence separately from a common cell-centered divergence. Adopted numerical method Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical. note.ja: 透磁率を1とする理想MHDの代表形。Eは熱・運動・磁場を含む全エネルギー密度。解説でCT・GLMと発散の測り方、HLLDテストへ進めます。 周期単位正方形・γ=5/3・μ0=1の平面理想MHDを扱います。構成した磁気静力学平衡を一定速度で移流する厳密解で、外力による製造解や標準円偏光Alfvén波とは異なります。GLMの補助方程式と具体的な保存変数セル平均は、実行例の式・入力・コードを参照してください。
note.en: Representative ideal MHD with magnetic permeability set to one. E is total thermal, kinetic and magnetic energy density. Follow CT/GLM, divergence conventions and HLLD tests. Planar ideal MHD on a periodic unit square with gamma=5/3 and mu0=1. The exact solution translates a constructed magnetostatic equilibrium at constant velocity; it is neither a forced manufactured solution nor the standard circularly polarized Alfvén wave. The execution example supplies the GLM auxiliary equation and explicit conserved cell averages.

text.en: Independent MHD transport, waves and compression comparisons Evolve all8conserved components with HLLD/MUSCL/Heun and2D CT. Compare wave means or unmodified Athena++ loop/late-OT fields, separating independent reference spatial/time increments. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-mhd-transport-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Circular Alfven wave: full-state refinement Evolve all eight conserved variables and compare circular polarization, including nonzero Bz/vz, against analytic cell means. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries gamma5/3, periodic[0,1], rho1,p.1,Bx1,amplitude.1, speed1,T1,32/64/128 cells. Initialize/reference conserved analytic cell means; pressure recovered from means differs from constant pointwise pressure. Editorial clarification Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. The observed order is for a 1D aligned wave, not oblique 2D propagation. Adopted numerical method Full-eight-state HLLD fluxes, MC-MUSCL reconstruction and fixed-step Heun. One-dimensional finite-volume update with constant Bx. ∂tU+∂xFx(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρv,E,B),γ=5/3 θi=2π(xi−t),(Bˉy,Bˉz)=.1sin⁡(πh)πh(cos⁡θi,sin⁡θi) ρˉ=1,Bˉx=1,(mˉy,mˉz)=−(Bˉy,Bˉz),Eˉ=.66 e2=∥U−Uexact∥2∥Uexact∥2,pobs=log⁡2(eh/eh/2) References and measured quantities Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify conserved analytic means by independent Gauss16 quadrature; measure transverse errors, phase and observed order. Verification limits and failures Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. The observed order is for a 1D aligned wave, not oblique 2D propagation. text.ja: MCMC・温度制御・生物モデル 小規模な固定入力で、計算法・参照・誤差・収束・失敗条件を確かめます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-models-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全5例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元1変数、対称Gaussianランダムウォーク提案幅1.5。固定master seedから32の別PCG64ストリームを生成し、1024回のburn-in後に各8192標本を保持します。 採用した計算法 log受理比でMetropolis更新。FFTによる連鎖内自己共分散を平均し、Geyerのgamma0+gamma1から始まる初期正ペア和から平均観測量のESSを求めます。古典的split-Rhatも併記します。 π(x)=(2π)−1/2e−x2/2,α=min⁡(1,e−(y2−x2)/2) τ=−1+2∑k=0K(ρ2k+ρ2k+1),Neff=MN/max⁡(1,τ) 何と比較し、何を測るか 正規CDFを独立参照とし、標本数1024/2048/8192の連鎖平均RMSEを比較。別の定常AR(1)系列と厳密tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho)で診断量を照合します。公差は固定入力で事前指定します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 mean_error0.0106317778433 text.en: MCMC, temperature control and biological models Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-models-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 5 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries One dimensionless variable and symmetric Gaussian random-walk width1.5. Spawn 32 separate PCG64 streams from a fixed master seed; retain 8192 samples per chain after 1024 burn-in steps. Adopted numerical method Use a log-acceptance Metropolis update. Pool FFT within-chain autocovariances and obtain mean-observable ESS from Geyer initial-positive pairs starting at gamma0+gamma1. Also report classical split-Rhat. π(x)=(2π)−1/2e−x2/2,α=min⁡(1,e−(y2−x2)/2) τ=−1+2∑k=0K(ρ2k+ρ2k+1),Neff=MN/max⁡(1,τ) References and measured quantities Use the normal CDF as an independent analytic reference and compare chain-mean RMSE at 1024/2048/8192 retained samples. A separate stationary AR(1) sequence and exact tau=(1+rho)/(1-rho) check the diagnostic. Acceptance is predeclared in fixed inputs. Verification limits and failures Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.ja: Hamilton系・振動子
name.en: Hamiltonian systems and oscillators

note.ja: 正準方程式と分離可能なHamiltonianの代表形。調和・4次ポテンシャルの振動子で、エネルギー誤差とシンプレクティック性を比べます。 Hamilton系へのリンクは調和ポテンシャルの力学部分です。計算には摩擦・雑音またはCSVRの温度浴が追加されます。
note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity. The Hamiltonian link identifies the harmonic mechanical part; the calculations add friction/noise or a CSVR heat bath.

name.ja: スカラーItô拡散：GBMとOU
name.en: Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU

note.ja: 決定論的初期値のスカラーSDE。平均・二次モーメントの弱誤差、共有Brown運動での強誤差、有限標本のMCSEを分けます。OUは調和Langevin系の浴成分に関連する追加検査です。 Hamilton系へのリンクは調和ポテンシャルの力学部分です。計算には摩擦・雑音またはCSVRの温度浴が追加されます。
note.en: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system. The Hamiltonian link identifies the harmonic mechanical part; the calculations add friction/noise or a CSVR heat bath.

name.ja: 熱・拡散方程式
name.en: Heat / diffusion equation

note.ja: 一定拡散係数νの代表形。モードの減衰、時間積分、境界条件へ。 線形反応拡散u_t=D u_xx+r u（公開入力はD=0.1、r=0.1）です。熱方程式へのリンクは拡散部分で、反応項を含む固有値r-Dk²で比較します。
note.en: A representative constant-diffusivity form: mode decay, time integration and boundaries. Linear reaction-diffusion u_t=D u_xx+r u, with published D=0.1 and r=0.1. The heat link covers diffusion; compare using the eigenvalue r-Dk² including reaction.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み
name.en: Turing reaction–diffusion framework

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復
name.en: FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。 公開固定入力は空間拡散を含まない2変数ODEの極限です。一般の伝播PDEを検証したという意味ではありません。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction. The published fixed input is the two-variable ODE limit without spatial diffusion; it does not validate the general propagation PDE.

name.en: Turing instability: linear growth and small-amplitude patterns

note.ja: Schnakenberg型反応拡散で、一様平衡の安定性と拡散による選択モードの成長を行列指数で検証します。
note.en: Use a matrix exponential to validate stable homogeneous kinetics and diffusion-driven growth of a selected Schnakenberg mode.

name.ja: Schnakenberg有限振幅過渡：非線形性と独立参照
name.en: Finite-amplitude Schnakenberg transient: nonlinearity and independent reference

note.ja: t=8までの有限振幅反応拡散を、独立なFourier–Galerkin参照・格子と時間刻み収束・新しい高調波で検証します。
note.en: Validate a finite-amplitude reaction-diffusion transient to t=8 with an independent Fourier–Galerkin reference, grid/time convergence and newly generated harmonics.

name.ja: Schnakenberg飽和パターン：近定常性と格子・時間収束
name.en: Near-saturated Schnakenberg pattern: near-stationarity and grid/time convergence

note.ja: t=100の1D選択パターンを独立参照で照合。参照の90→100の変化・全PDE残差と、有限刻みprimaryのFD残差を分けて測ります。
note.en: Compare the selected1D pattern at t=100 with an independent reference. Separate reference90→100 change/full-PDE residual from the finite-step primary FD residual.

name.ja: 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する
name.en: Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input

note.ja: 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。
note.en: Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison.

note.en: Excite a two-variable reduced membrane ODE with a current pulse; check all-output-time errors, temporal refinement and recovery against DOP853.

text.en: Nonuniform ALE transport and2D rotating shallow-water waves Time-advance conservative ALE transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells with GCL, and2D linear rotating C-grid shallow-water waves. A prescribed-ALE Saltzman-type piston and limited sphere transport/axisymmetric balance are separate additions; general global Williamson dynamics remain unverified. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-moving-waves-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells Advance cell integrals and face positions with identical Heun stages, transporting a nonuniform analytic wave beyond a uniform GCL check. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps. Editorial clarification First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work. Adopted numerical method Upwind relative flux(a-w)q advances actual masses with identical predictor/corrector face geometry; record stage volumes and Courant numbers. m˙i=−[(a−w)q]i+1/2+[(a−w)q]i−1/2,Vi=xi+1/2−xi−1/2 x(ξ,t)=ξ+0.2sin⁡(2πξ)sin⁡(2πt)/(2π) References and measured quantities Separate analytic moving-cell-integral error, global/stage mass, constant GCL and geometry error. Qualify an independent DOP853 integration of the same FV ODE with two tolerances. Verification limits and failures First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.en: Analytic reference Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps. Integrate q(x,t)=1+.2sin[2pi(x-.7t)] between the actual saved primary faces. Separately record geometry error against analytic face positions. Time checks use independent DOP853 at two tolerances for the same FV ODE. First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work.

name.ja: 2D C-grid回転浅水波の実時間発展：参照・検証
name.en: Actual2D C-grid rotating shallow-water time advance — references and checks

note.ja: 連続PDE空間誤差と離散symbol時間誤差、mass/energy、stencil-symbol一致、zero-mode慣性振動と離散定常釣合いを保存。
note.en: Retain continuous-PDE spatial and discrete-symbol temporal errors, mass/energy, stencil-symbol identity, zero-mode inertia and discrete steady balance.

name.ja: C-grid：連続Fourier解と離散記号の行列指数
name.en: C-grid: continuous Fourier solution and discrete-symbol exponential

note.ja: 解析解 線形f-plane、g=H=f=1、周期単位正方形、(k,l)=(1,2)、eta振幅.01、N16/32/64,T.5。別の固定N16時間系列、zero-modeと離散geostrophic診断。η₀=.01cos[2π(x+2y)]、u₀=v₀=0を、連続3×3 Fourier作用素と離散3×3記号の行列指数で別々に発展させます。主計算は実際の2次元staggered場を時間更新します。 線形・平面・周期squareの限定例。非線形浅水、PV・球面格子・全球dynamical coreやWilliamsonは未実装の後続課題。
note.en: Analytic reference Linear f-plane,g=H=f=1, periodic unit square, mode(1,2),height amplitude.01,N16/32/64,T.5. Separate N16 time refinement, zero-mode and discrete geostrophic probes. Evolve eta0=.01cos[2pi(x+2y)],u0=v0=0 with separate continuous3x3 Fourier-operator and discrete3x3-symbol exponentials. The primary actually advances2D staggered fields. Linear planar periodic square only. Nonlinear SWE,PV,spherical dynamics and Williamson tests remain future work.

note.en: Advance cell integrals and face positions with identical Heun stages, transporting a nonuniform analytic wave beyond a uniform GCL check.

text.ja: Noh衝撃波：厳密解・過熱誤差・格子収束 初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称Noh問題を1D有限体積法で解きます。厳密セル平均・原点過熱・格子収束を比較し、球では離散保存と境界時間求積の誤差を別々に検証します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-noh-2026-11-23-r5 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元r∈[0,1]、γ=5/3、ρ0=1、u0=-1、p0=0、T=.6。平面d=1・円筒半径対称d=2・球半径対称d=3をPDE実行し、衝撃半径は.2。外側密度は(1+t)^(d-1)、原点は反射、体積測度r^(d-1)dr。角度因子をすべての収支から共通に省き、球の解析総量はM=512/375、E=256/375です。球の図は1D半径解の中心断面で、Cartesianの2D/3D計算や角度方向の対称性破れの検証ではありません。 編集上の補足 初回不合格の実行ソース・入力・全8格子計算の診断ログに加え、全8本の元の全場プロファイルCSVも保存しています。stdoutから原文のまま抽出した不合格サマリーの来歴とは区別します。旧r3の同じCSVとSHAが一致することを確認しました。公開する成功版は全断面CSV・履歴・結果とZIP独立展開の再実行記録を備えます。 採用した計算法 Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。 確認の限界と失敗条件 平面・円筒は空間一次、球はMUSCL型の制限線形再構築を使う教育用計算です。原点過熱と有限格子のplateau誤差が残り、全域誤差から原点を除外しません。r²重みで中心欠陥が小さく見えるため、原点を含む固定coreの誤差と拡大図も示します。L∞や中心最大誤差のゼロ収束、滑らかな球問題での方式全体の高次精度、幾何源付き全RK段階の一般の正値性保証、Cartesian多次元、任意γの独立照合は検証していません。円筒L∞は旧系列で単調減少せず、球のL2/L∞と過熱も診断値として保持します。球の離散質量・エネルギー収支が丸め誤差でも、解析総量との差は境界時間求積のO(dt²)となります。半径方向の運動量には幾何源があり、保存されるCartesian運動量とは異なります。ExactPackは解析評価器の独立実装で、別の数値PDEエンジンではありません。 text.en: Noh shocks: exact reference, origin heating and refinement Solve zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical Noh flow with 1D finite volumes. Compare exact cell means, origin heating and refinement; separately verify discrete budgets and boundary-time-quadrature error in spherical flow. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-noh-2026-11-23-r5 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional r in [0,1], gamma=5/3, rho0=1, u0=-1, p0=0, T=.6. PDE runs use planar d=1, cylindrical-radial d=2 and spherical-radial d=3, with shock radius .2. Outer density is (1+t)^(d-1), the origin reflects, and the measure is r^(d-1)dr. The same angular factor is omitted throughout; spherical analytic totals are M=512/375 and E=256/375. Its figure is a central section of a 1D radial solution, not a Cartesian 2D/3D calculation or a test of angular symmetry breaking. Editorial clarification The initial failed attempt retains its source, inputs, diagnostic logs and all eight original full-field profile CSVs. These arrays are distinct from the failed summary recovered verbatim from stdout; their hashes match the same CSVs in the prior r3 edition. The successful release supplies all profiles, histories, results and an independently extracted ZIP rerun. Adopted numerical method Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure. ∂tU+r1−d∂r(rd−1F(U))=(0,(d−1)p/r,0)T,U=(ρ,ρu,E)T C=(γ+1)/(γ−1),rs=∣u0∣(γ−1)t/2,ρ2=ρ0Cd,p2=(γ−1)ρ2u02/2 ρ1(r,t)=ρ0(1+∣u0∣t/r)d−1,u1=u0,p1=0 Vi=(ri+1/2d−ri−1/2d)/d,Pf∗=F^m,f−uˉfF^ρ,f,arithmetic-face option: Sm,iVi=12(Pi−1/2∗+Pi+1/2∗)(Ai+1/2−Ai−1/2) E1=∑iVi∣ρˉi−ρˉiexact∣∑iViρˉiexact,M(t)=ρ0(R+∣u0∣t)d/d,Etot(t)=u02M(t)/2 d=3, ρ0=∣u0∣=1:Mh−Mexact=16∑nΔtn3,Eh−Eexact=112∑nΔtn3 Ecore=∑ri+1/2≤0.70rsVi∣ρˉi−ρˉiexact∣∑ri+1/2≤0.70rsViρˉiexact,Vi=ri+1/23−ri−1/233 d=3:∫ab2rP∗(r) dr=b−a3[(b+2a)PL∗+(2b+a)PR∗] rˉi=dd+1ri+1/2d+1−ri−1/2d+1ri+1/2d−ri−1/2d,Ui(r)=Uˉi+θiσi(r−rˉi) σi=minmod⁡(Uˉi−Uˉi−1rˉi−rˉi−1,Uˉi+1−Uˉirˉi+1−rˉi),0≤θi≤1interior cells; boundary slopes σ0=σN−1=0 References and measured quantities Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves. Verification limits and failures An educational calculation: first-order space in planar/cylindrical flow and MUSCL-type limited linear reconstruction in spherical flow. Origin heating and finite-grid plateau errors remain; the center is never removed from whole-domain error. Because r^2 weighting can make central defects appear small, an origin-inclusive fixed-core norm and enlarged view are also shown. Vanishing Linf/center maximum error, high order for the complete method on smooth spherical problems, general stage positivity with the geometric source, Cartesian multidimensional flow and independent arbitrary-gamma validation are not established. Cylindrical Linf was not monotone in the old series; spherical L2/Linf and heating are retained as diagnostics. Roundoff-scale discrete mass/energy balance coexists with O(dt^2) spherical boundary-time-quadrature error against analytic totals. Radial momentum has a geometric source and is not a conserved Cartesian momentum component. ExactPack independently implements the analytic evaluator, not another numerical PDE engine. note.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
note.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

note.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
note.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

text.ja: Noh問題：2次元Cartesianと格子方向の誤差 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Noh問題：実際の2次元Cartesian Euler計算 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 text.en: Noh:2D Cartesian flow and grid orientation error A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-noh-cartesian-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Noh problem: an actual 2D Cartesian Euler calculation A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional [-.5,.5]², gamma=5/3, rho0=1, inward speed 1, p0=0, T=.6, shock radius.2. Initial conserved states are cell-center cold samples, not exact initial momentum means. All four edges prescribe supersonic inflow rho=1+t/r and u=(-x/r,-y/r). No symmetry boundary, radial projection or geometric source. Adopted numerical method Unsplit shared-face x/y piecewise-constant Rusanov fluxes and SSPRK2/Heun. CFL .35 uses (max a_x+max a_y)/dx. Cold physical outer fluxes are spatially integrated analytically and their affine time dependence is integrated at both Heun stages. No cell repair, pressure floor/seed or hidden timestep retry; invalid stages retain raw arrays and fail. ∂tU+∂xF(U)+∂yG(U)=0,U=(ρ,ρu,ρv,E)T rs=t/3,(ρ,p,ur)2=(16,16/3,0),(ρ,p,ur)1=(1+t/r,0,−1) ρˉi=1ΔxΔy∫Ciρexact(x2+y2,t) dx dy M(t)=4R2+8Rtasinh⁡(1)+πt2,Etot=M/2,R=0.5 Δt=0.35max⁡ax/Δx+max⁡ay/Δy References and measured quantities Inputs/source/acceptance hashes are saved before execution. All 19 unit tests and 49 gates on three grids passed at the first attempt. Analytic density is integrated over cells by splitting shock-circle cuts and 64-point Gauss quadrature with x=rs sin(theta), checked against 128 points and analytic total mass; these are quadrature references, not closed-form exact cell means. At 128², full-square density L1=.09981, origin-inclusive core L1=.12231; shock errors are.968 axis cells and1.469 diagonal cells. Maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about 4.6e-15. D4 conserved parity and continuous rotational symmetry are measured separately. Verification limits and failures A first-order-space lightweight example retains origin heating and shock errors. Finest maximum center specific internal energy is still about 14% high. Axis/diagonal shock-radius difference is about .501dx and is not monotone over these grids. Roundoff-level D4 parity does not establish exact circular symmetry. General perturbation stability, displaced origins, rotated meshes, 3D Cartesian flow and high-order accuracy are unverified. Earlier planar/cylindrical/spherical 1D editions and gates remain unchanged. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.ja: 正方形の全域で密度・2成分運動量・全エネルギーを更新する、小型の2次元Euler有限体積計算です。32²・64²・128²の3格子で厳密Noh状態からの誤差・保存収支・格子方向の影響を測ります。図は実際の2次元保存配列で、1D半径解の回転表示ではありません。
note.en: A small 2D Euler finite-volume calculation evolves density, both momenta and total energy over the full square. Three grids,32²/64²/128², measure Noh-reference errors, budgets and grid orientation effects. The picture shows the actual evolved 2D array.

text.ja: 硬いODE・RK45・境界分割 Robertsonとvan der Pol、RK45の補間・イベント、非同次境界の分割法を小さな固定入力で検証します。独立参照、局所推定と実誤差、時間誤差と空間誤差を区別します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-ode-adaptivity-2026-11-24-r2 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全4例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 編集上の補足 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。 採用した計算法 BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。 y˙1=−0.04y1+104y2y3,y˙2=−y˙1−3 ⁣× ⁣107y22,y˙3=3 ⁣× ⁣107y22 ∥r∥w,∞=max⁡i∣ri∣/wi,edbl=(yh/2,h/2−yh)/3 何と比較し、何を測るか 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 maximum_sampled_weighted_error0.043888885126 factorizations11711 linear_solves23896 factor_reuses12185 accuracy_scopeFixed reference observation times only; all-step positivity/conservation separately tested. text.en: Stiff ODEs, RK45 and boundary splitting Small fixed inputs validate Robertson and van der Pol, RK45 interpolation/events, and splitting with inhomogeneous boundaries. Independent references distinguish local estimates from actual errors and temporal from spatial errors. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-ode-adaptivity-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Editorial clarification Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. note.ja: 3成分の硬い反応ODEと、保存則を代数式に置き換えたindex-1 DAEを区別して比較します。 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。
note.en: Distinguish the stiff three-species ODE from an index-one DAE obtained by replacing one equation with conservation. A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct.

note.en: Each example distinguishes physical time in damped rotation from pseudo-time used to reduce steady residuals. Use gamma = 0.2, omega = 3, initial state (1, 0), and T = 2. Three paired relative and absolute tolerances with two maximum steps, plus two terminal runs, give eight runs.

Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs.

note.en: Use analytic damped rotation to test acceptance, rejection, FSAL ownership, dense interpolation and directed event times separately.
