note.en: Evolve actual one-dimensional nonperiodic fields and compare unmodified and boundary-corrected Strang splitting against the same spatial discretization.

text.ja: 粒子・輸送：独立参照・保存則・統計誤差 周期力、FMM、PIC、衝突、放射輸送の既存問題を別版で検証します。決定論的な離散誤差、保存則、有限粒子数の偏りと統計誤差を分けます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-particle-transport-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全6例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。 手法・式・図・参照解 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 Coulomb定数1、単位立方体の3次元周期、全電荷0、tin-foil境界。旧版と同じ非対称配置です。独立参照も同じ零モードと自己項の規約を使います。 編集上の補足 非対称な中性立方セルの全エネルギー・全24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較します。積分・打切り・上限の感度は、この固定配置での確認です。 採用した計算法 erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。 E=1π∫0∞[∑ijqiqjΘ(ri−rj,u)−∑iqi2]du Fi=−∇iE 何と比較し、何を測るか 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 固定した中性立方セルだけです。上限感度は厳密な全配置の裾誤差保証ではありません。theta参照は別定式化の自作実装であり、第三者計算パッケージや公表された参照数表ではありません。非中性・非直交・スラブ・応力・長時間MDは対象外です。 保存した実測値と判定 表示は丸めています。合否は固定入力の元の公差と丸め前の数値で判定し、全判定が合格した保存結果だけを表示します。 量 / metric実測値 text.en: Particles and transport: independent references, conservation and statistical error Extend existing periodic-force, FMM, PIC, collision and radiation problems in a separate release. Separate deterministic discretization, conservation, finite-particle bias and statistical error. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-particle-transport-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 6 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Coulomb constant one; unit cubic 3D periodic neutral cell with tin-foil boundary. The asymmetric configuration matches the earlier example; reference zero-mode and self conventions match the model. Editorial clarification Compare the asymmetric neutral cubic-cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Quadrature, truncation and upper-tail sensitivity apply to this fixed configuration. Adopted numerical method Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces. E=1π∫0∞[∑ijqiqjΘ(ri−rj,u)−∑iqi2]du Fi=−∇iE References and measured quantities Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control. Verification limits and failures One fixed neutral cubic cell. Upper-limit sensitivity is not a rigorous tail bound for arbitrary configurations. The theta reference is an independently formulated original implementation, not an external package or published numerical table. Charged/triclinic/slab cells, stress and long MD are outside scope. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Same neutral periodic eight-charge cell, alpha=5.6 and three real-space image shells. This is Essmann-style SPME in the PME family, distinct from the original 1993 Lagrange interpolation. Editorial clarification Use the energy-gradient B-spline SPME variant of the PME family. Measure mesh-phase sensitivity and finite-mesh net force; do not claim exact momentum conservation or original Lagrange-PME reproduction. Adopted numerical method Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation. Fi=−∂Eh/∂ri ∑jMp(u−j)=1,∑jMp′(u−j)=0 References and measured quantities Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control. Verification limits and failures Finite-mesh aliasing generally gives nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant. No exact momentum conservation, arbitrary-configuration error bound, long MD, original PME or every SPME variant is certified. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Length 2pi, stationary unit-density ions, electron q/m=−1, plasma frequency one, sinusoidal displacement 0.001 and final time 1.6. Editorial clarification DOP853 integrates the same particle-grid RHS and is independent only as a time algorithm. Separate quiet-start refinement from random-load noise at time zero; do not claim exact energy conservation. Adopted numerical method CIC deposition/matched gathering, spectral Poisson and velocity Verlet. note.ja: erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。
note.en: Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces.

note.ja: 16³/24³/40³格子と4/6次Bスプライン、3つの平行移動位相を用います。FFT逆空間エネルギーを割当て重みで位置微分し、実空間・自己項はEwald主計算と共有します。
note.en: Use 16³/24³/40³ meshes, orders four/six and three translations relative to the mesh. Differentiate FFT reciprocal energy through assignment weights; real/self terms share the primary Ewald implementation.

note.en: Uniform random complete matchings and isotropic pair scattering preserve pair momentum/energy. An independent sampler projects Gaussian vectors into the zero-center-of-mass subspace and fixes their radius.

name.ja: Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分：参照・検証
name.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration — references and checks

note.ja: 参照の求積・theta/像の打切り・切替点をまとめて精密化し、上限32→40の感度を別に記録します。alpha3点、実空間4点・逆空間5点、平行移動・並べ替え、合力、エネルギー差分の3成分を比較。粗い打切りの不正確さを検出する対照も残します。
note.en: Record combined refinement of reference quadrature/theta/image/switch controls and a separate upper-limit 32-to-40 sensitivity. Compare three alpha values, four real and five reciprocal cutoffs, translation/permutation, net force and three energy-difference derivatives. Retain an intentionally inaccurate coarse-cutoff control.

name.ja: SPME：格子・補間次数・格子位相と保存則：参照・検証
name.en: SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation — references and checks

note.ja: 独立thetaエネルギー・全力との差と、共有Ewald経路自体の誤差を明記します。分配の総和・導関数総和、電荷、エネルギー差分3成分、位相間の幅、有限格子の合力と粗い格子の対照を保存します。
note.en: Report full energy/force errors against theta integration and explicitly check the shared Ewald path. Store assignment and derivative sums, charge, three finite-difference derivatives, phase spread, finite-mesh net force and a coarse-mesh control.

name.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ：参照・検証
name.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth — references and checks

note.ja: ポテンシャル・場の最大絶対誤差、実際の遠方移動演算、回転・平行移動誤差、電荷を掛けた力の合計を測ります。粗い展開の失敗対照も確認します。
note.en: Measure maximum absolute potential/field errors, actual far translations, rotation/translation differences and net charge-weighted force. Detect an inaccurate low-order control.

name.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音：参照・検証
name.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise — references and checks

note.ja: 16/32/64格子とdt=.2/.1/.05を別に精密化し、線形cos(t)と時間参照の誤差を分離します。実数奇微分のNyquist零モードはGauss残差から分けて記録。時刻0の64seed・N=256/1024/4096のCICモード電力を解析期待値と比較します。
note.en: Refine 16/32/64 grids and dt=.2/.1/.05 separately; distinguish continuum cos(t) from time-reference errors. Record the real odd derivative’s Nyquist null mode separately from Gauss residuals. Compare time-zero CIC mode power at 64 seeds and N=256/1024/4096 with its analytic expectation.

name.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合
name.en: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。 離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories. Periodic[0,2pi],256particles,grids8/16/32,seeds35001/35002,dt.02,T.24. Uniform random positions,v=.2Normal+.1sin(x). Six pairs mean twelve separately evolved trajectories.

name.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差：参照・検証
name.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error — references and checks

note.ja: 全roundの運動量・エネルギーの最大保存誤差は決定論的な許容値で検査します。最初の6roundの異方性、4点のエネルギーCDF、4次モーメントと有限NのBeta参照との差は、独立seed間の標準誤差で測ります。NによるCDF標準誤差の減少と、有限NからMaxwellへの偏りを分けます。
note.en: Check maximum momentum/energy errors over all rounds against deterministic tolerances. Use independent-seed standard errors for six-round anisotropy, four energy-CDF points and fourth moments against the finite-N beta reference. Separate decreasing CDF sampling error with N from finite-N Maxwell bias.

name.ja: 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計：参照・検証
name.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics — references and checks

note.ja: 16〜256セル・4〜64方向を別に収束させ、QUADPACK積分とE3を照合。64seed・1024/4096/16384光子で平均誤差、RMSE、二項標準偏差と95% Clopper–Pearson区間の実測被覆を記録します。全光子の出射＋吸収、正値性と離散フラックス収支を確認します。
note.en: Refine 16–256 cells and 4–64 ordinates separately; compare QUADPACK integration with E3. For 64 seeds and 1024/4096/16384 photons, record mean error, RMSE, binomial standard deviation and observed 95% Clopper–Pearson coverage. Check photon exit-plus-absorption counts, positivity and discrete flux balance.

name.ja: Ewald：非対称周期セルのエネルギー・力と独立theta積分
name.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration

note.ja: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。
note.en: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation.

name.ja: SPME：格子・補間次数・格子位相と保存則
name.en: SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation

note.ja: BスプラインSPMEを同じ独立theta参照へ照合し、格子・次数・位相への依存、電荷の保持、エネルギー勾配と合力を測ります。
note.en: Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force.

name.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ
name.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth

note.ja: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。
note.en: Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

name.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音
name.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise

note.ja: 冷たい1次元周期プラズマのquiet-start収束と、独立seedでの初期粒子雑音を分け、電荷・運動量・Gauss則・エネルギー誤差を保存します。
note.en: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error.

name.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差
name.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error

note.ja: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
note.en: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

name.ja: 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計
name.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

note.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
note.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

text.en: Particles, electrostatics, kinetic and radiative transport Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-particles-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 6 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Neutral-cell Ewald sums and an independent theta integral Implement real-space, reciprocal-space and self Ewald terms for neutral 3D periodic Coulomb charges; vary splitting and cutoffs. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Cubic cell, zero total charge, Coulomb constant one and conducting/tin-foil boundary. An asymmetric eight-charge case is distinct from the eight-ion NaCl reference cell. Adopted numerical method Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences. Mesh/order convergence of B-spline smooth PME A small smooth-PME example assigns charge with B-splines and evaluates the Ewald reciprocal contribution by FFT. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries The neutral cubic cell and real-space term match the Ewald example. The adopted PME-family variant uses Essmann-type B-splines, distinct from Darden’s original Lagrange interpolation. Adopted numerical method Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces. Qj=∑iqi∏a=13Mp(uia−ja+p/2) Fi=−∂Eh/∂ri References and measured quantities Meshes 16³/24³/40³ and two orders are compared with directly summed Ewald reciprocal terms. Shared real/self terms are stated. Check finest-grid force derivatives by energy differences and verify assigned total charge. Verification limits and failures Finite-mesh aliasing permits nonzero net force for this energy-gradient variant; that diagnostic is reported. Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless length 2pi, electron charge/mass −1, stationary ion density one and plasma frequency one. A quiet start receives a small sinusoidal displacement of amplitude 0.001. Adopted numerical method Combine CIC deposition and matching field gathering, a mean-zero spectral Poisson solve and velocity Verlet. Set the field Nyquist mode to zero for a real skew-adjoint spectral derivative. x˙i=vi,v˙i=−Eh(xi),−ϕxx=ρ,E=−ϕx A(t)/A(0)≃cos⁡(ωpt),ωp=1 References and measured quantities Separate a 32/64/128-grid sweep from timestep refinement on a 512 grid. Verification limits and failures Finite amplitude and finite particles leave an error floor. note.ja: 対の重心速度と相対速度の大きさを保持し、相対速度の方向を球面上で一様に選びます。roundは物理時刻ではなく衝突演算の回数です。 D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>と置くと、ランダムな相方の平均で重心の異方性が(N−2)/(2(N−1))倍になり、散乱後の相対方向の異方性期待値はゼロになるため、保存した期待減衰率が得られます。
note.en: Preserve pair center-of-mass velocity and relative speed, then choose the new relative direction uniformly on the sphere. Rounds count collision operations and are not calibrated physical time. For D=<vx²−(vy²+vz²)/2>, averaging a random partner multiplies the center-of-mass anisotropy by (N−2)/(2(N−1)); isotropic postcollision relative directions contribute zero expected anisotropy.

name.ja: 中性周期点電荷：Ewald・smooth PME：参照・比較条件
name.en: Neutral periodic charges: Ewald and smooth PME — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 同じ中性周期電荷・規約の収束したEwald和、力の有限差分とカットオフ・格子収束を確認します。孤立重力粒子の直接和とは境界・相互作用が異なります。 追加版は同じ中性8点電荷・立方体・tin-foil規約のエネルギーと全粒子力を、別実装theta積分と参照自身の細分化に照合します。SPMEはB-splineのエネルギー勾配型であり、原Lagrange PMEや厳密運動量保存を主張しません。
note.en: Check converged Ewald sums for identical neutral periodic charges/conventions, force finite differences and cutoff/mesh refinement. Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. The companion compares energy and every force for the same neutral eight-charge cubic tin-foil cell against a separately implemented theta integral and its own refinement. SPME uses B-spline energy gradients; original Lagrange PME and exact momentum conservation are not claimed.

name.en: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 同じ2次元対数核と粒子配置の直接和を数値基準に、多重極の次数・階層変換・力誤差を確認します。3次元1/r核の基準は流用しません。 追加版ではCartesian直接和と解析配置を別の基準にし、展開次数と木深さを分離します。深さに対する単調収束や3次元Coulomb核の精度・計算量を保証しません。
note.en: Use direct summation with the same 2D logarithmic kernel and particles to check expansion order, hierarchical translations and force error. Do not reuse a 3D 1/r reference. The companion uses Cartesian direct sums and analytic configurations as separate references, varying expansion order and tree depth independently. It guarantees neither monotonic error with depth nor accuracy/complexity for a 3D Coulomb kernel.

name.ja: CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動：参照・比較条件
name.en: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 小振幅の冷たいプラズマの線形変位cos(t)と比較し、電荷整合性・Poisson残差・自己力、格子系列と時間刻み系列を確認します。一般の非線形PIC軌道の厳密解という主張ではありません。 追加版は静止イオン背景のまま、電荷・運動量・粒子と場のエネルギーを軌道誤差と分けます。小振幅線形参照であり、熱的Landau減衰や電磁PICの根拠ではありません。
note.en: Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.

name.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布：参照・比較条件
name.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 等質衝突成分の運動量・エネルギー保存、異方性緩和と分布モーメントを確認します。有限粒子数の平衡はmicrocanonicalで、Maxwell/Gamma分布は大粒子数極限の基準です。空間輸送を含むBoltzmann方程式全体の厳密解検証ではありません。 追加版は固定運動量・エネルギー球面の有限粒子数モーメントを導出し、独立な射影正規標本と複数seedで比較します。衝突roundは物理時間ではなく、hard-sphere空間輸送へ対応を広げません。
note.en: Check momentum/energy conservation, anisotropy relaxation and distribution moments for the homogeneous collision component. Finite-particle equilibrium is microcanonical; Maxwell/Gamma distributions are large-N standards. This does not validate an exact solution of the full spatial Boltzmann equation. The companion derives finite-particle moments on a fixed-momentum/energy sphere and compares independent projected-Gaussian samples across seeds. Collision rounds are not physical time, and the correspondence does not extend to spatial hard-sphere transport.

name.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標放射輸送：参照・比較条件
name.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 純吸収・指定流入の平板に対する各方向の解析的な指数減衰と離散座標解を比較します。相対論的M1モーメント閉包とは別の放射モデルです。 追加版は解析rayと連続角度参照を保持し、固定角度の空間誤差と厳密rayの角度誤差、流入・流出・体積吸収の収支を分けます。散乱や多次元閉包へ拡張しません。
note.en: Compare discrete ordinates with analytic directional exponential attenuation through a purely absorbing slab with specified inflow. This differs from relativistic M1 moment closure. The companion retains analytic rays and a continuum-angle reference, separating fixed-ordinate spatial error, exact-ray angular error and inflow/outflow/volume-absorption balance. It does not extend to scattering or multidimensional closures.

name.en: Ewald: asymmetric-cell energies and forces versus independent theta integration

note.ja: 中性8電荷の全エネルギーと24力成分を、別実装のGaussian/theta積分と比較。分割・実空間・逆空間の打切り、保存則と不変性を分けて測定します。
note.en: Compare a neutral eight-charge cell energy and all 24 force components with a separately coded Gaussian/theta integral. Separate splitting and real/reciprocal truncation from invariants and conservation.

name.ja: SPME：格子・補間次数・格子位相と保存則
name.en: SPME: mesh, interpolation order, mesh phase and conservation

note.ja: BスプラインSPMEを同じ独立theta参照へ照合し、格子・次数・位相への依存、電荷の保持、エネルギー勾配と合力を測ります。
note.en: Compare B-spline SPME with the same independent theta reference; measure mesh/order/phase effects, charge partition, energy gradients and net force.

name.ja: 2次元対数核のM2M・M2L・L2Lを持つFMM
name.en: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L

note.ja: 自由空間の対数ポテンシャルを一様四分木の多重極・局所展開で評価し、直接和と比較します。
note.en: Evaluate a free-space log potential with uniform-quadtree multipole and local expansions and compare with direct sums.

name.ja: FMM：直接和・解析配置と展開次数・木の深さ
name.en: FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth

note.ja: 96粒子の2次元対数核を別の全対直接和と照合し、展開次数・木の深さ、回転・平行移動、合力の近似誤差を測ります。
note.en: Compare a 96-particle 2D logarithmic kernel with independent all-pairs sums; measure order/depth, rotation/translation and approximate net-force errors.

name.ja: CIC静電PICの冷たいプラズマ振動
name.en: Cold-plasma oscillation with electrostatic CIC PIC

note.ja: 1次元周期セルの電子をCICで格子と結び、Poisson方程式と粒子運動を自洽に進めます。
note.en: Couple electrons to a 1D periodic grid by CIC, solving Poisson and particle motion self-consistently.

name.ja: PIC：格子・時間収束、保存量と粒子雑音
name.en: PIC: mesh/time convergence, invariants and particle noise

note.ja: 冷たい1次元周期プラズマのquiet-start収束と、独立seedでの初期粒子雑音を分け、電荷・運動量・Gauss則・エネルギー誤差を保存します。
note.en: Separate quiet-start refinement of a cold 1D periodic plasma from independent-seed initial particle noise; record charge, momentum, Gauss diagnostics and energy error.

name.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合
name.en: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline

note.ja: ベクトル化CIC/FFTと、別に書いた粒子ループCIC・密なDFTを、それぞれが自己無撞着な場を毎kick計算する軌道全体で照合します。
note.en: Compare vectorized CIC/FFT with separately authored scalar-particle CIC/dense DFT; each trajectory sources its own field at every kick.

name.ja: 等質DSMC衝突成分の保存則・Maxwell分布
name.en: Conservation and Maxwell relaxation in a homogeneous DSMC collision component

note.ja: 等質なMaxwell分子のランダム二体衝突で、保存則と平衡分布への緩和を検証します。
note.en: Test conservation and relaxation toward equilibrium through randomized pair collisions of homogeneous Maxwell molecules.

name.ja: DSMC衝突成分：有限N平衡・保存則・統計誤差
name.en: DSMC collision component: finite-N equilibrium, invariants and statistical error

note.ja: 有限粒子数の平衡をMaxwell極限と区別し、独立な球面標本、解析的異方性減衰、seed間誤差と比較します。
note.en: Distinguish finite-particle equilibrium from the Maxwell limit; compare independent sphere samples, analytic anisotropy decay and across-seed uncertainty.

name.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標放射輸送
name.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab

note.ja: 純吸収の定常放射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。
note.en: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux.

name.ja: 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計
name.en: Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics

note.ja: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。
note.en: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage.

text.en: Domain-aware, double-exponential and sparse-grid quadrature Compare fixed integrals with domain-aware methods, separating estimated errors, actual errors, budget exits and underresolution controls. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-quadrature-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions Fifteen specialized quadratures and fifteen Simpson companions use fixed inputs. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Whole-line Gaussian, two finite frequencies, half-line Fourier and an internal singularity; absolute tolerances1e-6/1e-8/1e-10 and epsrel0. Editorial clarification Singular-node failures and unmet Simpson goals remain visible; error estimates are not general guarantees. The formulas and inputs specify mathematical integration domains and dimensions. Parameter and error axes are not physical spatial coordinates. Passing reproduction checks does not mean that every accuracy goal was met. Original row outcomes: 25 met, 2 unmet and 3 not computable. False/NA outcomes and raw failures are retained. Adopted numerical method Explicit domain/weight dispatch retains active full_output prefixes. The existing Simpson function is unchanged. I=∫Ωf(x) dx References and measured quantities Independent analytic interval references and actual callback counts are checked. The finite Gaussian target is an interval, not an invented erf value. Verification limits and failures Singular-node failures and unmet Simpson goals remain visible; error estimates are not general guarantees. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Acceptance uses original fixed-input tolerances and unrounded numbers; only stored results passing every check are presented. 量 / metricMeasured value records30 integrand_evaluations34351 text.ja: 小さな量子模型と保存参照カード 固定2準位連成・1D固有対・最小分子・3波模型と、H/He・周期Heの保存参照監査です。重い一般範囲は残します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-quantum-small-2026-11-25 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全7例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴 電子角と核座標を実際に結合した2準位模型を、短いNVEと核熱浴で比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。 編集上の補足 長時間第一原理NVE、一般の多軌道直交制約・SCF誤差、電子/核の一般熱浴、正準平衡・断熱分離・エルゴード性、実物質は未検証。 採用した計算法 解析BO力とCP型作用の式をVerlet/BAOABで積分し、核熱と架空電子運動エネルギーを分けます。 text.en: Small quantum models and saved-reference cards Fixed two-state dynamics,1D eigenpairs,minimal molecules and a3-wave model plus saved H/He and periodic-He audits. Broad expensive tails remain unverified. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-quantum-small-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 7 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions.

text.en: 2D shadows,beams and M1 closure Compute absorber shadows and opposing beams with discrete ordinates and M1, separately checking the closed M1 PDE with a manufactured solution. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-radiation-geometry-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport Compare the actual evolved circular-absorber shadow with characteristic chord attenuation, signed-angle transport and nonlinear M1. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Two spatial dimensions, a three-dimensional angular measure, c=1 and static absorption. Evolve the actual signed-angle and nonlinear M1 equations on24/48/96grids. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets. Editorial clarification Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented. Adopted numerical method Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure. ∂tE+∇⋅F=−κaE,∂tF+∇⋅P=−κaF P=E[1−χ2I3+3χ−12n⊗n] χ=3+4f25+24−3f2,f=∣F∣/E,Pxx+Pyy+Pzz=E References and measured quantities The independent characteristic cell averages and manufactured M1 forcing passed191reference/component checks before any PDE main. Check all-step budgets, realizability and positivity, spatial refinement, a separate half-step probe, and actual x/y evolution. Opposing-beam closure error is distinguished from numerical error. The new general flux passed762fixed component checks before this revised PDE main. Retain the17old tests and add5directional regressions=22tests; all24fixed runs and166scientific gates remain unchanged under the same120second limit. Verification limits and failures Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.ja: 放射輸送・モーメント法
name.en: Radiation transport and moment methods

note.ja: 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
note.en: Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

text.en: Non-equilibrium radiation: distinct diffusion and transport Separate Su-Olson diffusion and transport by normalization,boundaries and sources,with an additional matched periodic Fourier control for the resolved diffusion limit. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-radiation-matter-2026-11-24-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 無限領域の対称1次元角度輸送と物質交換で、ε=1、弾性散乱なし、低温の零初期状態です。Q=1を|x|<0.5、0<τ<10に与えます。主計算は左反射・十分遠い右入射真空の半領域で、比較時刻は境界の影響前です。別の同条件比較用の周期セル平均制御は、物理座標x∈[0,2π)、c=ε=1、κ=4/8/16、N=128/512/2048、Q=0、初期I=V=1+0.1cos(x)、s=0/.0625/.125/.25に対するt=κsを用います。この制御は1997のsource駆動問題とは初期・境界・sourceが異なり、制御内のFV・連続角度参照・拡散比較に同じ入力を用います。 原1997本文・原表と直接照合したとはしません。公開表の転記か再生成かは著者READMEに未記載。source停止後、一般散乱、全時空間の連続体誤差や角度次数は未認証です。 この追加はκhを解像したN∝κ²の半離散周期制御で、固定格子AP性や主SSPRK2の拡散時間次数を認証しません。初期F0と非零Fick流束の初期層を保持し、極限判定は最終s=.25のみ。両行列伝播にSciPy sparse expm_multiplyを共有し、DOP853照合は参照伝播器の資格です。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Infinite symmetric1D angular transport/material exchange,epsilon1,no elastic scattering,cold initial state. Source Q1 for |x|<.5 and0<tau<10. Primary half-domain uses reflecting left and distant incoming-vacuum right; comparison times precede boundary influence. A separate matched periodic cell-mean companion uses physical x in [0,2*pi), c=epsilon=1, kappa4/8/16, N128/512/2048, Q0, initial I=V=1+.1cos(x), and t=kappa*s for s=0,.0625,.125,.25. Its IC/BC/source differ from the source-driven1997 benchmark; the FV, continuum-angular and diffusion comparisons within this companion use matched inputs. No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator.

text.ja: 等方散乱平板と連続角度参照 等方散乱平板の角度離散法を、連続角度の積分方程式から得た独立参照に照合します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-radiation-scattering-2026-11-24 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 等方散乱平板の反射・透過・吸収 正負の角度を結合した実際の定常輸送を解き、独立な連続角Fredholm参照とR/T/Aを比較します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 text.ja: SRHD衝突・SRMHD非線形Alfvén波 SRHDの対向衝突をTaub関係の二衝撃波解と、全7保存量SRMHDの有限振幅円偏波を独立テンソル式・保存量平均と比較します。空間は1次元で、図のx–t表示は2D流れではありません。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 text.en: SRHD collision and nonlinear SRMHD Alfven wave Compare an SRHD head-on collision with a Taub two-shock solution and full7-state finite-amplitude SRMHD wave with independent tensor formulas/conserved means. Space is1D; x–t pictures are not2D flow. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-relativistic-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. SRHD symmetric two-shock collision Compare a relativistic symmetric collision with independent exact Taub-based conserved cell means; save actual1D x–t fields. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Editorial clarification Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means. Adopted numerical method Use the shared seven-component RMHD operator at B=0 with primitive MUSCL/minmod, causal HLL bounds±1 and SSPRK33. Safeguarded Newton recovers the physical Z=rho h W² root; check residual and full conserved-state roundtrip. U=(D,Sx,Sy,Sz,E,By,Bz)T,D=ρW,W=(1−v2)−1/2 hb2−ha2=(pb−pa)(hb/ρb+ha/ρa) v02=(pb−pa)(eb−ea)(ea+pb)(eb+pa),e=ρ+pΓ−1 j2=−pb−pahb/ρb−ha/ρa,Vs2=j2ρb2+j2 References and measured quantities Predeclare25 pytest tests,six runs,110 group gates and six reference qualifiers. Check all-component boundary budgets, stage/face admissibility,D/E refinement,star pressure,shock positions and reflection. Compare actual final states with independent scalar-pressure SRHD recovery and flux. Verification limits and failures Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means. name.ja: 相対論的対称衝突：特殊化した二衝撃波Taub参照
name.en: Relativistic symmetric collision: specialized two-shock Taub reference

note.ja: 半解析解 c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。 独自の穏やかな対称入力で、接触面は同じ静止状態へ退化します。一般三波Riemann解、高Lorentz因子、原著の数値入力は検証しません。Eは静止質量を含み、保存量の厳密セル平均と比較します。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver. Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means.

note.ja: 半解析解 c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver.

name.ja: SRMHD円偏波：有限振幅厳密族と独立テンソル積分
name.en: SRMHD circular wave: finite-amplitude exact family and independent tensor integration

note.ja: 解析解 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。
note.en: Analytic reference Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval.

name.ja: SRHDの対称二衝撃波衝突：参照・検証
name.en: SRHD symmetric two-shock collision — references and checks

note.ja: 群全体25pytest、6固定計算、110判定と参照6検査を事前固定。全量境界収支、各段・再構築面の正値と亜光速、D/E細分化、星領域圧力、衝撃波位置、反射対称性を検査。実際の最終状態を独立なSRHD圧力根と流束でも照合します。
note.en: Predeclare25 pytest tests,six runs,110 group gates and six reference qualifiers. Check all-component boundary budgets, stage/face admissibility,D/E refinement,star pressure,shock positions and reflection. Compare actual final states with independent scalar-pressure SRHD recovery and flux.

name.ja: 相対論的対称衝突：特殊化した二衝撃波Taub参照
name.en: Relativistic symmetric collision: specialized two-shock Taub reference

note.ja: 半解析解 c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。 独自の穏やかな対称入力で、接触面は同じ静止状態へ退化します。一般三波Riemann解、高Lorentz因子、原著の数値入力は検証しません。Eは静止質量を含み、保存量の厳密セル平均と比較します。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver. Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means.

name.ja: SRMHDの有限振幅円偏極Alfvén波：参照・検証

note.ja: 非線形分散式、独立テンソルのGauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で参照を確認。全7量保存と全段物理性、途中誤差、最細相対L1≤.04、位相≤.03、振幅≤.04、観測次数≥1.5を事前固定します。
note.en: Qualify nonlinear dispersion,independent tensor Gauss means and complex-step PDE residuals. Predeclare all-seven-component conservation,stage admissibility,intermediate errors,finest relative L1≤.04,phase≤.03,amplitude≤.04 and observed order≥1.5.

name.ja: SRMHD円偏波：有限振幅厳密族と独立テンソル積分
name.en: SRMHD circular wave: finite-amplitude exact family and independent tensor integration

note.ja: 解析解 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。 原著の厳密解族を独立な低次法で計算し、ECHO法や原著誤差表は再現しません。一般RMHD衝撃波、極端な磁化・Lorentz因子、GR、抵抗MHD、多次元磁場発散制御は対象外。図は実際の1D時空間場です。
note.en: Analytic reference Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval. Use the original exact family with an independent lower-order operator; no ECHO-algorithm or error-table reproduction. Generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/Lorentz factors,GR,resistive MHD and multidimensional divergence control are outside scope. Figures show actual1D x–t fields.

text.ja: Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証 球対称Euler方程式を半径方向の有限体積法で解く軽量例です。固定した半径0.03の領域に総エネルギー1を与え、128・256・512セルで点爆発の相似参照からの差と保存収支を測ります。図は1次元球対称データの断面表示で、2次元Cartesian計算ではありません。 text.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-sedov-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional gamma=5/3, ambient density1, velocity0, pressure0, radius[0,1], deposited energy1, T=.05. Uniform thermal energy inside a sphere is assigned using exact cut-shell volumes. Deposition radius0.03 is shared by all three grids; a separate512-cell run uses0.015. The origin is reflecting and the outer boundary is outflow; actual boundary fluxes enter measured budgets. Editorial clarification Revisionr1 passed22 tests and four runs on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux retry passed22 tests then failed in the -Werror main run when a CFL candidate ratio overflowed at tiny cold-tail wave speeds. Revisionr2 evaluates the same CFL condition as1/max(speed/width), avoiding intermediate overflow. Inputs/acceptance thresholds stay unchanged; retain the old release/failure and independently rerun23 tests and all fixed inputs from a new ZIP. Fixed-radius point-source comparison includes model discrepancy: its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order, and the radius comparison is sensitivity rather than complete deposition/PDE-error separation. Original Linux failure: https://github.com/hrkoyama/hrkoyama.github.io/actions/runs/45109504662 (all22 tests passed; the first128-cell,rdep.03 main calculation raised RuntimeWarning: overflow encountered in divide before completion). note.ja: エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

note.ja: 半解析解 理想気体Eulerの球半径対称、γ=5/3、周囲密度1・圧力0、爆発エネルギー1、r∈[0,1]、t=0.05。自己相似参照は瞬間的な理想点源を表しますが、有限体積計算は半径0.03の内部へ投入し、同じ最細格子で半径0.015も比較します。参照は相似ODEの数値積分、小さな中心域の正則漸近形、衝撃位置で分割する球殻求積を含む半解析解であり、閉形式の厳密セル平均ではありません。ギャラリー図は1次元球半径データの中心断面で、2D Cartesian計算ではありません。固定投入半径での誤差には点源とのモデル差が含まれ、その傾きは純粋な空間収束次数ではなく、投入半径の変更も感度診断に留まります。 エネルギー正規化した球対称の自己相似参照。相似ODEの数値積分・球殻平均の求積を含む半解析解で、閉形式の厳密セル平均とは区別します。有限半径の投入初期値は理想点爆発の特異初期値と一致しません。 固定した有限の投入半径で点源の自己相似参照と比べるため、誤差曲線には投入モデルの差も含まれ、純粋な空間精度の収束次数ではありません。同じ最細格子で投入半径を変える比較は感度診断であり、連続極限の投入誤差とPDE離散化誤差を完全に分離する検証ではありません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Ideal-gas Euler in spherical radial symmetry, gamma=5/3, ambient rho0=1 and p0=0, explosion energy E0=1, r in [0,1], t=0.05. The similarity reference describes ideal instantaneous point deposition. Finite-volume runs instead deposit energy inside radius 0.03, with a paired radius-0.015 sensitivity calculation. The reference uses a numerical similarity-ODE integration, a tiny-core regular asymptote and split shell quadrature; it is semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. The gallery picture is a central section of one-dimensional spherical-radial data, not a two-dimensional Cartesian computation. Fixed-radius errors include point-source model discrepancy, so their refinement slope is not a pure spatial order; the paired-radius calculation is only a sensitivity diagnostic. An energy-normalized spherical similarity reference. Numerical integration of similarity ODEs and shell quadrature make this semi-analytic, not closed-form exact cell means. Finite-radius deposition is distinct from the singular ideal point-blast initial data. At fixed finite deposition radius, comparison with the point-source similarity reference includes deposition-model discrepancy; its refinement slope is not a pure spatial order. Changing deposition radius on the same finest grid is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a complete separation of continuum deposition and PDE-discretization errors.

name.ja: Sedov–Taylor点爆発：球対称の軽量検証
name.en: Sedov–Taylor point blast: lightweight spherical-radial validation

note.ja: 球対称Euler方程式を半径方向の有限体積法で解く軽量例です。固定した半径0.03の領域に総エネルギー1を与え、128・256・512セルで点爆発の相似参照からの差と保存収支を測ります。図は1次元球対称データの断面表示で、2次元Cartesian計算ではありません。
note.en: A lightweight spherical-radial Euler finite-volume example deposits unit energy inside fixed radius0.03. Three grids of128/256/512 radial cells measure differences from a point-blast similarity reference and conservation budgets. The picture is a section display of1D spherical data, not a2D Cartesian calculation.

text.en: Spectral elements and FR: small comparisons with existing FEM/DG Compare2D SEM Poisson and1D periodic FR advection with the existing P1 FEM/modal DG under matched equations, boundaries and analytic fields. Separate h/p refinement, continuous error, residuals, conservation and time error from any external Nek/PyFR execution. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-sem-fr-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. 2D spectral-element Poisson: P1 FEM comparison and h/p refinement Solve a sine manufactured solution on the unit square with GLL spectral elements and the existing triangle P1 FEM. Compare matched free-unknown counts under h refinement and p=1..6 at fixed elements. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless: -Laplacian u=2pi²sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on[0,1]², u=0 on the boundary. Constant coefficient; affine Cartesian squares for SEM and the existing regular triangle mesh for P1 FEM. Adopted numerical method C0 tensor Qp Lagrange SEM with p+1 Legendre GLL nodes/quadrature, sparse stiffness assembly and a SciPy direct solve. At p=2 use2/4/8 elements per axis; separately fix2x2 elements and p=1..6. Execute the byte-identical published Numart triangle P1 FEM/GMRES at4/8/16 subdivisions, matching9/49/225 free unknowns. −Δu=f,u∣∂Ω=0,u∗=sin⁡(πx)sin⁡(πy),f=2π2u∗ Ke=S⊗W+W⊗S,S=DTWD,W=diag⁡(wi) EL2=(∫Ω(uh−u∗)2 dΩ)1/2,EH1=(∫Ω∣∇uh−∇u∗∣2 dΩ)1/2 References and measured quantities Compare with the analytic manufactured sine solution/gradient. Integrate continuous L2/H1-seminorm errors at independent higher-order Gauss points. Check h/p refinement, matched-unknown errors, boundary data and true residuals; save actual2D SEM fields and P1 vertices/triangles/values in NPZ. Verification limits and failures One smooth fixed problem only. Meshes, quadrature and algebraic solvers differ: no speed, complexity or universal-accuracy ranking. The diagonal GLL quadrature mass is not the exactly integrated mass of every product. No curved mesh, singular solution, incompressible flow or Nek5000/nekRS run. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. text.ja: 浅水流：地形・静止湖・乾燥床 浅水系の地形源項と静水再構成を、全湿潤・露出床の静止湖とSWASHESの定常Bernoulli流で検査します。別の平坦床Ritter破堤は、真の乾燥状態・保存収支・固定水深の前縁を確認します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-shallow-water-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 SWASHES地形流：静水と非零流量の定常解 水没・露出した隆起上の静水と、非零流量の亜臨界定常解を別々に検査します。静水の保存と、動く定常流に残る離散化誤差を区別します。 手法・式・図・参照解 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 text.en: Shallow water: topography, lakes and dry beds Check shallow-water bed sources and hydrostatic reconstruction with wet/emerged lakes and a SWASHES steady Bernoulli flow. A separate flat-bed Ritter dam break tests genuinely dry states, conservation budgets and a fixed-depth front. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-shallow-water-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. SWASHES topographic flow: lakes and nonzero steady discharge Check two lake equilibria separately from nonzero subcritical flow, distinguishing lake preservation from moving-flow discretization error. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient. Editorial clarification Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope. The final revision passed31 unit checks and all109 gates over8 group runs. The finest moving steady case,N400, has depthL1 about.0249108 and relative depthL1 about.000505933. Represented-bed lake balance, finite-time moving steady errors and dry-bed front errors are retained separately. Adopted numerical method Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair. ∂th+∂xq=0,∂tq+∂x(q2/h+gh2/2)=−gh∂xz z∗=max⁡(zL,zR),hK∗=max⁡(0,hK+zK−z∗),qK∗=hK∗uK FK=FHLL(UL∗,UR∗)+(0,12g(hK2−(hK∗)2))T q=4.42,h+z+q2/(2gh2)=2+4.422/(8g),h>(q2/g)1/3 References and measured quantities Freeze31 unit checks and eight group runs. Record lake drift, every FE minimum depth, shared-flux/bed-impulse budgets, conservative-mean L1 errors and three-grid ratios. Qualify an independent Bernoulli bisection by energy and branch checks. Verification limits and failures Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. note.ja: 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
note.en: Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

note.ja: 31単体検査と8固定計算を事前固定。静水の水深・流量の最大変化、全FE段の非負水深、共有流束と地形運動量の収支、定常流3格子の保存量セル平均L1誤差・細分化比を保存します。独立したBernoulli二分法のエネルギー一定・亜臨界枝を照合します。
note.en: Freeze31 unit checks and eight group runs. Record lake drift, every FE minimum depth, shared-flux/bed-impulse budgets, conservative-mean L1 errors and three-grid ratios. Qualify an independent Bernoulli bisection by energy and branch checks.

name.ja: 静止湖：表現した床の上の湿潤・露出平衡
name.en: Lake at rest: wet and emerged equilibrium over represented bed

note.ja: 解析解 g9.81、[0,25]m、200セル。8<x<12の放物線床z=.2−.05(x−10)²をセルごとにGauss8で平均し、h_i=max(η₀−z_i,0)、q_i=0、η₀=.5/.1mを初期化します。静水再構成が保つのはこの表現した区分定数床の平衡であり、連続床上の水深平均をそのまま使う別問題ではありません。 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Use g9.81,[0,25]m and200cells. Represent z=.2−.05(x−10)² on8<x<12 by split Gauss8 cell means, initializing h_i=max(eta0−z_i,0),q_i0 with eta0=.5/.1m. Hydrostatic reconstruction preserves equilibrium over this represented piecewise-constant bed; this differs from directly averaging depth over the continuous bed. Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.

name.ja: SWASHES定常流：非射流Bernoulli根
name.en: SWASHES steady flow: subcritical Bernoulli root

note.ja: 半解析解 g9.81、[0,25]m、同じ放物線床、流量q4.42m²/s、下流h2m。h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g)の非射流根を別の二分法で求め、セル平均求積を比較します。100/200/400セルのPDE計算は定常参照から初期化してt2まで進め、SWASHESの静止状態からの過渡計算そのものは再現しません。 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Use g9.81,[0,25]m, the parabolic bed, discharge q4.42m²/s and downstream depth2m. Independently bisect the subcritical root of h+z+q²/(2gh²)=2+q²/(8g) and qualify cell quadrature. PDE runs on100/200/400cells start from the steady reference and advance to t2; they do not reproduce the original rest-to-steady transient. Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.

name.ja: 乾燥床へのRitter破堤流：参照・比較条件
name.en: Ritter dam break onto a dry bed — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 全段の水深min、新たに濡れた初期乾セル数、残る乾セル数、境界流束を含む質量・運動量収支を保存します。Ritterのhとhuをファン端で分割したGauss8セル平均と比較し、Gauss16・全質量・PDE残差で参照を確認。3格子L1細分化とh≥.001mの最右セル中心を検査します。
note.en: Record all FE minima, newly wetted and remaining dry cells, boundary-aware mass/momentum budgets, and L1 refinement. Split Gauss8 h/hu references are qualified by Gauss16, mass and PDE identities. Diagnose the rightmost cell center with mean h>=.001m.

name.ja: Ritter乾燥床破堤：g9.81の専用セル平均参照
name.en: Ritter dry-bed dam break: dedicated g9.81 cell-mean reference

note.ja: 解析解 平坦・摩擦なしの[-10,10]m、堰x0=0、hL1m/hR0、初速0、g9.81、t.5s。左波頭−sqrt(g)tと真の乾燥前縁2sqrt(g)tで分割して保存量(h,hu)をセル平均します。固定水深.001mの等値線も区別します。旧参照カードと重力・領域・時刻の異なる専用入力で、旧値は変更しません。 前線診断はセル平均の.001m等深線で、厳密な支持端を別に保存します。非負性は固定実行の実測です。初期乾セルの濡れを検査し、後退汀線・周期的な再乾燥、実地洪水、摩擦や地形上の移動前線は検証しません。 初回100/200/400セル・[−5,5]mでは28検査と105/109判定が合格し、乾セル残存3判定と前線誤差.3960>.25mが不合格でした。元の全記録を保持し、許容条件を変えず領域・格子を細分化しました。 領域・格子だけを変えた第2回は微小な裾のbinary64 underflowで停止しました。第3回は同じHLL更新の水量packetによる代数的評価を導入し、元の28検査に3検査を追加します。
note.en: Analytic reference Flat frictionless[-10,10]m, dam x00,hL1m/hR0,zero initial velocity,g9.81,t.5s. Split conserved(h,hu) cell means at the rarefaction head−sqrt(g)t and genuine dry front2sqrt(g)t. Separately track the fixed depth.001m contour. These dedicated gravity/domain/time inputs differ from the historical card, whose values remain unchanged. The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged.

text.ja: 中性スラブ：3周期補正と真の2周期参照 長方形の周期箱と非周期zの分枝を固定し、Yeh–Berkowitz補正を真の2周期の自己項・零モード込みの参照と照合します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-slab-ewald-2026-11-23 text.en: Small learned models and independently checked biological ODEs Study a Poisson PINN, periodic-heat FNO and enzyme, predator–prey and SEIR systems under fixed budgets. Original learning and approximation goals remain separate from reproduction checks. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-small-models-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 5 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Poisson PINN: independent grid error Compare a 49-parameter PINN for three fixed seeds with analytic and finite-difference solutions. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Solve dimensionless −uₓₓ=π² sin(πx) on [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data. Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points. Editorial clarification This fixed-budget study covers one smooth Poisson problem and three seeds. A small training loss does not establish independent-point accuracy or general PINN training success. Unmet goals remain visible. Adopted numerical method Train a hard-boundary tanh ansatz with trust-region reflective least squares and an analytic parameter Jacobian. Retain every returned model under the fixed budget. Also solve second-order finite differences with 31, 63 and 127 unknowns using the Thomas algorithm. −uxx=π2sin⁡(πx),0<x<1,u(0)=u(1)=0 uθ(x)=x(1−x)[b0+∑j=116ajtanh⁡(wjx+bj)] ri=−uθ,xx(xi)−π2sin⁡(πxi)π2,L=164∑i=164ri2 References and measured quantities Independently qualify all 49 residual-Jacobian columns, loss-gradient coordinates and spatial derivatives. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Use periodic heat flow uₜ=νuₓₓ on [0,2π) to T=0.25. name.ja: Michaelis–Mentenと完全酵素反応系

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 限定した実行例：2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction. Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

name.ja: Lotka–Volterra捕食・被食

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 限定した実行例：1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。 無次元の捕食者・被食者系x′=x(1−y)、y′=y(x−1)、初期値(1.2,0.8)、0≤t≤20。正の象限で不変量H=x−log x+y−log yを評価します。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test. Scoped executed example: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity. Use the dimensionless predator–prey equations x′=x(1−y), y′=y(x−1), initial state (1.2,0.8) and 0≤t≤20. Evaluate H=x−log x+y−log y only in the positive quadrant.

note.en: Study a Poisson PINN, periodic-heat FNO and enzyme, predator–prey and SEIR systems under fixed budgets. Original learning and approximation goals remain separate from reproduction checks. Manufactured solution Solve dimensionless −uₓₓ=π² sin(πx) on [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data. Use sixteen hidden units, 49 real parameters, seeds 8401–8403, 64 training points and 257 separate evaluation points. This fixed-budget study covers one smooth Poisson problem and three seeds. A small training loss does not establish independent-point accuracy or general PINN training success. Unmet goals remain visible.

text.ja: 作用素分割：同じ反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較 短い時間区間の非線形Schnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ初期場・格子・部分ソルバー・出力時刻で比較します。時間の収束と数値参照の感度を調べる軽量な追加例です。既存の空間収束・長時間パターンの記録は保持します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-splitting-2026-11-22 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 同じ非線形反応拡散でLie–TrotterとStrangを比較する 32格子・終了時刻1のSchnakenberg反応拡散を、同じ入力・部分ソルバーでLie–TrotterとStrangにより進めます。4段階の時間刻みで1次／2次の収束、参照の感度、反応収支と未収束時の失敗を確かめる軽量な比較例です。 手法・式・図・参照解 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 無次元の1D周期区間[0,2π)、N=32、a=.1,b=.9、D=(.01,1)。u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x、v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4xは既存の有限振幅例と同じ初期場です。今回の終時刻はT=1、ステップ数16/32/64/128、共通出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1。反射対称・π周期の限定入力です。 採用した計算法 Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。 L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。 確認の限界と失敗条件
