text.en: Operator splitting: Lie–Trotter and Strang on the same reaction–diffusion problem Compare short-time nonlinear Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion with the same initial field, grid, subsolvers and observation times. This lightweight addition checks temporal convergence and numerical-reference sensitivity while retaining existing spatial and long-time pattern records. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-splitting-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Lie–Trotter versus Strang on the same nonlinear reaction–diffusion input Advance a 32-point Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion problem to T=1 with matched inputs and subsolvers. Four step sizes check first-/second-order temporal convergence, reference sensitivity, reaction balance and failure on nonconvergence in a lightweight comparison. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Nondimensional 1D periodic [0,2pi), N=32, a=.1, b=.9, D=(.01,1). The initial fields u₀=1+.08cos2x+.01cos4x and v₀=.9−.03cos2x−.002cos4x match the earlier finite-amplitude example. This new run ends at T=1, uses 16/32/64/128 steps and common output times 0/.25/.5/.75/1. The fixed input is reflection-even and pi-periodic. Adopted numerical method Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure. ut=0.01uxx+0.1−u+u2v,vt=vxx+0.9−u2v λh,k=−4Δx2sin⁡2 ⁣(πkN),Lh=ΨRh∘ehDLFD,Sh=ehDLFD/2∘ΨRh∘ehDLFD/2 ΨRh(y)=y+hR ⁣(y+ΨRh(y)2),⟨u+v⟩n+1−⟨u+v⟩n=h(0.1+0.9−⟨umid⟩) E2(h)=max⁡t∈{.25,.5,.75,1}max⁡s∈{u,v}1N∑j(es,j(t))2,pobs=log⁡2E2(h)E2(h/2) References and measured quantities The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering. Verification limits and failures This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. note.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
note.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

note.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
note.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

text.en: Modal damping of steady multistage RK A 16-component periodic linear field measures pseudo-time residual damping with stable, neutral and expanding controls. This is distinct from fourth-order accuracy for nonlinear physical-time problems. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-steady-rk-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Real-space mode damping with steady multistage RK Apply four steady residual stages on a periodic grid, separating damping, neutrality and amplification of discrete modes. The retained first run missed the original absolute residual goal in the expanding control. text.en: Weak/strong SDE errors and sampling uncertainty Use analytic moments and shared Brownian paths to separate weak/strong SDE errors from finite-sample uncertainty. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-stochastic-accuracy-2026-11-24 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. GBM weak bias and Monte Carlo error Separate continuous truth,exact discrete EM expectation,paired-path weak difference and MCSE. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries dX=.5Xdt+.4XdW,X0=1;dimensionlessT1;8/16/32/64steps;32independent seeds×1024paths. Unbounded state,no clipping. Editorial clarification Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused. Adopted numerical method Aggregate fixed fine Gaussian blocks;reuse one exact terminal array. OUexact kicks use the correct jointly sampled integral with independent bridge noise. Different floating reduction orders need not be bit identical. dXt=μXt dt+σXt dWt bp(h)=E[Xh(T)p]−E[X(T)p],p=1,2 E[Xh(T)]=X0(1+μh)n References and measured quantities Before paths qualify Decimal80/120,independent GH/OUcovariance integrals and paired-variance allocation. Gate5MCSE calibration,MCSE precision,fixed three-level weak rate and final-two-level3SE resolution. Coverage is descriptive over32batches against discrete truth. Verification limits and failures Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Acceptance uses original fixed-input tolerances and unrounded numbers; only stored results passing every check are presented. 量 / metricMeasured value text.ja: 決定論的温度制御と拘束自由度 小さな調和・四次系で温度制御の違いを比較し、固定線形拘束の有効自由度・運動量共分散・過渡分布を検証します。未達の統計目標も表示します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-thermostat-constraint-controls-2026-11-25 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 NH・chain・弱結合・速度固定の比較 同じ2モード系で、温度平均に加えて分布・揺らぎ・相関を比べます。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 単位質量,kBT=1、周波数1/1.7、quartic係数0/0.2。NH1/NHC3/Berendsen/速度固定、2結合・2刻み、正準256＋加熱128レプリカを固定します。 編集上の補足 著者作成の分割でありLAMMPS/MKT実装の完全再現ではありません。時刻20は混合・平衡化の証明でなく、平均温度一致だけで正準分布や一般的なエルゴード性を認定しません。 調査目標には、異なる熱浴の正準モーメント・相関と、固定した正準/加熱アンサンブルの有限時刻での比較が含まれます。未達は熱浴・初期集団ごとの結果を残したもので、必須の実装・再現検査とは別に読みます。 採用した計算法 明示した凍結変数の厳密bath部分流を対称合成し、各半bathを2副周期で計算します。etaはE部分流だけで進め、独立な全拡張ODEの短時間参照と照合します。 text.en: Deterministic thermostats and constrained degrees of freedom Compare thermostats on small harmonic/quartic systems and check effective degrees of freedom, momentum covariance and transient distributions under fixed linear constraints. Retain unmet statistical goals. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-thermostat-constraint-controls-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. NH,chains,weak coupling and fixed-speed contrasts Compare distributions,fluctuations and correlations as well as mean temperature on the same two-mode systems. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fix unit masses,kBT1,frequencies1/1.7 and quartic0/.2. Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas. Editorial clarification This authored splitting is not a full LAMMPS/MKT reproduction. Time20does not prove mixing/equilibration; correct mean temperature alone does not establish canonical sampling or general ergodicity. Study targets compare canonical moments and correlations across different baths and finite-time canonical/heated ensembles. Retained unmet outcomes must be read by bath and initial ensemble, separately from mandatory implementation and reproduction checks. Adopted numerical method Symmetrically compose exact frozen-variable bath subflows,two subcycles per half bath. note.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。 質量1/2/3の1D3粒子と1つの共通調和ポテンシャル。拘束なし・COM・COM＋相対・冗長行を含む同じ拘束でf=3/2/1/1、各1,024レプリカを用います。
note.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical. Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas.

note.ja: 半解析解 共通の調和ポテンシャル中の1次元3粒子で質量1/2/3、kBT=1。無拘束・COM・COM相対・冗長行の等価拘束で有効自由度3/2/1/1、各1,024標本を比較します。固定線形拘束Cq=0、CM⁻¹p=0を用い、冗長行は同じ接空間上で比較します。 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas. Dimensionless; masses 1/2/3 and kBT=1. Fixed linear constraints Cq=0 and CM⁻¹p=0; redundant rows are compared on the same tangent space. These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

text.en: CSVR and Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations Small fixed inputs connect numerical methods, references, errors, refinement and explicit failure conditions. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-thermostats-2026-11-22 from the ZIP. This command executes all 3 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries kB=1, T=1.3, tau=0.5, h=0.2, 65536 independent replicas. Test three initial energies at each of three degree counts. No Hamiltonian force, positions, constraints or center-of-mass removal. Adopted numerical method Use the completed-square exact CIR transition with normal R and independent chi-square(Nf−1) S. The same R sets the sign of global alpha; S=0 for Nf=1. Reconstruct momentum from its unit direction and new radius without a tiny-K energy ratio. Reject K=0 because its direction is undefined. Kˉ=NfT2,c=e−h/τ,A=T(1−c)2,R∼N(0,1), S∼χNf−12 K′=(cK+AR)2+AS,sign⁡α=sign⁡(cK+AR) E[K′∣K]=cK+(1−c)Kˉ,Var⁡(K′∣K)=2TKc(1−c)+NfT22(1−c)2 K∼Gamma⁡(Nf/2,T),Var⁡(Tinst)=2T2Nf,CKbath(t)=e−t/τ References and measured quantities Compare with separate CIR conditional moments, three SciPy noncentral-chi-square quantile probabilities, stationary Gamma K and bath-only exp(−t/tau) correlation. A separate noiseless mean-relaxation control demonstrates loss of fluctuations. Verification limits and failures A bath diagnostic, not another independent physical problem. Correct K sampling does not thermalize momentum directions by global scaling alone. The bath-only exp(−t/tau) identity is not a full-MD kinetic ACF. Statistical decisions apply to fixed seeds/budgets, not general mixing guarantees. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. (8), the sign of alpha in Eq. (9) using the same Gaussian, the Nf=1 Langevin limit and tau=1/(2 gamma). The original long Lennard-Jones transport calculations are not reproduced. Year is access year. This is an original implementation, not a reproduction of the downloadable code. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4. Adopted numerical method Both use exact O(h/2)–velocity-Verlet–O(h/2), or OBABO. CSVR applies one factor to all momenta; Langevin uses independent component-wise OU noise. gamma=1/(2 tau) matches bath-only K relaxation. The earlier BAOAB release is retained as a different splitting. U(q)=12∑i=12ωi2qi2,H=K+U,γ=12τ Σh,i=diag⁡(Tωi2(1−h2ωi2/4),T),Σh=MΣhMT+Q K∼Gamma⁡(1,T),H∼Gamma⁡(2,T),Var⁡K=T2,Var⁡H=2T2 CX(t)=E[(Xt−μX)(X0−μX)]σX2,SE⁡(C^X)=sproductsNreplicas References and measured quantities Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence. Verification limits and failures Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. note.en: Use the completed-square exact CIR transition with normal R and independent chi-square(Nf−1) S. The same R sets the sign of global alpha; S=0 for Nf=1. Reconstruct momentum from its unit direction and new radius without a tiny-K energy ratio. Reject K=0 because its direction is undefined.

text.ja: 非周期壁面：キャビティと製造解 非周期壁面の2D渦度・流れ関数法でRe100蓋駆動キャビティと製造流れを解きます。Ghia原著の有限格子数値表、壁剪断と格子収束を比較し、独立した圧力Poisson・勾配製造問題を区別します。 text.en: Nonperiodic walls: cavity and manufactured flow Solve a Re100 lid-driven cavity and manufactured flow with a nonperiodic wall-bounded2D vorticity/streamfunction method. Compare original finite-grid Ghia tables, wall shear and grid refinement, keeping a separate pressure-Poisson/gradient manufactured problem distinct. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-wall-flow-2026-11-23-r2 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison March a real nonperiodic 2D viscous incompressible solver to steady state on 17/33/65 node grids and compare against original Ghia centerlines. Retain streamlines, grid vortex center, true PDE residual and discrete divergence. Methods, equations, figures and references Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless unit square, viscosity .01, lid speed1, Re=100. Top interior nodes have u=1; other walls and all four corners have zero velocity. Psi=0 on every wall; initial interior vorticity 0. Reapply Thom wall vorticity at every Heun stage. Editorial clarification Educational Re=100 checks on three fixed grids. Lid/sidewall corner velocities are discontinuous; stationary corners take precedence. Ghia values are rounded numerical references, not an exact solution, and printed four-decimal coordinates are preserved. No high-Re, turbulence, original-algorithm reproduction or cavity-pressure validation is claimed. Scientific-source revision3, immutable edition2026-11-23-r2, passed22 unit checks and all94 group gates. After the initial NumPy-boolean JSON-serialization failure, the next unpublished candidate lacked completion status and case-ID top-level checks required by the common verifier. This edition only repairs the JSON envelope with termination,failure and case-keyed checks, retaining the prior three diagnostics under summary_checks, and adds one regression. Inputs,acceptance,numerical solver,references and the prior21 tests are unchanged. All six saved NPZ field arrays are bit-identical to the previous candidate. The original unpublished packet is archived outside the public tree, and earlier failure history is retained. Finest Ghia centerline maximum errors are about.00277820 foru and.00590408 forv; the grid primary vortex is(.609375,.734375), with true steady residual about9.68e-10. name.ja: 壁面製造解：多項式速度と独立した圧力演算子
name.en: Wall manufactured solution: polynomial velocity and separate pressure operator

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形・ν.01・滑りなし、ψ*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²、u*=ψ*y、v*=−ψ*x、ω*=−Δψ*。連続の渦度式からs=u*ω*x+v*ω*y−νΔω*を構成し、独立の係数行列微分と照合します。PDE計算の壁渦度はキャビティと同じThom式で、厳密値を注入しません。p_op=x²+y²+sinπx sinπyの非零Dirichlet Poisson・勾配は別の演算子問題で、流れに結合した圧力やキャビティ圧力ではありません。 Thomの壁渦度局所打切りは一次で、壁剪断の二次精度は主張せず観測次数を示します。流れ関数の発展では圧力を消去するためゲージは該当しません。圧力診断は独立した演算子製造問題であり、キャビティの圧力・応力境界やMAC射影の検証ではありません。多項式の別微分は独立な流体ソルバーとの比較とは区別します。
note.en: Manufactured solution Unit square,viscosity.01,no-slip,psi*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²,u*=psi*_y,v*=−psi*_x,omega*=−Delta psi*. Construct s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega* from the continuous vorticity PDE, qualified by independent tensor-coefficient differentiation. PDE wall vorticity uses the same Thom closure as the cavity without exact injection. Nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/gradient for p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y) is a separate operator problem, not coupled flow or cavity pressure. Thom wall vorticity has first-order local truncation; publish observed shear rates without promising second order. Pressure is eliminated from streamfunction evolution, so a pressure gauge is inapplicable. The separate operator MMS does not verify cavity pressure, traction boundaries or MAC projection. Independent polynomial differentiation is distinct from comparison with an independent flow solver.

text.ja: 熱的PIC：Landau減衰と二流不安定性 自己無撞着な全分布の重み付きPICを、独立な誘電分散式と線形Volterra初期値問題と比較します。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-warm-pic-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 温かいPICの線形Landau減衰 熱速度1のMaxwell分布を自己無撞着に動かし、減衰率・周波数・符号付き場の履歴を独立した線形参照で調べます。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 vth=ωp=λD=1、k=.5、L=4π、α=.01、格子32、256空間層×128速度節点、dt=.04、T16、固定窓[4,12]。シード33001–33004。 空間粒子層だけ512へ倍増する独立companionも固定します。 編集上の補足 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 採用した計算法 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。 ∂tf+v∂xf−E∂vf=0,∂xE=1−∫f dv,⟨E⟩=0 D(ω,k)=1+1k2∑sas[1+ζsZ(ζs)],ζs=ω−kus2k e(t)=Φ(t)−∫0tsΦ(s)e(t−s) text.en: Warm PIC: Landau damping and two-stream instability Compare self-consistent weighted full-f PIC with independently formulated dielectric dispersion and linear Volterra IVPs. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-warm-pic-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Warm PIC linear Landau damping Advance thermal Maxwellian full-f particles and compare damping rate, frequency and signed-field history with qualified independent linear references. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries vth=omega_p=lambda_D=1,k.5,L4pi,alpha.01,grid32,256spatial strata×128velocity nodes,dt.04,T16,fit[4,12],seeds33001–33004. A separately evolved512-spatial-strata companion changes only particle-space resolution. Editorial clarification Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Adopted numerical method Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. name.ja: Particle-in-Cell（PIC）
name.en: Particle-in-cell / PIC

note.ja: 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。
note.en: Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. Qualify the dielectric root using branch continuation/bracket checks and a separately derived, time-refined Volterra IVP with the same fixed-window estimator.

title.ja: WENOの臨界点・ε依存性
title.en: WENO critical points and epsilon dependence

ja.title: 配布版を取得して実行する
何と比較し、何を測るか
確認の限界と失敗条件
保存した実測値と判定
一次文献・関連資料と確認範囲

text.ja: WENOの臨界点・ε依存性 セル平均からのWENO-JS／Z二乗重みの臨界点再構成と、実際の周期スカラー輸送を比較します。εの違い、解析セル平均と点値、空間誤差と時間刻みの影響を分けます。 選んだ一次臨界多項式では微小εのJS・Zの局所次数はともに約5で、Zの主誤差が小さい結果です。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-weno-critical-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 局所多項式のセル中心x=0、再構成面h/2、h=1/64…1/512を使います。輸送は[0,1]周期・速度1・q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)、T=1、32/64/128セルです。全て有限体積セル平均であり、点値を誤差の参照にしません。 編集上の補足 一次臨界点の面再構成だけに次数判定を置き、二次臨界点は診断値として残します。固定εは解の振幅・単位に依存します。局所再構成の次数とPDE全体の次数、有限体積版と原著の有限差分版を区別します。衝撃波、Euler/MHD、一般の高次臨界点、任意入力の安定性・TVD・正値性は今回の保証に含めません。 選んだ一次臨界多項式では、微小εのJS・Zのどちらも最後の格子対の局所再構成次数は約5です。JSの絶対誤差は約9.77×10⁻⁹から2.88×10⁻¹³、Zは約2.12×10⁻⁹から5.70×10⁻¹⁴へ減少し、最細のZ/JS比は約.198です。この固定例が示すのは主誤差の減少であり、JSの次数低下やZによる普遍的な臨界点の次数回復を観測したという意味ではありません。二次臨界クラスの結果は別の診断として残します。 採用した計算法 3候補と線形重み(.1,.6,.3)、Jiang–Shu指標を共通にし、JSはd/(β+ε)²、Zはd[1+(|β₀−β₂|/(β+ε))²]を正規化します。ε=10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h²です。輸送は共有風上面流束と古典RK4、Courant.1を使い、状態クリップ・再試行を行いません。 qˉi=h−1∫xi−h/2xi+h/2q(x) dx,qi+1/2−=∑k=02ωkpk text.en: WENO critical points and epsilon dependence Compare critical-point reconstruction from cell means using WENO-JS/Z power-two weights and actual periodic scalar transport. Separate epsilon choices, analytic cell means versus point values, and spatial error versus time-step effects. For the selected first-critical polynomial, both tiny-epsilon JS and Z show local rates about5; Z has a smaller leading error. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-weno-critical-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Local polynomials have center x=0 and target h/2, h=1/64…1/512. Transport uses periodic[0,1], unit speed, q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx), T=1 and32/64/128 cells. All evolved states/references are FV cell means, not point samples. Editorial clarification Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed. For the selected first-critical polynomial, BOTH tiny-epsilon JS and Z have local reconstruction rates of about5 on the last grid pair. JS absolute error decreases from about9.77e-9 to2.88e-13 and Z from about2.12e-9 to5.70e-14, with a finest Z/JS ratio about.198. This fixed example demonstrates a smaller leading error; it does not observe JS order loss or establish universal critical-point order recovery by Z. The second-critical class remains a separate diagnostic. Adopted numerical method Share three candidates, linear weights(.1,.6,.3) and JS indicators. Normalize JS d/(beta+epsilon)² or Z d[1+(|beta0−beta2|/(beta+epsilon))²]. Use epsilon10⁻⁴⁰,10⁻⁶,h². Actual transport uses shared upwind face fluxes and classical RK4 at Courant.1 without state clipping/retries. qˉi=h−1∫xi−h/2xi+h/2q(x) dx,qi+1/2−=∑k=02ωkpk (p0,p1,p2)=16(2qˉi−2−7qˉi−1+11qˉi,−qˉi−1+5qˉi+2qˉi+1,2qˉi+5qˉi+1−qˉi+2) ωk=αk/∑jαj,d=(.1,.6,.3),αkJS=dk/(ϵ+βk)2,αkZ=dk[1+(τ5/(ϵ+βk))2],τ5=∣β0−β2∣ ∂tq+∂xq=0,q(x,t)=q0(x−t),dqˉidt=−qi+1/2−−qi−1/2−h qˉi(t)=sinc⁡(h)cos⁡θi+.075sinc⁡(h)sin⁡θi−.025sinc⁡(3h)sin⁡(3θi),θi=2π(xi−t),sinc⁡(z)=sin⁡πzπz References and measured quantities Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors. Verification limits and failures Order gates concern the chosen first-critical interface reconstruction; second-critical values remain diagnostic. Fixed epsilon depends on amplitude/units. Distinguish reconstruction order from PDE convergence and this FV implementation from original FD papers. No shock/Euler/MHD, arbitrary higher-critical-point, universal stability/TVD or positivity guarantee is claimed. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. name.ja: WENO臨界点：多項式セル平均と解析的周期輸送
name.en: WENO critical points: polynomial cell means and analytic periodic transport

note.ja: 解析解 局所参照はx=0を中心とする5セルの解析平均からh/2を評価する多項式です。通常・一次・二次臨界の3形、h=1/64…1/512を区別します。実際の周期輸送参照は[0,1]、速度1、T1、q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)のFourier積分セル平均で、別のGauss12点関数求積と照合します。局所多項式と輸送の初期形は異なり、点値や別PDE計算の参照ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Local references integrate polynomials over five cells centered around x=0 and evaluate at h/2. Regular, first-critical and second-critical profiles use h=1/64…1/512. The actual periodic-transport reference is the Fourier-integrated cell mean of q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx) on[0,1], speed1,T1, checked independently by Gauss12 point-function quadrature. Local polynomials differ from the evolved profile; neither point samples nor another PDE calculation are substituted for cell means.

name.ja: WENO-JS／Z：臨界点とεの固定比較：参照・検証
name.en: WENO-JS/Z: fixed critical-point and epsilon comparison — references and checks

note.ja: 実行前契約で72局所再構成・24PDE計算・36pytestを固定します。解析セル平均を独立Gauss12求積と照合し、局所の誤差・重み、輸送のL1/L2/L∞・質量・全段有限性・中間時刻と保存流束を記録します。最細格子で6通りの刻み半減差が対応する連続解誤差の10%以下か確認します。
note.en: Pre-run contract fixes72 local reconstructions,24 PDE runs and36 pytest checks. Qualify analytic means against independent Gauss12 quadrature; retain local errors/weights, transport L1/L2/Linf, mass, stage finiteness, intermediate times and shared-flux budgets. Six finest-grid half-dt differences must be at most10% of corresponding continuum errors.

name.en: Advection / sine translation

note.ja: 解析解 単位区間の周期境界、一定移流速度1。 同じ周期・速度1の正弦移流モデルです。参照一覧は振幅0.25、共通固定入力は0.2で、DG・CIP等の表現や時間も異なります。
note.en: Analytic reference Periodic unit interval; constant advection speed 1. Same periodic sine-transport model at speed one. The library amplitude is 0.25 versus 0.2 in the common fixed input; DG/CIP representations and output times also differ.

note.ja: 解析解 局所参照はx=0を中心とする5セルの解析平均からh/2を評価する多項式です。通常・一次・二次臨界の3形、h=1/64…1/512を区別します。実際の周期輸送参照は[0,1]、速度1、T1、q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)のFourier積分セル平均で、別のGauss12点関数求積と照合します。局所多項式と輸送の初期形は異なり、点値や別PDE計算の参照ではありません。 同じ一定速度の周期移流に対する追加参照ですが、cos+.1sin³のセル平均と局所臨界多項式は、従来の単一正弦・CIP表示と異なります。
note.en: Analytic reference Local references integrate polynomials over five cells centered around x=0 and evaluate at h/2. Regular, first-critical and second-critical profiles use h=1/64…1/512. The actual periodic-transport reference is the Fourier-integrated cell mean of q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx) on[0,1], speed1,T1, checked independently by Gauss12 point-function quadrature. Local polynomials differ from the evolved profile; neither point samples nor another PDE calculation are substituted for cell means. An additional constant-speed periodic-transport reference. The cos+.1sin³ cell means and local critical polynomials differ from the historical single-sine/CIP display.

note.ja: 解析解 全て無次元。u_t+u_x=0、区間[0,1)、周期境界、初期値0.4+sin(2πx)。解析解は0.4+sin(2π(x−t))。一定の正速度1、均一なアフィン区間要素。 全て無次元。u_t+u_x=0、区間[0,1)、周期境界、初期値0.4+sin(2πx)。解析解は0.4+sin(2π(x−t))。一定の正速度1、均一なアフィン区間要素。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless u_t+u_x=0 on[0,1), periodic boundary, initial0.4+sin(2pi x), analytic0.4+sin(2pi(x-t)). Constant positive speed1 and uniform affine intervals. note.ja: 同じセル平均からのWENO5再構成と実際の周期輸送で、JS重みとZ二乗重みを比較します。3種類の臨界性、3種類のε、固定格子と時間刻み半減を分けて保存します。
note.en: Compare WENO5 JS and Z power-two weights from the same cell means, then evolve actual periodic transport. Retain three regularity classes, three epsilon choices, fixed grids and separate halved-time-step diagnostics.

text.ja: Zalesak型2D回転輸送：保存・有界性・形状誤差 切り欠き付き円盤を、与えた剛体回転速度で運ぶ2次元スカラー保存則です。一次風上とminmod付きMUSCLを同じSSPRK(3,3)で比較し、一回転後の保存量・範囲・形状誤差と格子位置・初期角度の依存を確認します。 基準系列は64²・128²・256²セルで、64²の位置ずらし・初期角度診断を別に設けます。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-zalesak-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全1例を実行します。results/ は同梱の保存結果です。追試は新規の output/ へ出力し、繰り返す場合は別の新規フォルダを指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlibは保存図の任意の再描画にだけ使い、通常の科学計算には不要です。 Zalesak型2D回転輸送：保存・有界性・形状誤差 スロット付き円盤を実際の2次元有限体積法で一回転させ、donor-cellとminmod MUSCLを比較します。3格子と、半セルの中心ずらし・45度の初期向きを含む8計算で、保存・各SSP段の有界性・形状誤差とスロットの埋まりを測ります。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提・単位・境界 無次元の[0,1]²、回転中心(.5,.5)、円盤中心(.5,.75)、半径.15、スロット幅.05・上端y=.85、角速度1、一回転T=2π、64²/128²/256²セルを固定します。スロット以外はq=1、外側は0です。周期境界を使い、厳密な物体の支持は境界から離れます。速度の周期延長には接線成分の継ぎ目があり、数値拡散の裾が届く場合は境界帯の質量として記録します。 編集上の補足 与えた発散ゼロの回転速度に従うスカラー輸送で、Euler流体の発展ではありません。Zalesak型の円盤・スロットによる形状保持の問題を用いますが、ZalesakのFCTアルゴリズムそのものを実装した例ではありません。連続指示関数の点値と保存量の幾何学的セル平均を区別し、周期境界での数値的な裾も測ります。 初版の32²/64²/128²では26検査・156/158判定に合格しましたが、最細の相対L1誤差が一次風上で約1.11675（基準1.0）、MUSCLで約.6023（基準.55）となり不合格でした。元入力・受入基準・保存配列・失敗を保持し、受入基準と流束・26検査を変えずに、改訂の実行前契約で基準系列を64²/128²/256²へ細分化しました。 改訂は26検査と8計算158判定に合格し、テストと本計算は同じ120秒枠で約19.58秒でした。N256の相対L1は一次風上約.932256、MUSCL約.394271（比約.423）、全計算の質量変化の最大値は約8.90×10⁻¹⁵です。全段の記録範囲は0〜1でしたが、この範囲には初期状態も含み、有界性だけで切り欠きが正しく保たれたとは判断しません。空スロット内プローブはセル平均の区分定数場を重み付けする離散診断で、連続解の点値ではありません。参照セル平均にも混合セルによる射影基準があるため、数値平均・参照平均・その差を別に保存します。N256の超過量は一次風上約.63465、MUSCL約.36501と、なお拡散が残ります。N64ではMUSCLのプローブ超過量が一次風上を上回る場合もあり、全指標・全格子での一様な優位は主張しません。幅.05の境界帯にある質量の割合はN256で約.0178615/.000243761（一次風上/MUSCL）でした。連続の厳密場はこの帯でゼロであり、周期境界へ伸びる数値的な裾を隠していません。 採用した計算法 解析的な発散ゼロの法線面速度と、隣接セルで共有する上流数値流束を用います。区分定数donor-cellと、方向別minmod勾配による平均保存型MUSCLを、どちらもSSPRK(3,3)で進めます。4面中点の平均がセル平均に等しいことと、各面のCourant数≤1/4による凸結合を使い、実際の値.20を各FE段で確認します。セル平均のクリップ、状態floor、刻み棄却・再試行は行いません。 26単体検査と8固定計算158判定を実行前に固定します。全FE候補・SSP凸結合のmin/max、共有流束による質量収支、再構築の平均保存、3格子のL1/L∞・相対L2を保存します。円と凸多角形の交差面積から独立に作る厳密輸送のセル平均を、SciPyの鉛直切片求積と面積・一次モーメントで照合します。1/4・1/2・3/4回転の誤差と重心も検査し、回転方向や速度の誤りが一回転のreturnだけで隠れないようにします。 確認の限界と失敗条件 標準的なスロット形状を単独の0–1物体として使う周期境界の限定例です。Zalesak原著のFCTアルゴリズム、原著の格子・境界、bell/coneを加えたFiredrakeデモ全体の再現ではありません。スロット内の診断は、固定した内側長方形と区分定数セル平均との面積重み付き値です。粗格子では厳密セル平均の投影だけでも0にならないため、その参照baselineと過剰な埋まりを別々に示します。格子中心・45度方向の2診断を普遍的な等方性保証とせず、完全な形状保持や一般流れの最大値原理を主張しません。解析幾何の微小な面積丸め処理と、実際の輸送状態をクリップしないことを区別します。 text.en: Zalesak-type 2D rotation: conservation, bounds and shape error A two-dimensional scalar conservation law transports a slotted disk in a prescribed rigid-rotation velocity. Compare donor-cell upwinding and minmod MUSCL with the same SSPRK(3,3), checking full-turn mass, bounds, shape error and dependence on grid placement and initial angle. The base refinements use64²,128² and256² cells, with separate placement and initial-angle diagnostics at64². These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-zalesak-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Zalesak-type 2D rotation: conservation, bounds and shape error Rotate a slotted disk through one full turn with an actual 2D finite-volume solver, comparing donor-cell and minmod MUSCL. Eight runs combine three grids with half-cell-center and 45-degree-start probes; measure conservation, bounds at every SSP stage, shape error and slot filling. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fix the dimensionless unit square, rotation center(.5,.5), disk center(.5,.75), radius.15, slot width.05/top y=.85, angular speed1, T=2pi and64²/128²/256² cells. The body is1 and exterior/slot0. Periodic normal face velocities match; the exact compact support stays away from the boundary. The periodic extension has a tangential-velocity seam, and diffusive tails reaching its fixed-width boundary band are measured. Editorial clarification This is scalar transport in a prescribed divergence-free rotation, not Euler-fluid evolution. It uses a Zalesak-type slotted-disk shape test without claiming implementation of Zalesak’s FCT algorithm. Pointwise indicator values and geometric conserved cell means are distinguished; numerical tails near periodic boundaries are also measured. The initial32²/64²/128² series passed26 tests and156/158 gates, but its finest relative L1 was about1.11675 for donor-cell(limit1.0) and.6023 for MUSCL(limit.55), so it failed. Retain all original inputs,criteria,fields and failed decisions. A new pre-execution contract refines the base series to64²/128²/256² without changing acceptance thresholds, flux algorithms or the26 tests. Revision 2 passed all 26 tests and all 158 gates over eight runs; tests plus the fixed-input driver took about 19.58 seconds within one 120-second budget. At N=256 the relative L1 errors are about 0.932256 for donor-cell and 0.394271 for MUSCL (ratio about 0.423); the maximum absolute mass change over all runs is about 8.90e-15. Recorded stage bounds are 0 to 1, including initial states, but bounds alone do not establish accurate slot preservation. The inner empty-slot probe weights the piecewise-constant cell-mean field; it is not a point value of the continuum solution. Mixed reference cells create a projection baseline, so numerical mean, reference mean and their excess are stored separately. At N=256 the excesses are about 0.63465 and 0.36501 for donor-cell/MUSCL, showing substantial remaining diffusion. At N=64 the MUSCL slot excess can exceed donor-cell, so no uniform improvement across every metric and grid is claimed. The N=256 mass fractions in the fixed-width 0.05 boundary band are about 0.0178615/0.000243761 for donor-cell/MUSCL. The compact exact field vanishes there; these periodic-boundary tails remain visible in the diagnostics. Adopted numerical method Use analytic divergence-free normal face averages and one shared upwind flux per interface. Both piecewise-constant donor-cell and mean-preserving directional-minmod MUSCL use SSPRK(3,3). The four face-midpoint mean equals the cell mean; individual outgoing-face Courant<=1/4 gives a convex FE update. Check the actual .20 bound at every stage. No transported-state clipping/floors or rejected/retried steps are used. ∂tq+∂x(uq)+∂y(vq)=0,(u,v)=(−(y−yc),x−xc),T=2π q(x,t)=q0 ⁣(c+R−t(x−c)),qˉij(t)=h−2∫Cijq(x,t) dx dy si=minmod⁡(qi−qi−1,qi+1−qi),qi±=qˉi±12si,qˉij=14(qL+qR+qD+qU) F^i+1/2,j=uj+qR,ij+uj−qL,i+1,j,EΔt(q)ij=qij−Δth(ΔxF^+ΔyG^)ij q(1)=EΔt(qn),q(2)=34qn+14EΔt(q(1)),qn+1=13qn+23EΔt(q(2)) Δthmax⁡(∣u∣,∣v∣)≤14,Dh ⁣⋅u=0⟹0≤EΔt(qˉ)≤1 if all four face states lie in [0,1] References and measured quantities Freeze26 unit checks and158 gates across eight fixed runs before execution. Retain min/max of every FE candidate/SSP convex mean, shared-flux mass budgets, reconstruction mean preservation and three-grid L1/Linf/relative-L2 errors. Independent circle/convex-polygon intersection means are qualified against SciPy vertical-slice quadrature, total area and first moments. Also check quarter/half/three-quarter-turn errors and centroids so a wrong direction or speed cannot hide behind a full-turn return. Verification limits and failures This is an isolated0–1 standard slotted body with periodic boundaries. It does not implement Zalesak FCT, reproduce the original paper’s grid/boundaries or the entire Firedrake bell/cone/background demonstration. The inner-slot diagnostic area-weights piecewise-constant means over a fixed rectangle. Coarse exact cell projection can already give a nonzero baseline, which is reported separately from excess numerical filling. Two center/orientation probes do not establish universal isotropy, perfect shape retention or a maximum principle for arbitrary flows. Tiny geometric-area roundoff handling is distinguished from the absence of transported-state clipping. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded. Pointwise indicator values and geometric conserved cell means are distinguished; numerical tails near periodic boundaries are also measured.

The four face-midpoint mean equals the cell mean; individual outgoing-face Courant<=1/4 gives a convex FE update. Check the actual .20 bound at every stage. No transported-state clipping/floors or rejected/retried steps are used.

name.en: Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means

note.ja: 解析解 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。 円盤とスロットの定義を固定し、保存した初期・帰還時のセル平均と比較します。指示関数の点値や別実装PDEの細格子解を参照と混同しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Unit-square two-dimensional scalar transport with prescribed velocity (0.5-y,x-0.5), angular speed 1 and period2*pi. The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics. Fix the disk and slot geometry and compare stored initial/returned cell means. Distinguish indicator point samples and a finer PDE calculation from this geometric reference.

note.ja: 解析解 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。 円盤とスロットの定義を固定し、保存した初期・帰還時のセル平均と比較します。指示関数の点値や別実装PDEの細格子解を参照と混同しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Unit-square two-dimensional scalar transport with prescribed velocity (0.5-y,x-0.5), angular speed 1 and period2*pi. The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics. Fix the disk and slot geometry and compare stored initial/returned cell means. Distinguish indicator point samples and a finer PDE calculation from this geometric reference.

text.ja: ウェーブレット ウェーブレットは位置とスケールの両方で関数の構造を表す基底です。Fourier成分の全域的な周波数表示と比べ、局所的な変化を複数の解像度で読めます。 対象と代表式 正規直交な離散ウェーブレット系では、粗いscaling係数cとdetail係数dで関数を展開します。ψⱼ,ₖ=2ʲ/²ψ(2ʲx−k)はL2ノルムを保つ規格化です。下式のエネルギー等式は、完全な正規直交系と整合する境界処理を前提とします。 f=∑kcJ,kϕJ,k+∑j≥J∑kdj,kψj,k,∥f∥22=∑k∣cJ,k∣2+∑j≥J,k∣dj,k∣2. 計算の流れ Mallatの多重解像度構成ではlow-pass/high-passフィルターを通して間引き、粗い係数へ再帰します。逆変換は対応する再構成フィルターを使います。消失モーメントが多い基底は滑らかな成分を少ないdetailで表しやすい一方、台の幅や境界の扱いも変わります。 適用条件と落とし穴 有限区間では周期延長・対称延長・専用境界基底などを指定します。係数の閾値処理は誤差と情報損失を伴い、保存則や衝撃波の正値性を自動では保ちません。連続変換、離散変換、biorthogonal系のエネルギー関係を混同しません。 検証するときに見る量 順逆変換の再構成誤差、正規直交系のエネルギー保存、低次多項式に対する消失モーメントを確認します。閾値を変えたときの保持係数数とL2/最大誤差、境界近くの歪みを報告します。 公開範囲と関連項目 既存の教育用コードと版を固定した検証記録への案内です。今回の本文・翻訳の追加でコードや過去の測定結果を変更せず、原論文全体の再現を主張しません。 ウェーブレット 一次文献・関連資料と確認範囲 原著、後続の変種、著者による著書、概説、公式資料を区別して参照します。DOI・書誌の確認と原文の該当箇所の閲覧を区別し、論文全体の監査や数値再現を行ったという意味ではありません。確認範囲の注記は引用ごとに示します。 S.G. Mallat (1989). A theory for multiresolution signal decomposition: the wavelet representation. IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 研究論文・提案または関連する定式化 · 原文の該当箇所を参照 · 確認した資料 抄録・序論と多重解像度／フィルターバンクの構成を参照。証明全体の監査は未実施です。 引用と利用条件
text.en: Wavelets Wavelets resolve structure in both location and scale. Compared with global Fourier modes, they describe localized changes through a hierarchy of resolutions. Problem and representative equations An orthonormal discrete wavelet system expands a function in coarse scaling coefficients c and detail coefficients d. The factor 2ʲ/² preserves the L2 norm of ψⱼ,ₖ. The stated energy identity assumes a complete orthonormal system and compatible boundary treatment. f=∑kcJ,kϕJ,k+∑j≥J∑kdj,kψj,k,∥f∥22=∑k∣cJ,k∣2+∑j≥J,k∣dj,k∣2. Algorithm Mallat’s multiresolution algorithm filters and downsamples into coarse and detail coefficients, then recurses on the coarse part. Matched synthesis filters reconstruct the signal. More vanishing moments can sparsify smooth components but affect support width and boundary handling. Conditions and pitfalls On finite intervals specify periodic/symmetric extensions or boundary wavelets. Coefficient thresholding loses information and does not automatically preserve conservation laws or shock positivity. Distinguish continuous transforms, orthonormal discrete transforms and biorthogonal energy relations. What to check Check reconstruction, Parseval energy and vanishing moments on low-degree polynomials. Vary thresholds and report retained coefficients, L2/maximum errors and boundary artifacts. Publication scope and related entries Links lead to existing educational code and dated verification records. This reading/translation update changes no scientific code or historical measurements and does not claim reproduction of an entire paper. Wavelets Primary publications, supporting sources and review scope Distinguish original research, later variants, author monographs, pedagogical articles and official references. Bibliographic verification differs from consulting selected passages; neither implies a full-paper audit or numerical reproduction. Access-depth notes accompany each source. S.G. Mallat (1989). A theory for multiresolution signal decomposition: the wavelet representation. text.ja: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS / FOUNDATIONS 分野を超えて使う 数値計算の基礎 誤差・安定性・散逸と分散・境界条件・分割法・幾何積分 全19章 · 19枚の図 · 38問の確認問題と解答 · 2026年11月24日版 PDFをダウンロード（A4・書籍版）旧PDF（2026-11-24版）小さな計算例のコードZIP共通の原稿JSON はじめに この教材は、特定の分野へ進む前に使える誤差・安定性・境界条件・時間積分の共通基礎です。微分積分と行列の初歩を前提にし、用いる記号は各章でも説明します。 まず直観を読み、定義と前提を確認し、手で追える計算例からコード・図へ進んでください。確認問題には短い解答を付けています。Webは解答を開いて読み、PDFでは同じ解答をそのまま確認できます。 少数の一次元問題と小さな行列を繰り返し使います。図の数が独立した物理問題の数という意味ではありません。新しい実物質計算、大規模走査、一般的な多次元ソルバーの性能評価は含めていません。 最初の風上法の粗い格子系列は設定した観測次数へ届きませんでした。入力・失敗結果を保存し、基準を変えずに細かい系列へ改訂しています。ここからも、観測次数と理論の関係を学べます。 想定読者：微分・積分と行列の初歩を学んだ初学者。特定の物理・工学分野の知識は前提にしない。 コード断片は配布ZIPのディレクトリで実行します。第19章のコマンドはシェルに入力します。 I 誤差を測り、結果を読む 近似と誤差の出どころ 絶対・相対誤差、丸め・打切り・反復誤差を区別し、桁数と精度を取り違えない。 誤差ノルム L1・L2・L∞ 連続ノルムと格子幅で重み付けした離散ノルムを使い分け、局所的な大誤差も見つける。 残差・条件数・後退誤差 問題の敏感さと解法の安定性を分け、小さい残差だけでは正確な解を保証しないと理解する。 整合性・打切り誤差・収束次数 局所誤差と大域誤差を区別し、Taylor展開と格子・時間刻みの細分化で精度を調べる。 II 安定性と数値不安定を理解する 安定性・収束とLaxの同値定理 適切に設定された線形初期値問題と整合する線形近似を対象に、決めたノルムでの一様な安定性と収束の関係を読む。 絶対安定性と安定領域 試験方程式 y'=λy と増幅関数 R(λΔt) を使い、時間刻みと増幅・減衰を結び付ける。 A安定性・L安定性・硬い問題 左半平面での安定性と非常に硬いモードの減衰を分け、安定でも時間精度は別と理解する。 von NeumannのFourier安定性解析 定係数・一様格子・周期または無限領域を基本として、波数ごとの増幅率を調べる。 CFL条件と依存領域 情報の伝わる速さと差分の届く範囲を結び付け、必要条件と十分条件を区別する。 数値散逸：振幅・ノルム・エネルギー 増幅率の絶対値から人工的な振幅減衰を読み、物理的な拡散・散逸と区別する。人工粘性の役割も学ぶ。 数値分散：位相速度・群速度・波形 増幅率の偏角から位相・伝播速度の誤差を読み、振幅が保たれても波形が崩れる理由を理解する。物理分散と区別する。 数値不安定と振動・発散の診断 誤差の増幅・発散を、安定だが振動的な解や物理的な不安定成長と区別し、原因を切り分ける。 III 初期条件・境界条件を扱う 初期条件とDirichlet・Neumann・Robin条件 値を与える、外向き法線微分を与える、両者を組み合わせる、という境界条件の意味を読む。 境界条件を離散化へ落とす 境界点・半格子・ゴースト点と法線の向きを図で確認し、境界だけの低次誤差を見つける。 適切性・純Neumannの互換条件と一意性 純Neumann問題の定数分の不定性と積分互換条件、平均値固定、境界を含む安定性を学ぶ。 IV 解法を組み合わせ、確かめる 線の方法と空間・時間誤差の切り分け 空間を離散化したODEと完全離散系を区別し、時間だけ・空間だけを変える比較を設計する。 Lie-Trotter分割とStrang分割 部分問題を順に解く合成と非可換性を学び、滑らかな条件での1次・2次、境界での次数低下を区別する。 シンプレクティック積分と長時間の振る舞い 調和振動子からHamilton系の位相空間を導入し、幾何構造を保つ時間積分とエネルギーの厳密保存を区別する。 小さな問題で検証する共通手順 解析解・製造解、誤差ノルム、収束、残差、保存量・エネルギー、境界誤差を一枚の手順にまとめる。 よく使う記号 h, Δx格子幅。節点かセル中心かも記す。Δt, n, T時間刻み、ステップ番号、比較する終時刻。u, U, e基準となる連続解、数値解、両者の差。λ, z, R(z)線形の増幅・減衰率、λΔt、時間積分の安定性関数。k, θ, G(θ)連続波数、無次元の格子波数kh、差分のFourier増幅率。κ(A)行列の条件数。熱の拡散係数κとは文脈を区別する。∂n, g外向き法線微分と境界の指定データ。q, p, H位置、運動量、Hamiltonian。一般の誤差次数pとは文脈を区別する。 参考資料と再現手順 Per-Olof Persson, Finite Difference Methods for PDEs 著者講義資料の差分・整合性・有限時間の一様安定性・Lax同値定理・熱の線の方法の関連箇所を参照。原著論文そのものや全文監査とは区別。 T. A. Driscoll and R. J. Braun, Fundamentals of Numerical Computation: Stiffness 著者による教科書の半離散拡散、硬さ、線形化に関する該当箇所を参照。 Ernst Hairer, Lecture 2: Symplectic integrators (2010) 著者講義ノートPDF1-3ページの定義、シンプレクティックEuler、Störmer-Verlet、合成・分離形の箇所を参照。長時間の全定理や一般非線形問題を監査・再現したという意味ではない。 R. R. Rosales, Notes: von Neumann Stability Analysis (2022) 既存アトラスの関連資料として案内。既存の閲覧記録と区別し、この教材作成時の原文再読を主張しない。 教材の実行・制作範囲 Fixed small educational exercises. Intentional unstable/low-order controls and successful accurate-method checks have distinct meanings. Existing atlas scientific releases and their criteria are unchanged. 25単体テスト・34固定判定・15CSVをZIPの verify_release.py で再実行できます。意図的な不安定例は異常を検出する対照例です。
text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS / FOUNDATIONS Numerical Foundations Across Disciplines Error, stability, dissipation and dispersion, boundary conditions, splitting, and geometric integration 19 chapters · 19 figures · 38 review questions with answers · 24 November 2026 Download the book PDF (US Letter)Previous PDF (24 November 2026)Small-example code ZIPShared manuscript JSON Introduction This course introduces error, stability, boundary conditions, and time integration before you move into a particular application. It assumes elementary calculus and matrices, and explains the notation again within each chapter. Start with the intuition, check the definitions and assumptions, and then work through the small calculations, code, and figures. Each review question has a short answer. On the Web, expand the answers to read them; the PDF displays those same answers in full. We reuse a small set of one-dimensional problems and small matrices. The number of figures is not the number of independent physical validation problems. The course does not include new real-material calculations, large parameter sweeps, or performance studies of general multidimensional solvers. The first coarse-grid sequence for the upwind method did not reach the prescribed observed order. We preserved its input and failed results and refined the grid sequence without changing the acceptance criterion. This also illustrates the relationship between observed and theoretical order. Audience: Beginners who have studied elementary differentiation, integration, and matrices. No background in a particular branch of physics or engineering is assumed. Run code snippets from the extracted ZIP directory. Enter the Chapter 19 commands in a shell rather than Python. I Measuring error and reading results Approximation and the sources of error Distinguish absolute and relative error, roundoff, truncation, and iteration error; do not confuse displayed digits with accuracy. Error norms: L1, L2, and L∞ Use continuous norms and grid-weighted discrete norms appropriately, and detect large localized errors. Residuals, conditioning, and backward error Separate sensitivity of the problem from stability of the algorithm, and understand why a small residual alone does not guarantee an accurate solution. Consistency, truncation error, and convergence order Distinguish local and global error, and investigate accuracy using Taylor expansions and refinement in space and time. II Understanding stability and numerical instability Stability, convergence, and the Lax equivalence theorem For a well-posed linear initial-value problem and a consistent linear approximation, relate uniform stability to convergence in a specified norm. Absolute stability and stability regions Use the test equation y′=λy and amplification function R(λΔt) to relate the time step to growth and decay. A-stability, L-stability, and stiff problems Separate stability over the left half-plane from damping of very stiff modes; accuracy remains a separate question. von Neumann Fourier stability analysis Examine amplification by wavenumber, primarily for constant coefficients on a uniform grid with periodic or infinite domains. CFL conditions and domains of dependence Connect information speed to the reach of a stencil, and distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions. Numerical dissipation: amplitude, norms, and energy Read artificial amplitude decay from the magnitude of the amplification factor, distinguish it from physical diffusion and dissipation, and understand the role of artificial viscosity. Numerical dispersion: phase speed, group speed, and waveforms Use the argument of amplification to examine phase and propagation-speed error, understand waveform distortion without amplitude loss, and distinguish physical dispersion. Diagnosing numerical instability, oscillation, and divergence Distinguish error amplification and divergence from stable oscillations and physical instability, and isolate their causes. III Working with initial and boundary conditions Initial conditions and Dirichlet, Neumann, and Robin boundaries Understand prescribed values, outward normal derivatives, and linear combinations of the two. Turning boundary conditions into discrete equations Use boundary nodes, half cells, ghost points, and normal directions to identify errors caused by low-order boundary closures. Well-posedness, pure-Neumann compatibility, and uniqueness Understand the arbitrary constant, integral compatibility, mean-value gauge, and boundary-inclusive stability of a pure-Neumann problem. IV Combining methods and checking results The method of lines: separating space and time error Distinguish the spatially discrete ODE from the fully discrete system, and design comparisons that vary time or space separately. Lie-Trotter and Strang splitting Understand composition of subproblems and noncommutativity; distinguish first and second order under smooth conditions from boundary-induced order reduction. Symplectic integration and long-time behavior Introduce Hamiltonian phase space through the harmonic oscillator, and distinguish preservation of geometric structure from exact energy conservation. A common verification procedure using small problems Combine analytic and manufactured solutions, error norms, convergence, residuals, conserved quantities, energy budgets, and boundary error into one procedure. Frequently used notation h, ΔxGrid spacing. Also state whether the unknowns are located at nodes or cell centers.Δt, n, TTime step, step number, and the final time used for comparison.u, U, eReference continuous solution, numerical solution, and their difference.λ, z, R(z)Linear growth or decay rate, the product λΔt, and the stability function of a time integrator.k, θ, G(θ)Continuous wavenumber, dimensionless grid wavenumber kh, and the Fourier amplification factor of a discretization.κ(A)Matrix condition number. Distinguish it from a thermal diffusivity also denoted by κ.∂n, gOutward normal derivative and prescribed boundary data.q, p, HPosition, momentum, and Hamiltonian. Distinguish the momentum p from an error order also denoted by p. Using the examples Use Python 3.12 and only its standard library for the calculations. After extracting the shared code ZIP, run python verify_release.py from its directory. It reruns 25 calculation tests, 2 comparison tests, 34 fixed acceptance checks, and the comparison of 15 saved CSV files. No NumPy, network connection, randomness, or external solver is required. To inspect a fresh run, use python lab.py --input inputs.json --output my-results with a new or empty my-results directory. Read the individual criteria in my-results/result.json and compare its CSV files with the figures. The archive README and some provenance records are in Japanese; the English chapters and these instructions explain how to run and interpret the same unchanged code. The deliberately cancellation-sensitive derivative.csv is checked against an independent 80-digit Decimal Taylor reference and ULP-derived bounds, including checks of the floating-point sine and cosine assumptions at the fixed arguments. The other 14 CSV files retain relative tolerance 1e -9 and absolute tolerance 1e -10. This reproduction policy does not relax the original 34 scientific acceptance criteria. Regenerating plots additionally requires ReportLab 4.4.9 and Poppler; plot-byte equality is not required. References and reproduction Per-Olof Persson, Finite Difference Methods for PDEs Relevant sections of the author's lecture notes were consulted for finite differences, consistency, uniform finite-time stability, the Lax equivalence theorem, and the method of lines for heat diffusion. This is distinct from reading the original research paper or auditing the complete notes. T. A. Driscoll and R. J. Braun, Fundamentals of Numerical Computation: Stiffness The relevant sections of the authors' textbook were consulted for semidiscrete diffusion, stiffness, and linearization. Ernst Hairer, Lecture 2: Symplectic integrators (2010) Pages 1-3 of the author's lecture-note PDF were consulted for the definition, symplectic Euler, Störmer-Verlet, composition, and separable systems. This does not claim an audit or reproduction of all long-time theorems or general nonlinear problems. R. R. Rosales, Notes: von Neumann Stability Analysis (2022) Provided as related reading already listed in the atlas. Earlier reading records are separate; we do not claim to have reread the original during preparation of this course. Scope of the computations and production Fixed small educational exercises. Intentional unstable/low-order controls and successful accurate-method checks have distinct meanings. Existing atlas scientific releases and their criteria are unchanged.

text.ja: 第1章 / 全19章 近似と誤差の出どころ 到達目標：絶対・相対誤差、丸め・打切り・反復誤差を区別し、桁数と精度を取り違えない。 計算機が返す桁数は、そのまま正しい桁数ではない。まず「何を近似しているか」と「どの段階で誤差が入るか」を分けよう。関数を格子で近似する誤差と、有限の桁で四則演算する誤差は、別の原因から生じる。 例えば微分を差分で置き換えると、幅を小さくするほど近似はよくなるように見える。しかし近い数どうしの差を取ると有効な桁を失う。小さすぎる幅では、丸め誤差を幅で割って増幅する。 絶対誤差と相対誤差 基準となる値をu、計算値をUとすれば、絶対誤差は両者の距離である。相対誤差は基準値の大きさで割るが、基準値がゼロ付近では不安定な指標になる。その場合は問題の代表スケールで割った誤差も併記する。 三つの誤差を混ぜない 離散化の打切り誤差、演算の丸め誤差、反復計算を途中で止める誤差を区別する。さらに、物理モデルや入力データ自体の不確かさは別の話である。反復残差だけを小さくしても、粗い格子による誤差は消えない。 幅を半分にすると何が起こるか sin xの中心差分は、滑らかな範囲では打切り誤差が幅の2乗で小さくなる。一方で丸めの寄与はおおよそ機械精度を幅で割った大きさになる。この二つの競合が、誤差曲線の底を作る。 小さな計算例 x=1でcos 1を基準にする。まずh=0.2,0.1,0.05,0.025で近似次数を確認し、その後10の負のべきで幅を小さくする。 「最小のh」を選ぶのではなく、誤差の曲線がどこで減少から増加へ転じるかを読む。この実験で見える最適幅は、関数や精度を変えれば変わる。 from math import sin, cos x = 1.0 for k in range(1, 17): h = 10.0**(-k) d = (sin(x+h)-sin(x-h))/(2*h) print(h, abs(d-cos(x))) 保存データでは、十分大きい幅の系列で約2次となり、極端に小さい幅では誤差が再び増える。最良の幅や末尾の丸めは実行環境によって少し変わる。 図1：中心差分の絶対誤差。横軸も縦軸も対数。左端の小さい幅では丸めが支配し、打切り誤差だけの予想から外れる。 保存データ：derivative.csv 配布ZIPを展開し python lab.py --input inputs.json --output my-results を実行する。既存の空でない出力先は使わない。該当CSVと保存済みの図を照合する。 コード・入力・保存CSV・テストを取得 / 図のPNG / 図のPDF 確認問題と解答 問1 相対誤差を、真値が0の点でそのまま計算してよいか。 解答を開く 割れない。絶対誤差や、問題全体の非ゼロの代表スケールで規格化した誤差を使う。 問2 幅を小さくして誤差が増えたら、差分公式の次数が間違っているのか。 解答を開く そうとは限らない。打切り誤差を調べる範囲から丸め誤差の範囲へ移った可能性がある。 つまずきやすい点 表示桁数を正確な桁数と呼ばない。 一つの幅だけで収束次数を決めない。 この章の要点 誤差の原因を分ける。 小さな刻みが常によいとは限らない。 アトラスで先を読む A安定性、L安定性、誤差ノルム
text.en: Chapter 1 / 19 Approximation and the sources of error Learning goal: Distinguish absolute and relative error, roundoff, truncation, and iteration error; do not confuse displayed digits with accuracy. The number of digits returned by a computer is not the number of correct digits. First separate what is being approximated from the stage at which error enters. Approximating a function on a grid and performing arithmetic with finitely many digits introduce error for different reasons. Replacing a derivative with a difference suggests that a smaller spacing should improve the approximation. However, subtracting nearby numbers loses significant digits. With very small spacing, division by that spacing amplifies roundoff. Absolute and relative error Let u be the reference value and U the computed value. Absolute error measures their distance. Relative error divides this distance by the magnitude of the reference value, but becomes a poor indicator near a zero reference. In that case, also report an error normalized by a representative problem scale. Keep three sources of error separate Distinguish truncation error from discretization, roundoff from arithmetic, and the error caused by stopping an iteration. Uncertainty in the physical model or input data is another issue. Reducing an iterative residual alone does not remove coarse-grid error. What happens when the spacing is halved? For a smooth sine function, the truncation error of the centered difference decreases quadratically with the spacing. The roundoff contribution is roughly machine precision divided by the spacing. Their competition produces the bottom of the error curve. A small worked example At x=1, use cos 1 as the reference. First check the order with h=0.2,0.1,0.05,0.025, and then reduce the spacing through negative powers of 10. Instead of choosing the smallest h, identify where the error curve changes from decreasing to increasing. The best spacing observed here changes with the function and the arithmetic precision. from math import sin, cos x = 1.0 for k in range(1, 17): h = 10.0**(-k) d = (sin(x+h)-sin(x-h))/(2*h) print(h, abs(d-cos(x))) The saved data approach second order for the sufficiently large-spacing sequence, while the error grows again at extremely small spacings. The best spacing and the final roundoff digits can vary slightly between environments. Figure 1: Absolute error of the centered difference, with logarithmic axes. Roundoff dominates at the small-spacing left end, where the curve departs from a truncation-only prediction. Saved data: derivative.csv Extract the code ZIP and run python lab.py --input inputs.json --output my-results. Use a new or empty output directory. Compare the relevant CSV with the saved figure. Get code, inputs, saved CSVs, and tests / Figure PNG / Figure PDF Review questions and answers Question 1: Can relative error be evaluated directly where the true value is 0? Show answer No: division by zero is undefined. Use absolute error or normalize by a nonzero representative scale for the problem. Question 2: If error grows as the spacing decreases, must the stated order of the difference formula be wrong? Show answer No. The calculation may have moved from a truncation-dominated range into a roundoff-dominated range. Common pitfalls Do not call displayed digits correct digits. Do not infer convergence order from one spacing. Key points Separate the sources of error. A smaller step is not always better. Continue in the atlas A-stability, L-stability, and error norms

title.ja: 誤差ノルム L1・L2・L∞
title.en: Error norms: L1, L2, and L∞

ja.title: 配列には格子の重みを付ける

keywords: Error norms: L1, L2, and L∞

text.ja: 第2章 / 全19章 誤差ノルム L1・L2・L∞ 到達目標：連続ノルムと格子幅で重み付けした離散ノルムを使い分け、局所的な大誤差も見つける。 場の誤差は場所ごとに違う。平均的にはよくても、一点だけ大きく外れている場合がある。そこで誤差の分布を、一つの大きさへまとめる約束が必要になる。これがノルムである。 L1は広がりを含む絶対量、L2は二乗を通した量、L∞は最も大きい誤差を見る。同じ誤差でも、どの問いを優先するかで評価は変わる。 連続的な定義 領域Ω上の誤差e(x)を考える。L∞では厳密には本質的上限を使う。滑らかな例では最大値と考えてよい。ノルムの単位も異なるため、数値の大小だけで優劣を決めない。 配列には格子の重みを付ける 一様なセル平均なら重みはセル幅hである。節点値の台形求積では、左右の端点だけ重みがh/2になる。非一様格子では各セル体積や求積重みを使う。比較する参照値も、点値かセル平均かを揃える。 RMSとの違い 一様なNセルで長さL=Nhなら、二乗平均平方根RMSと離散L2は√Lの係数だけ異なる。長さ1では偶然一致するが、一般の領域で同じ定義だと思ってはいけない。 小さな計算例 長さ1をN個のセルに分け、一つのセルだけ誤差を1、他を0にする。これは幅がh、高さが1の誤差を表す。 Nを増やすとL1=h、L2=√hは小さくなるが、最大誤差は1のままである。「L2が収束した」だけでは最大誤差まで消えたとは言えない。 from math import sqrt N = 64 h = 1.0/N e = [0.0]*N e[N//2] = 1.0 print(h*sum(abs(x) for x in e)) print(sqrt(h*sum(x*x for x in e))) print(max(abs(x) for x in e)) N=64ではL1=1/64、L2=1/8、L∞=1。格子数によって配列の長さが変わる比較では、重みのない単純和をPDEのL1/L2と取り違えない。 図2：幅1/Nのセル一つだけに高さ1の誤差がある例。平均的な誤差と最大誤差で、収束の見え方が異なる。 保存データ：norms.csv 配布ZIPを展開し python lab.py --input inputs.json --output my-results を実行する。既存の空でない出力先は使わない。該当CSVと保存済みの図を照合する。 コード・入力・保存CSV・テストを取得 / 図のPNG / 図のPDF 確認問題と解答 問1 重みを付けない配列の二乗和は、格子を細かくしても同じ連続量を近似するか。 解答を開く 一般にはしない。一様格子ではhを掛けてから平方根を取る必要がある。 問2 L∞も併記する利点は何か。 解答を開く 平均では見逃す局所的な大誤差を検出できる。ただし弱い解や不連続点を含む問題では期待する収束を別に考える。 つまずきやすい点 節点とセル平均を比較しない。 相対ノルムの分母がゼロに近くないか確かめる。 この章の要点 重みと参照表現を揃える。 複数のノルムで誤差の形を見る。 アトラスで先を読む A安定性、L安定性、誤差ノルム
text.en: Chapter 2 / 19 Error norms: L1, L2, and L∞ Learning goal: Use continuous norms and grid-weighted discrete norms appropriately, and detect large localized errors. The error in a field varies from place to place. An approximation can be good on average and still have a large error at one point. A norm specifies how to summarize the error distribution as one magnitude. L1 measures integrated absolute error, L2 uses squared error, and L∞ measures the largest error. The same error distribution can receive different assessments depending on which question matters. Continuous definitions Consider an error e(x) on a domain Ω. Strictly, L∞ uses the essential supremum; for the smooth examples here, it can be read as the maximum. The norms can also have different units, so their numerical magnitudes alone do not rank their usefulness. Weight arrays by the grid For uniform cell averages, the weight is the cell width h. For trapezoidal quadrature of nodal values, the two endpoint weights are h/2. On nonuniform grids, use cell volumes or quadrature weights. Match the reference representation too: point values and cell averages differ. The distinction from RMS For N uniform cells over a length L=Nh, the discrete L2 norm differs from the root mean square, RMS, by a factor √L. They happen to coincide when L=1, but are not the same definition on a general domain. A small worked example Divide a unit interval into N cells and set the error to 1 in one cell and 0 elsewhere. This represents an error of height 1 and width h. As N increases, L1=h and L2=√h decrease, but the maximum error stays at 1. Convergence in L2 alone does not show that the maximum error vanishes. from math import sqrt N = 64 h = 1.0/N e = [0.0]*N e[N//2] = 1.0 print(h*sum(abs(x) for x in e)) print(sqrt(h*sum(x*x for x in e))) print(max(abs(x) for x in e)) For N=64, L1=1/64, L2=1/8, and L∞=1. When the array length changes with grid resolution, do not confuse an unweighted array sum with a PDE L1 or L2 norm. Figure 2: An error of height 1 in a single cell of width 1/N. Average and maximum error show different convergence behavior. Saved data: norms.csv Extract the code ZIP and run python lab.py --input inputs.json --output my-results. Use a new or empty output directory. Compare the relevant CSV with the saved figure. Get code, inputs, saved CSVs, and tests / Figure PNG / Figure PDF Review questions and answers Question 1: Does an unweighted sum of squared array entries approximate the same continuous quantity as the grid is refined? Show answer Generally no. On a uniform grid, multiply the sum by h before taking the square root. Question 2: Why also report L∞? Show answer It detects large local errors that an average can miss. For weak solutions or problems with discontinuities, assess the expected kind of convergence separately. Common pitfalls Do not compare nodal values directly with cell averages. Check that the denominator in a relative norm is not near zero. Key points Match the weights and reference representation. Use several norms to examine the shape of the error.
