note.en: A one-dimensional form with constant isothermal sound speed cₛ. Follow the density-jump reference solution.

name.ja: 2次元の回転移流
name.en: Two-dimensional rotational advection

note.ja: 与えた剛体回転速度でスカラーを運ぶ2次元保存則。連続場は一回転で戻り、保存量・有界性と切り欠きの形状誤差を調べます。
note.en: A two-dimensional scalar conservation law in a prescribed rigid rotation. The continuum field returns after one turn, enabling mass, bounds and slotted-shape error checks.

name.ja: 特殊相対論的流体（SRHD）
name.en: Special-relativistic hydrodynamics (SRHD)

note.ja: c=1、平坦なCartesian時空の理想流体。γ則EOSと原始変数回復を使う穏やかな対称二衝撃波の固定例を追加。一般三波Riemann解、極端なLorentz因子、一般相対論を検証したとはしません。
note.en: Ideal fluid in flat Cartesian spacetime,c=1. Add a mild fixed symmetric two-shock example with gamma-law EOS and primitive recovery; no general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or GR claim.

name.ja: 特殊相対論的理想MHD（SRMHD）
name.en: Special-relativistic ideal MHD (SRMHD)

note.ja: c=4π=1、平坦時空・理想電気伝導・γ則EOSです。bμは流体静止系磁場4ベクトル。全磁気応力と誘導を含む7保存量を1Dで進め、原始変数は完全なRMHDのZ根で復元します。GRMHDとは区別します。
note.en: Flat spacetime,ideal conductivity,gamma-law EOS,c=4pi=1; b^mu is the comoving magnetic four-vector. The1D solver evolves seven conserved variables with full magnetic stress and induction, using coupled RMHD Z recovery. Distinguish it from GRMHD.

name.ja: Fisher–KPP侵入前線
name.en: Fisher–KPP invasion front

note.ja: 拡散と増殖を結ぶ侵入前線。表示は規格化した代表形で、波の速度と境界条件は解説先へ。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Fisher–KPP：特殊波速の厳密前線
note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Fisher–KPP: a special-speed exact front

name.ja: Keller–Segel走化性
name.en: Keller–Segel chemotaxis

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Keller–Segel：連成流束の製造解
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Keller–Segel: a manufactured coupled-flux solution

name.ja: 外力・移流付きKeller–Segel製造問題

note.ja: 著者作成の強制2場モデルです。原著の全生物モデル、ピーク形成、真のblow-upやその抑制を実証しません。負値をクリップして正値性を装いません。
note.en: This authored forced two-field model does not reproduce the full original biological model or demonstrate aggregation, true blow-up or suppression. No clipping is used to manufacture positivity.

note.en: Use centered second-order differences and SSPRK3 with exact Dirichlet values at every stage. Compare time errors to an independent reference for the same95-unknown semidiscreteODE.

name.ja: Keller–Segel：連成流束の製造解

caption.en: Use smooth exact2D fields to test cross fluxes, stage timing and mass ledgers. This authored forced two-field model does not reproduce the full original biological model or demonstrate aggregation, true blow-up or suppression. No clipping is used to manufacture positivity.

note.ja: セル平均の中心面流束とSSPRK3を使い、n/c/強制項を同じ段に揃えます。展開した三角多項式の積分を、別の未展開積分とスカラー面ループ参照で確認します。
note.en: Use cell-average centered face fluxes and SSPRK3 with n,c and forcing at the same stage. Check expanded trigonometric integrals against independent unexpanded integrals and scalar face-loop references.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
note.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

name.ja: 等エントロピー渦：低Mach比較に用いるEuler解析場
name.en: Isentropic vortex: analytic Euler field for low-Mach comparisons

note.ja: 解析解 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。 同じ等エントロピー移動渦族の解析場です。保存量をGauss求積してから圧力・速度を算出し、周期の継ぎ目に残るGaussianの裾と求積誤差を明記します。
note.en: Analytic reference The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1. Analytic field for the same translating isentropic-vortex family. Pressure and velocity are evaluated after Gauss integration of conserved variables; finite-periodic Gaussian tails and quadrature error remain explicit.

Retain min/max of every FE candidate/SSP convex mean, shared-flux mass budgets, reconstruction mean preservation and three-grid L1/Linf/relative-L2 errors. Independent circle/convex-polygon intersection means are qualified against SciPy vertical-slice quadrature, total area and first moments. Also check quarter/half/three-quarter-turn errors and centroids so a wrong direction or speed cannot hide behind a full-turn return.

name.ja: Zalesak型の切り欠き円盤：剛体回転と幾何学的セル平均
name.en: Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means

note.ja: 解析解 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。 円盤とスロットの定義を固定し、保存した初期・帰還時のセル平均と比較します。指示関数の点値や別実装PDEの細格子解を参照と混同しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Unit-square two-dimensional scalar transport with prescribed velocity (0.5-y,x-0.5), angular speed 1 and period2*pi. The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics. Fix the disk and slot geometry and compare stored initial/returned cell means. Distinguish indicator point samples and a finer PDE calculation from this geometric reference.

name.ja: 相対論的対称衝突：特殊化した二衝撃波Taub参照
name.en: Relativistic symmetric collision: specialized two-shock Taub reference

note.ja: 半解析解 c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。 独自の穏やかな対称入力で、接触面は同じ静止状態へ退化します。一般三波Riemann解、高Lorentz因子、原著の数値入力は検証しません。Eは静止質量を含み、保存量の厳密セル平均と比較します。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver. Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means.

note.ja: 解析解 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。 原著の厳密解族を独立な低次法で計算し、ECHO法や原著誤差表は再現しません。一般RMHD衝撃波、極端な磁化・Lorentz因子、GR、抵抗MHD、多次元磁場発散制御は対象外。図は実際の1D時空間場です。
note.en: Analytic reference Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval. Use the original exact family with an independent lower-order operator; no ECHO-algorithm or error-table reproduction. Generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/Lorentz factors,GR,resistive MHD and multidimensional divergence control are outside scope. Figures show actual1D x–t fields.

note.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
note.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

name.ja: 等エントロピー渦：低Mach比較に用いるEuler解析場
name.en: Isentropic vortex: analytic Euler field for low-Mach comparisons

note.ja: 解析解 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。 同じ等エントロピー移動渦族の解析場です。保存量をGauss求積してから圧力・速度を算出し、周期の継ぎ目に残るGaussianの裾と求積誤差を明記します。
note.en: Analytic reference The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1. Analytic field for the same translating isentropic-vortex family. Pressure and velocity are evaluated after Gauss integration of conserved variables; finite-periodic Gaussian tails and quadrature error remain explicit.

note.ja: 26単体検査と8固定計算158判定を実行前に固定します。全FE候補・SSP凸結合のmin/max、共有流束による質量収支、再構築の平均保存、3格子のL1/L∞・相対L2を保存します。円と凸多角形の交差面積から独立に作る厳密輸送のセル平均を、SciPyの鉛直切片求積と面積・一次モーメントで照合します。1/4・1/2・3/4回転の誤差と重心も検査し、回転方向や速度の誤りが一回転のreturnだけで隠れないようにします。
note.en: Freeze26 unit checks and158 gates across eight fixed runs before execution. Retain min/max of every FE candidate/SSP convex mean, shared-flux mass budgets, reconstruction mean preservation and three-grid L1/Linf/relative-L2 errors. Independent circle/convex-polygon intersection means are qualified against SciPy vertical-slice quadrature, total area and first moments. Also check quarter/half/three-quarter-turn errors and centroids so a wrong direction or speed cannot hide behind a full-turn return.

name.ja: Zalesak型の切り欠き円盤：剛体回転と幾何学的セル平均
name.en: Zalesak-type slotted disk: rigid rotation and geometric cell means

note.ja: 解析解 単位正方形の2次元スカラー輸送です。速度(.5−y,x−.5)、角速度1、周期2π、中心(.5,.75)・半径.15の円盤から.475<x<.525かつy<.85のスロットを除き、内部1・外部0とします。公式Firedrake例の正規化した切り欠き円盤だけを取り出した変種で、bell・cone・背景値1・DG・流入境界は再現しません。周期有限体積の対向面では法線速度が一致します。連続解の台は境界から離れており、数値的な裾は別に測ります。参照は剛体回転の逆特性と円盤・多角形の解析的な面積積分によるセル平均で、点値を並べた画像や別PDE計算の細格子解ではありません。一回転後の連続形状への帰還と、位置・初期角度を変えた固定診断を区別します。 円盤とスロットの定義を固定し、保存した初期・帰還時のセル平均と比較します。指示関数の点値や別実装PDEの細格子解を参照と混同しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Unit-square two-dimensional scalar transport with prescribed velocity (0.5-y,x-0.5), angular speed 1 and period2*pi. The baseline indicator is one inside the disk of radius 0.15 centered at (0.5,0.75), excluding 0.475<x<0.525 and y<0.85, and zero outside. This isolates the normalized slotted-cylinder component described in the official Firedrake setup; its bell, cone, background 1, DG discretization and inflow boundary are not copied. Periodic finite-volume normal velocities match on opposite faces; the compact exact body stays away from the boundary, while numerical tails are measured. Exact rigid characteristics and analytic disk/polygon intersection areas define the reference cell means, not rasterized point samples or a second numerical PDE solution. A full turn returns to the initial continuum shape; rotated/shifted variants are separate fixed diagnostics. Fix the disk and slot geometry and compare stored initial/returned cell means. Distinguish indicator point samples and a finer PDE calculation from this geometric reference.

name.ja: 相対論的対称衝突：特殊化した二衝撃波Taub参照
name.en: Relativistic symmetric collision: specialized two-shock Taub reference

note.ja: 半解析解 c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。 独自の穏やかな対称入力で、接触面は同じ静止状態へ退化します。一般三波Riemann解、高Lorentz因子、原著の数値入力は検証しません。Eは静止質量を含み、保存量の厳密セル平均と比較します。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver. Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means.

name.ja: SRMHD円偏波：有限振幅厳密族と独立テンソル積分
name.en: SRMHD circular wave: finite-amplitude exact family and independent tensor integration

note.ja: 解析解 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。 原著の厳密解族を独立な低次法で計算し、ECHO法や原著誤差表は再現しません。一般RMHD衝撃波、極端な磁化・Lorentz因子、GR、抵抗MHD、多次元磁場発散制御は対象外。図は実際の1D時空間場です。
note.en: Analytic reference Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval. Use the original exact family with an independent lower-order operator; no ECHO-algorithm or error-table reproduction. Generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/Lorentz factors,GR,resistive MHD and multidimensional divergence control are outside scope. Figures show actual1D x–t fields.

note.ja: 製造解 単位正方形でT=0.25まで、n=1+0.1e⁻ᵗcos(πx)cos(πy)、c=1+0.05e⁻²ᵗcos(πx)cos(2πy)に対応する外力を製造し、発散零で境界に接する移流を用います。無次元の係数と外力をinputs.jsonに固定。内面・角の所有を明示して製造外力と境界流束を扱います。 著者作成の強制2場モデルです。原著の全生物モデル、ピーク形成、真のblow-upやその抑制を実証しません。負値をクリップして正値性を装いません。
note.en: Manufactured solution On the unit square toT.25,manufacture forcing for n=1+.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy,c=1+.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πy with divergence-free tangential advection. Dimensionless; manufactured-field coefficients and forcing are fixed in inputs.json. Manufactured forcing and boundary fluxes, with explicit ownership of interior faces and corners. This authored forced two-field model does not reproduce the full original biological model or demonstrate aggregation, true blow-up or suppression. No clipping is used to manufacture positivity.

title.ja: 古典的RK4
title.en: Classical RK4

keywords: h and t have the same time unit, and f_i has units y_i/time. State-component units belong to the problem; RK4 imposes no intrinsic physical unit. hλ is dimensionless.
時間hとtは同じ単位、f_iはy_i/時間の単位。状態成分の単位は問題が定め、RK4自体は固有の物理単位を持たない。hλは無次元。
Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to the ODE step itself. For a PDE, each stage's RHS evaluation must supply the appropriate boundary values or ghost states.
時間ステップ単体に空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEを進める場合、境界値やゴースト状態は各段階の右辺評価が正しく供給する必要がある。
滑らかな常微分方程式・空間離散後の系の初期値問題。
Initial-value problems for smooth ODEs or semidiscrete systems.
runge_kutta.TABLEAUS['rk4']の古典4段4次とrk_step。Hamiltonian比較にも同じ古典係数のRK4がある。
Classical four-stage fourth-order TABLEAUS['rk4'] and rk_step in runge_kutta.py; the Hamiltonian comparison also uses classical RK4 coefficients.
非硬い滑らかな問題で、誤差と刻み幅の関係を明快に調べたい。
4回の右辺評価を許容でき、固定刻みや別の刻み制御を管理できる。
A smooth nonstiff problem needs a clear accuracy/step-size baseline.
Four RHS evaluations per step are affordable, with fixed-step or external step control.
非常に硬い減衰やDAEを汎用に解く。
SSP性・正値性や長時間のHamilton構造保存が必須。
Very stiff decay or general DAEs must be handled.
SSP/positivity guarantees or long-time Hamiltonian structure preservation are essential.

name.ja: 古典的RK4
name.en: Classical RK4

summary.ja: 滑らかな非硬い常微分方程式を4回の右辺評価で4次精度に進める古典Runge–Kutta法。公開例では次数条件、安定関数、非線形・時刻依存問題を比較し、SSP性やシンプレクティック性とは区別する。 追加固定例：振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：酵素反応の保存と準定常近似、Lotka–Volterra不変量と正値性、SEIR保存則と初期線形化。
summary.en: Classical four-stage Runge–Kutta advances smooth nonstiff ODEs with fourth-order accuracy. Released examples compare order conditions, stability functions and nonlinear/time-dependent problems while distinguishing accuracy from SSP and symplectic properties. Additional fixed examples: Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Fixed educational executions: Enzyme conservation and QSSA, Lotka–Volterra invariant and positivity, SEIR conservation and initial linearization.

method.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

name.ja: ロジスティック個体群増殖
name.en: Logistic population growth

note.ja: 収容力Kを持つ密度依存の連続時間増殖モデル。離散ロジスティック写像とは区別します。 限定した実行例：無次元の単一個体群。RK4を全出力時刻で解析解と比較し、非負性と刻み幅の収束を確認。反応拡散・複数種は対象外。
note.en: Density-limited growth with carrying capacity K. It is the simplest biological ODE baseline. The linked original is the later 1847 memoir; the 1838 note itself was not audited. The differential equation is not the discrete logistic map. Scoped executed example: One dimensionless population. Compare RK4 with the analytic solution at every output time; check nonnegativity and time refinement. Excludes reaction–diffusion and multispecies models.

name.ja: SIR・SEIR区画モデル

note.ja: 閉じた一様混合集団の規格化SIR系。SEIRは曝露区画を追加します。人数と割合ではβの定義が異なります。 限定した実行例：閉鎖・均質な人口割合SIR。RK4と別実装のSciPy DOP853を比較。人口保存・非負性・時間収束を確認。SEIR・空間伝播・実データ較正は対象外。
note.en: Closed, well-mixed normalized population fractions. SEIR adds an exposed compartment and a progression rate. The original general epidemic framework is broader than this SIR specialization. Population-count and fraction conventions give different β definitions. Scoped executed example: Closed homogeneous population-fraction SIR. Compare RK4 with independently implemented SciPy DOP853; check conservation, nonnegativity and time convergence. Excludes SEIR, spatial spread and calibration to observations.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み
name.en: Turing reaction–diffusion framework

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: FitzHugh–Nagumoの興奮と回復
name.en: FitzHugh–Nagumo excitation and recovery

note.ja: 高速の興奮と低速の回復を結ぶ規格化した代表形。係数・符号・空間拡張には複数の規約があります。 限定した実行例：公開実行例はD=0の空間なしの縮約ODEです。FHN/BVP型の縮約ODEの限定検証です。HH全イオンチャネル、空間軸索、患者データ、実測電気生理の再現を含みません。
note.en: A normalized fast excitation/slow recovery model for pulses, refractoriness and spiral waves when extended in space. This is a common normalized variant; cubic coefficients, recovery signs and nondimensionalization differ between formulations. Scoped executed example: The executed case has D=0 and no spatial coordinate. Scoped verification of an FHN/BVP-style reduced ODE. It excludes full HH ion channels, spatial axons, patient data and experimental electrophysiology reproduction.

name.ja: 拘束付き平面振り子

note.en: Distinguish the original position-constrained DAE, an underlying ODE based on differentiated constraints, and the SHAKE/RATTLE discrete maps.

name.ja: Michaelis–Mentenと完全酵素反応系
name.en: Michaelis–Menten and full enzyme kinetics

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 限定した実行例：2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

name.ja: Lotka–Volterra捕食・被食
name.en: Lotka–Volterra predator–prey

note.ja: 捕食・被食の結合ODE。位相平面と長時間積分を考えるためのモデルです。 限定した実行例：1初期値・有限時間の固定比較です。連続系の閉軌道を引き込み極限周期とは呼びません。RK4の厳密な不変量保存、任意刻みでの正値性、長時間の構造保存は保証しません。
note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test. Scoped executed example: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.

name.ja: Hodgkin–Huxley膜動態
name.en: Hodgkin–Huxley membrane dynamics

note.ja: 電位とゲート変数z=m,h,nの膜モデル。元のイカ軸索モデルと、人心筋や空間ケーブルへの拡張を区別します。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Hodgkin–Huxley：電位固定・静止平衡・発火
note.en: Voltage and gating variables z=m,h,n describe an ionic excitable membrane. A cable extension adds spatial axial current. The original squid-axon model is not a calibrated human cardiac model. No single rate parameter set is selected by this survey. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Hodgkin–Huxley: clamps, rest and firing

note.ja: a=g=1, Ω=2, u0=.5, h0=10 の軸対称な無次元部分問題。運動量中心差分・質量FV・RK4の混成で実際に時間発展させます。標準地球条件や全球多次元SWE、厳密な離散釣合い・PV保存の再現ではありません。
note.en: Axisymmetric nondimensional subproblem with a=g=1, Omega=2, u0=.5 and h0=10. Actual time evolution uses centered primitive momentum, finite-volume mass and RK4. Not standard Earth parameters, a full global multidimensional SWE core, exact discrete balance or a PV-conservation claim.

name.ja: 周期正弦波の線形移流

caption.ja: 保存済みのCIP・線形補間・厳密な移流波形。
caption.en: Stored CIP, linear-interpolation and exact advection profiles.

note.ja: この問題への対応が共通の固定入力・実行例で明示された手法です。図と実行例の条件の違いは入力で確認してください。 セル平均からのWENO-JS／Z二乗重みの臨界点再構成と、実際の周期スカラー輸送を比較します。εの違い、解析セル平均と点値、空間誤差と時間刻みの影響を分けます。 p+1個のGauss解点、上流数値流束、Legendre多項式によるRadau左右補正、SSPRK(3,3)。初期L2射影・上流流束・時間刻み規約をバイト一致の既存modal DGと揃えます。スケールしたCourant数(2p+1)|a|Δt/h≤.15。最後にp2/N32で刻みを半減。
note.en: Methods explicitly bound to this problem by the common fixed-input execution example. Inspect its input for differences from the figure’s conditions. Compare critical-point reconstruction from cell means using WENO-JS/Z power-two weights and actual periodic scalar transport. Separate epsilon choices, analytic cell means versus point values, and spatial error versus time-step effects. p+1 Gauss solution points, upwind interface flux, Legendre Radau corrections and SSPRK(3,3). Match initial L2 projection, upwind flux and timestep policy to the unchanged published modal DG. Scaled Courant(2p+1)|a|dt/h<=.15; separately halve the timestep at p2/N32.

note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

name.ja: Michaelis–Mentenと完全酵素反応系

note.ja: 酵素・基質・複合体の反応と飽和速度則。完全反応系、迅速平衡近似、準定常近似の違いは解説先へ。 限定した実行例：2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

note.en: Coupled prey growth and predation; a phase-plane and long-time integration test. Scoped executed example: This is a finite-time comparison for one initial state. The continuum closed orbit is not an attracting limit cycle. RK4 is not claimed to preserve H exactly, maintain positivity at arbitrary steps or guarantee long-time geometric fidelity.

caption.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts. Drawn from saved arrays. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

name.ja: WENO臨界点：多項式セル平均と解析的周期輸送

note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity.

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

name.ja: Turing反応拡散の枠組み
name.en: Turing reaction–diffusion framework

note.ja: 2成分反応拡散の枠組み。f・gは個別に指定する必要があり、模様の画像だけでTuring機構とは判定できません。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。一般の模様選択、2次元、生物実験への較正、流体連成には広げません。
note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

name.ja: 受動Lorentz・Ohmic分散Maxwell場

note.ja: 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
note.en: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

note.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
note.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

note.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 空間も異なるcosine Fourier–Galerkin＋Radau参照（K32/64/96、cubic投影M=4(K+1)>4K、analytic Jacobian）とraw L1/L2/L∞を比較。参照のK感度とODE公差感度を別検査し、時間次数は同じFD半離散系を別実装Radauで積分した値に対して測定。平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を成分ごとに求め悪い方を採用。反応収支・全step正濃度・初期ゼロのk≥5（本対称性で最初はk6）・線形化との差を記録します。 収束ノルムと参照感度は固定最終時刻で判定し、途中スナップショット誤差は別の推移診断です。
note.en: Compare raw L1/L2/L∞ with a spatially independent cosine Fourier–Galerkin/Radau reference (K32/64/96, cubic projection M=4(K+1)>4K, analytic Jacobian). Separately check K and ODE-tolerance sensitivity. Measure time order against a separately implemented Radau integration of the SAME FD semidiscretization. Norms are per-species mean-absolute/RMS/maximum, then the worse species. Record source/sink balance, every-step positive concentrations, initially absent k≥5 (first allowed k6 here), and departure from linearization. Convergence norms and reference sensitivities are assessed at the fixed final time; intermediate snapshot errors are separate evolution diagnostics.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

name.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
name.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

note.ja: 解析解 外側真空、ky=4、板[4,5]、ε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。s=Ezとp=Hzをω=5.1/6/6.9で比較します。 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz. This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
note.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

name.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照
name.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

title.ja: L安定なSDIRK2
title.en: L-stable SDIRK2

keywords: h has time units, f_i has y_i/time, and J_ij has y_i/(y_j×time). Nondimensionalization or component scaling is needed: the fixed Newton tolerance 2×10^-12 does not automatically adapt to arbitrary physical units. Adaptive atol sets state scales and rtol is dimensionless.
hは時間、f_iはy_i/時間、Jacobian要素J_ijはy_i/(y_j×時間)。無次元化または成分尺度の調整が必要で、固定のNewton許容値2×10^-12は任意の物理単位に自動対応しない。適応版のatolは状態尺度、rtolは無次元。
Spatial boundaries do not apply to the ODE time step itself. For semidiscrete PDEs, incorporate boundary conditions and their time dependence consistently into the RHS and Jacobian.
ODE時間積分単体には空間境界条件は該当しない。PDEの半離散系に使う場合、境界条件とその時刻依存性を右辺とJacobianへ整合して組み込む。
速い減衰モードと遅い変化が共存する常微分方程式の初期値問題。
ODE initial-value problems with rapidly decaying modes and slower evolution.
stiff.pyのsdirk2_step: γ=1−1/√2の2段2次stiffly accurate SDIRK。Newtonは許容値2×10^-12・最大25回。適応ラッパーは独立のステップ倍化。
sdirk2_step in stiff.py: two-stage second-order stiffly accurate SDIRK with γ=1−1/√2. Newton uses tolerance 2×10^-12 and at most 25 iterations. The separate adaptive wrapper uses step doubling.
硬い減衰を抑えつつ2次精度で進め、右辺とJacobianを用意できる。
陰的段階の収束と、許容誤差を変えた結果の比較を管理できる。
Stiff decay must be damped with second-order stepping, and an RHS/Jacobian are available.
Implicit-stage convergence and tolerance-refinement comparisons can be monitored.
Jacobianが不整合、またはNewtonが収束しない状態のまま解を採用する。
DAE、厳密な正値性、イベント検出や保証付き大域誤差制御をこの実装だけで必要とする。
The Jacobian is inconsistent or unconverged Newton stages would be accepted.
This implementation alone must supply DAE support, strict positivity, event detection or guaranteed global-error control.

summary.ja: 硬い常微分方程式の減衰を扱う2段2次の陰的Runge–Kutta法。公開版はγ=1−1/√2のstiffly accurateなL安定SDIRKで、各段階にNewton法を用い、別のラッパーでステップ倍化による局所誤差制御を行う。 追加固定例：Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差、van der Polの短時間剛性遷移。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：酵素反応の保存と準定常近似。

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。

Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. Two fixed methods, three step counts and two mu values plus four adaptive runs give 16 runs. This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

note.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似
name.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

keywords: The released oscillator is nondimensional with m=1 and harmonic ω=1. A general-mass formulation would require drift h p/m and consistent position, momentum, force and time scales; that generalization is not an input feature of this released function.
公開振動子は質量m=1、調和角振動数ω=1に無次元化している。一般の質量に転用する場合はdriftをh p/mとし、q・p・力・時間の尺度を整合させる必要があるが、その一般化はこの公開関数の入力では提供しない。

Spatial boundary conditions do not apply to this oscillator phase-space map. It is a different problem from the original periodic Lennard-Jones fluid; particle periodicity, walls and constraints are not implemented here.
この振動子の位相空間写像に空間境界条件は該当しない。原報の周期Lennard–Jones流体とは別の問題であり、粒子の周期境界や壁・拘束はこの実装にない。
位置依存ポテンシャルを持つHamilton系の軌道と長時間の幾何学的挙動。
Trajectories and long-time geometric behaviour of Hamiltonian systems with a position-dependent potential.
hamiltonian._verletのkick–drift–kick（velocity-Verlet形）。公開の対象は単位質量の1次元調和・四次振動子で、Verlet原報の位置漸化式とは表現を区別する。
Kick–drift–kick (velocity-Verlet form) in hamiltonian._verlet, restricted to unit-mass one-dimensional harmonic/quartic oscillators; distinguished from the original paper's position recurrence.
固定刻みで、分離Hamiltonianの可逆性・シンプレクティック性とエネルギー誤差を比較したい。
位置依存力の時間尺度を解像できる振動子の教材例が欲しい。
Compare fixed-step reversibility/symplecticity with energy error for a separable Hamiltonian.
An oscillator teaching example with resolved position-dependent-force time scales is useful.
速度依存力や摩擦、拘束を追加しても同じ構造保存が自動的に成り立つと期待する。
任意質量・多粒子系や適応刻みの汎用実装を必要とする。
The same geometric guarantees are expected to survive added velocity forces, friction or constraints automatically.
A general-mass, many-particle or adaptive-step implementation is required.

summary.ja: 既存配布版：位置だけに依存する力を、半分のkick・drift・半分のkickで進める2次の可逆・シンプレクティック法。公開例は単位質量の調和/四次振動子で、エネルギー誤差と構造保存が同じでないことを確かめる。 追加固定例：無軟化Kepler二体の時間誤差、冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：温かいPICの線形Landau減衰、温かいPICの二流初期成長。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：PIC空間演算の独立実装照合。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み、結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: A second-order reversible symplectic method using half kick, drift and half kick for position-dependent forces. Released unit-mass harmonic/quartic oscillators illustrate why energy error and geometric structure preservation are different properties. Additional fixed examples: Unsoftened Kepler two-body time error, Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Warm PIC linear Landau damping, Warm PIC two-stream initial growth. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Independently coded PIC spatial pipeline. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Kepler eccentricity and time-step controls, Coupled frequencies and finite-window resonance. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

summary.ja: Thomas法は三重対角消去。1949年原報は未読で、公式収蔵目録とMolerの1996年通信から書誌を追跡しています。Crank–Nicolsonと多重格子の文献は関連章の背景資料で、Thomas原報やその再録ではありません。 追加固定例：解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：1D Poisson PINNと独立格子誤差。
summary.en: Thomas is tridiagonal elimination. Its1949 original remains unread; an official archival finding aid and Moler's signed1996 correspondence provide bibliographic leads. Crank–Nicolson and multigrid references are related chapter context, not Thomas originals or reprints. Additional fixed examples: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. title.en: Conjugate gradients

keywords: CG has no intrinsic physical unit. The public Poisson coordinates have unit dimensionless length; dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]². Residual norms are unweighted array norms.
CG自体に固有の物理単位はない。公開Poisson例は長さ1の無次元座標で、次元を与えるなら [f]=[u]/[長さ]²。残差は格子体積で重み付けしない配列ノルム。
CG itself supplies no physical boundary condition. The public 2D Poisson examples impose u=0 on every side of [0,1]² by zero padding.
代数解法としてのCGは境界を定めない。公開2次元Poisson例は [0,1]² の全辺で u=0 をゼロ埋め込みにより課す。
Poisson方程式の離散化などから得られる、実対称正定値系 Ax=b。
Real SPD systems Ax=b, including a discrete Poisson equation.
五点差分作用素を直接適用する前処理なしの線形CG。共通比較経路では各反復で真の残差を再計算する。
Unpreconditioned linear CG with a matrix-free five-point operator; the comparison path recomputes the true residual each iteration.
SPDが分かっている離散系で、行列積だけから解を求めたいとき。
同じ格子・右辺・真の残差基準で他のPoisson解法と比較するとき。
The discretized system is known to be SPD and a matrix-free solve is desired.
Comparing Poisson solvers on the same grid, forcing and true-residual criterion.
移流による非対称系、鞍点系、零空間を残した周期・Neumann系。
反復回数だけで計算時間や連続解の精度を保証したい場合。
Nonsymmetric advection systems, saddle-point systems or periodic/Neumann systems with an untreated nullspace.
Claims about runtime or continuous-solution accuracy based only on iteration count.

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
name.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. title.ja: Armijo減衰Newton法
title.en: Armijo-damped Newton

keywords: No intrinsic physical unit; the caller defines unknown and residual scales. Components are not nondimensionalized automatically, so scale them consistently before using the norm and absolute tolerance.
固有の物理単位はなく、未知数・残差の尺度は呼び出し側が決める。単位・桁の違う残差成分を自動で無次元化しないため、ノルムと絶対許容誤差を使う前に尺度を揃える。
Newton has no intrinsic physical boundary. F/Jacobian assembly supplies it; the existing Bratu test encodes zero Dirichlet values at both ends of [0,1].
Newton法自体に物理境界はない。境界はFとJacobianの組立て側が指定する。既存Bratu検査は [0,1] の両端零Dirichletを内部未知数の残差へ組み込む。
微分可能な平方の非線形連立方程式 F(x)=0。
A differentiable square nonlinear system F(x)=0.
残差ノルムのArmijo型十分減少を用いる減衰Newton。内部線形解法はdenseまたはGMRESで、Jacobianは明示指定。
Damped Newton with an Armijo-type residual-norm decrease test; explicit Jacobian and dense/GMRES inner solve.
Jacobianを与えられ、根の候補に近い初期値があるとき。
非線形問題で線形解法の誤差と減衰の作用を分けて確認するとき。
A Jacobian and an initial guess near a candidate root are available.
Examining the separate effects of inner linear accuracy and damping.
Jacobianが特異になる点や、解が複数ある問題を初期値依存なしに解きたい場合。
制約付き最適化やJacobianなしの巨大問題をこのまま解く場合。
Requiring initial-guess-independent results near singular Jacobians or multiple roots.
Direct use for constrained optimization or very large Jacobian-free problems.

name.ja: Armijo減衰Newton法
name.en: Armijo-damped Newton

summary.ja: 非線形方程式 F(x)=0 を、Jacobianから求めたNewton方向と残差ノルムの十分減少による減衰で解く。公開例は密行列解法または前処理付きGMRESの内部解法を選べる。 追加固定例：擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：同じ難しい初期値に対する線探索と信頼領域。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差、van der Polの短時間剛性遷移。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 固定した教育用実行例：酵素反応の保存と準定常近似。
summary.en: Solve F(x)=0 using a Jacobian-based Newton direction and damping that requires sufficient decrease of the residual norm. The example supports a dense or preconditioned GMRES inner solve. Additional fixed examples: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Line search and trust regions from the same difficult starts. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold, Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error, Van der Pol: an early stiffness transition. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE, Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Fixed educational executions: Enzyme conservation and QSSA.

method.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

note.en: Enzyme saturation; the full mass-action system resolves the transient complex C, while the rate law eliminates a fast variable. The 1913 rapid-equilibrium interpretation and the 1925 quasi-steady-state derivation must remain distinct. Scoped executed example: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

name.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
note.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

name.ja: 等エントロピー渦：低Mach比較に用いるEuler解析場
name.en: Isentropic vortex: analytic Euler field for low-Mach comparisons

note.ja: 解析解 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。 同じ等エントロピー移動渦族の解析場です。保存量をGauss求積してから圧力・速度を算出し、周期の継ぎ目に残るGaussianの裾と求積誤差を明記します。
note.en: Analytic reference The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1. Analytic field for the same translating isentropic-vortex family. Pressure and velocity are evaluated after Gauss integration of conserved variables; finite-periodic Gaussian tails and quadrature error remain explicit.

note.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
note.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

name.ja: 等エントロピー渦：低Mach比較に用いるEuler解析場
name.en: Isentropic vortex: analytic Euler field for low-Mach comparisons

note.ja: 解析解 全平面Eulerの移動等エントロピー渦を、γ=1.4、β=3、背景密度1、背景速度U=(1,.5)で定義します。背景Mach数Mに対してp∞=1.25/(1.4M²)とし、θ=1−(γ−1)β²exp(1−r²)/(8γπ²p∞)、ρ=θ^(1/(γ−1))、p=p∞θ^(γ/(γ−1))です。Uとともに動く座標を[-10,10]²へ折り返します。解析式は全平面の厳密なEuler解ですが、有限周期箱の継ぎ目にはゼロでないGaussianの裾があり、滑らかな周期トーラスの厳密解とは区別します。4保存量のセル平均をGauss8で求積しGauss16と照合した後、圧力・速度へ変換します。閉形式の厳密セル平均やprimitive変数の平均ではありません。低Mach固定例はM=.1/.01、T=.1。p∞=1で従来KEEPの場へ戻ります。 同じ等エントロピー移動渦族の解析場です。保存量をGauss求積してから圧力・速度を算出し、周期の継ぎ目に残るGaussianの裾と求積誤差を明記します。
note.en: Analytic reference The translating whole-plane ideal-gas Euler vortex uses gamma=1.4, beta=3, far-field density1 and background velocity U=(1,.5). For background Mach number M, p_inf=1.25/(1.4*M^2); theta=1-(gamma-1)*beta^2*exp(1-r^2)/(8*gamma*pi^2*p_inf), rho=theta^(1/(gamma-1)), p=p_inf*theta^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Coordinates move with U and are wrapped in [-10,10]^2. The whole-plane field is analytic; the finite minimum-image periodic field retains nonzero Gaussian seam tails and is not a globally exact smooth torus solution. Tensor Gauss8 cell means of all conserved variables are checked against Gauss16, then primitive pressure and velocity are recovered from those means. These are numerical cell quadratures, not closed-form exact cell averages or means of primitive variables. The low-Mach fixed runs use M=.1/.01 and T=.1; the historical KEEP case is recovered by p_inf=1. Analytic field for the same translating isentropic-vortex family. Pressure and velocity are evaluated after Gauss integration of conserved variables; finite-periodic Gaussian tails and quadrature error remain explicit.

note.ja: CTは面磁場の離散発散を保存し、採用GLMはセル中心磁場の発散誤差を輸送・減衰します。初期化・離散演算子・減衰条件を区別した上で、構成厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使うCT／GLMの同条件比較へ進めます。格子誤差と時間積分誤差を分け、GLMを厳密な発散ゼロ保証と扱いません。旧Brio–Wuは1次元流束確認、GLM Fourier例は制約診断であり、多次元MHDの一般的な検証とは別です。 採用離散化では物理2例の共通発散は可換性でゼロを保つため、別の初期発散誤差対照でCTの保持とGLMの波動輸送・減衰を調べ、減衰なしの対照でLLF拡散や位相と区別します。
note.en: CT preserves its face-field discrete divergence; the adopted cell-centered GLM transports and damps divergence errors. Distinguish initialization, discrete operators and damping conditions before comparing CT/GLM under matched conditions against a constructed exact solution and independent Athena++ references. Separate spatial and time-integration errors; GLM does not guarantee exact zero divergence. The earlier Brio–Wu case checks 1D fluxes and the GLM Fourier case is a constraint diagnostic, separately from general multidimensional MHD validation. Because commuting operators keep the common divergence zero in these two physical cases, a separate initial-divergence control checks CT preservation and GLM wave transport/damping, using an undamped companion to distinguish LLF diffusion and phase.

note.ja: CTは面磁場の離散発散を保存し、採用GLMはセル中心磁場の発散誤差を輸送・減衰します。初期化・離散演算子・減衰条件を区別した上で、構成厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使うCT／GLMの同条件比較へ進めます。格子誤差と時間積分誤差を分け、GLMを厳密な発散ゼロ保証と扱いません。旧Brio–Wuは1次元流束確認、GLM Fourier例は制約診断であり、多次元MHDの一般的な検証とは別です。 採用離散化では物理2例の共通発散は可換性でゼロを保つため、別の初期発散誤差対照でCTの保持とGLMの波動輸送・減衰を調べ、減衰なしの対照でLLF拡散や位相と区別します。
note.en: CT preserves its face-field discrete divergence; the adopted cell-centered GLM transports and damps divergence errors. Distinguish initialization, discrete operators and damping conditions before comparing CT/GLM under matched conditions against a constructed exact solution and independent Athena++ references. Separate spatial and time-integration errors; GLM does not guarantee exact zero divergence. The earlier Brio–Wu case checks 1D fluxes and the GLM Fourier case is a constraint diagnostic, separately from general multidimensional MHD validation. Because commuting operators keep the common divergence zero in these two physical cases, a separate initial-divergence control checks CT preservation and GLM wave transport/damping, using an undamped companion to distinguish LLF diffusion and phase.

note.ja: ωt+uωx+vωy=νΔωを中央差分とHeun法で進め、各段で−Δhψ=ωを非周期Dirichlet DSTで解きます。u=ψy,v=−ψx。局所一次のThom壁渦度を使用し、原著のCSI-MGと高次壁公式は実装していません。

note.en: Analytic reference Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps. Integrate q(x,t)=1+.2sin[2pi(x-.7t)] between the actual saved primary faces. Separately record geometry error against analytic face positions. Time checks use independent DOP853 at two tolerances for the same FV ODE. First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work.

pm_acceleration is a dimensionless G=1 example. L and positions share a length unit; density, potential and acceleration scale as M/L³, GM/L and GM/L². Only the lower-level periodic_poisson accepts a positive gravity parameter.
pm_accelerationはG=1固定の無次元例。L・位置には同じ長さ単位を使い、ρは質量/L³、φはGM/L、加速度はGM/L²に対応する。下位関数periodic_poissonのみ正のgravityを指定できる。
Periodic in all directions with box length L. Mean removal enforces periodic-Poisson compatibility, while zeroing k=0 fixes the additive potential gauge. This is not the isolated-force problem.
全方向周期、箱長L。平均密度を除くことで周期Poissonの整合性を満たし、k=0を零に固定してポテンシャルの加法定数を選ぶ。孤立境界の力とは同一問題でない。

title.ja: Barnes–Hut八分木
title.en: Barnes–Hut octree

keywords: 重力と長距離相互作用
Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
無次元のG=1。位置と軟化長は同じ長さ単位、質量には一貫した単位を使う。長さL₀・質量M₀で次元を戻す場合、加速度の尺度はGM₀/L₀²。
Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.
孤立境界で周期像を加えない。軟化核のポテンシャル −Gm/√(r²+ε²) は無限遠で零となる規約。周期PM・Ewald・TreePMとは異なる境界問題。
正質量粒子の孤立・Plummer軟化Newton重力加速度。
Isolated Plummer-softened Newtonian acceleration from positive-mass particles.
Barnes–Hut octree、幾何開角s/d、単極子または軟化核の完全二次モーメント。theta=0で全て開く。
Barnes–Hut octree with geometric s/d opening, monopole or full softened second moment; theta=0 fully opens the tree.
孤立境界で静的な力と開角・近似次数の関係を調べるとき。
同じ位置・質量・軟化長で直接和と照合するとき。
Studying static isolated-force error versus opening angle and expansion order.
Comparing against direct summation with identical positions, masses and softening.
周期系を孤立直接和とそのまま比較したい場合。
近接衝突の非軟化力や厳密な対称相互作用を必要とする場合。
Direct comparison of a periodic problem to isolated direct summation.
Unsoftened close encounters or strictly symmetric pair interactions.

title.ja: Legendreモード基底・正規直交化
title.en: Legendre modal basis / orthonormal scaling

keywords: Legendreモード基底・正規直交化
ξ and basis values are dimensionless. On an affine interval of length L, J=L/2 scales mass by J and gradient stiffness by 1/J. Expansion coefficients share the represented function's units.
ξと基底は無次元。長さLのアフィン区間ではJ=L/2で、質量行列にJ、勾配の剛性行列に1/Jを掛ける。展開係数は表す関数と同じ単位。

Basis evaluation/projection imposes no physical boundary condition. Endpoint values/fluxes and interelement coupling belong to the consuming discretization; the constant stiffness nullspace is not removed automatically.
基底の評価・射影自体は物理境界を課さない。端点の値や流束、隣接要素の接続は利用する離散化側が指定する。剛性行列の定数モードの零空間も自動で除かない。
区間上の関数の多項式表現、L2射影、要素積分。
Polynomial representation, L2 projection and element integration on an interval.
重み1のLegendreモードと任意のL2直交規格化。NumPyのLegendre評価とGauss求積を使用。
Unweighted Legendre modes with optional unit-L2 normalization, using NumPy Legendre evaluation and Gauss quadrature.
モード係数と節点値の違いや直交性を確かめるとき。
滑らかな区間関数の射影や定係数アフィン要素の行列を作るとき。
Examining modal coefficients versus nodal values and orthogonality.
Projecting smooth interval functions or constructing constant-coefficient affine element matrices.
曲線写像・可変係数でも同じ少数求積点で厳密積分できると期待する場合。
不連続点をまたぐGauss求積だけで高精度を保証したい場合。
Expecting the same low-order quadrature to remain exact with curved maps or variable coefficients.
Relying on unsplit Gauss quadrature across a jump for guaranteed high accuracy.

summary.en: Represent reference-interval functions in Legendre modes. The implementation tabulates P₀…Pₚ and derivatives, optionally normalizes them, and computes unweighted L2 projection and affine element matrices by Gauss quadrature.

title.ja: Lagrange節点基底・GLL選点法
title.en: Lagrange nodal basis / GLL collocation

keywords: Reference coordinates/basis values are dimensionless; nodal values carry the function's units. Affine interval matrices scale as M∝J and K∝1/J with J=L/2.
参照座標と基底は無次元、節点値は表す関数の単位。アフィン区間行列はJ=L/2により M∝J、K∝1/J。
GLL includes endpoints but does not itself enforce Dirichlet values or interelement continuity. The consuming discretization supplies values, fluxes and coupling.
GLLは端点を含むが、それだけでDirichlet値や要素間の連続性を課すわけではない。境界値・流束・接続は利用側が指定する。
節点値からの多項式補間、微分と参照要素行列。
Polynomial interpolation/differentiation from nodal values and reference-element matrices.
Legendre Vandermondeで構成する区間Lagrange基底、GLL/等間隔節点、明示P1/P2三角形、Qₚ積基底。
Interval Lagrange bases via a Legendre Vandermonde solve, GLL/equispaced nodes, explicit triangle P1/P2 and Qₚ products.
節点自由度、partition of unity、モード表現との同値性を調べるとき。
GLLで対角化した求積質量と厳密質量の違いを比較するとき。
Studying nodal degrees of freedom, partition of unity and modal equivalence.
Comparing quadrature-diagonalized GLL mass with exact mass.
任意次数の三角形・曲線要素や大規模高次数表作成を求める場合。
GLLの対角質量を常に厳密だとみなす場合。
Arbitrary-degree triangles, curved elements or large high-degree tabulation.
Treating GLL diagonal quadrature mass as universally exact.

name.ja: Lagrange節点基底・GLL選点法
name.en: Lagrange nodal basis / GLL collocation

summary.ja: 節点でδᵢⱼとなるLagrange基底により、関数を節点値から補間する。公開実装は区間のGLL/等間隔節点、三角形P1/P2、四角形Qₚの積基底と、GLLの厳密質量・求積集中質量の差を扱う。
summary.en: Interpolate from nodal values with Lagrange cardinal functions. The example covers interval GLL/equispaced nodes, triangle P1/P2, quadrilateral Qₚ products, and exact versus GLL-quadrature-lumped mass.

note.ja: CTは面磁場の離散発散を保存し、採用GLMはセル中心磁場の発散誤差を輸送・減衰します。初期化・離散演算子・減衰条件を区別した上で、構成厳密解と独立Athena++参照を使うCT／GLMの同条件比較へ進めます。格子誤差と時間積分誤差を分け、GLMを厳密な発散ゼロ保証と扱いません。旧Brio–Wuは1次元流束確認、GLM Fourier例は制約診断であり、多次元MHDの一般的な検証とは別です。 採用離散化では物理2例の共通発散は可換性でゼロを保つため、別の初期発散誤差対照でCTの保持とGLMの波動輸送・減衰を調べ、減衰なしの対照でLLF拡散や位相と区別します。
note.en: CT preserves its face-field discrete divergence; the adopted cell-centered GLM transports and damps divergence errors. Distinguish initialization, discrete operators and damping conditions before comparing CT/GLM under matched conditions against a constructed exact solution and independent Athena++ references. Separate spatial and time-integration errors; GLM does not guarantee exact zero divergence. The earlier Brio–Wu case checks 1D fluxes and the GLM Fourier case is a constraint diagnostic, separately from general multidimensional MHD validation. Because commuting operators keep the common divergence zero in these two physical cases, a separate initial-divergence control checks CT preservation and GLM wave transport/damping, using an undamped companion to distinguish LLF diffusion and phase.
