title.en: FD WENO5-Z

keywords: Released Euler examples are nondimensional. With dimensional data, β and τ scale as the squared projected flux, so the effect of a fixed ε=10^-6 changes with scaling. Nondimensionalize states/fluxes or choose a scale-consistent ε. Use compatible units for Δt, Δx and wave speed.
公開例は無次元Euler量。一般の単位を使う場合、βとτは投影した流束の2乗の尺度を持つため、固定ε=10^-6の効果も変わる。状態・流束の無次元化または尺度に合うεを検討する。Δt・Δx・波速の単位は整合させる。
reconstruction._pad uses periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states or edge extrapolation. Uniform high-order boundary accuracy and nonreflection are not guaranteed.
reconstruction._padで周期、端点初期値固定、または端値外挿のゴースト値を使う。境界での一様な高次精度や無反射性は保証しない。
滑らかな波と衝撃波を併せ持つ1次元Euler流の空間流束微分。
Approximate spatial flux derivatives for one-dimensional Euler flows containing both smooth waves and shocks.
reconstruction.pyのweno-z: p=2のWENO-Z重み、点値FD、大域LF分割、界面固定特性基底（既定）、SSPRK3。
weno-z in reconstruction.py: p=2 WENO-Z weights, pointwise FD, global LF splitting, face-frozen characteristic projection by default, and SSPRK3.
一様格子上で滑らかな解の高次空間精度と不連続の捕獲を比較したい。
点値とセル平均を区別し、ε・CFL・特性投影の選択を管理できる。
Compare smooth-solution high-order spatial accuracy with discontinuity capture on a uniform grid.
Point values and cell averages can be distinguished, and ε, CFL and characteristic projection can be controlled.
一般の非構造格子や多次元、保証付きの真空処理が必要。
セル平均を入力する有限体積WENOと、この点値FD実装を同一視して使いたい。
General unstructured meshes, multiple dimensions or guaranteed vacuum treatment are required.
A finite-volume WENO accepting cell averages is required instead of this pointwise FD implementation.

title.ja: Ewald法
title.en: Ewald summation

keywords: 重力と長距離相互作用

Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。

Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.
3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。
周期像を含む中性点電荷のCoulombエネルギーと力。孤立重力や電子密度のHartree場とは区別します。
Coulomb energy and forces for neutral point charges and periodic images, distinct from isolated gravity or an electron-density Hartree field.
公開例は中性3D点電荷・立方体・tin-foil境界の直接Ewald和です。実空間・逆空間・自己項を含み、打切り・分割パラメータ、エネルギー有限差分の力と独立theta積分を検査しています。

The released example is direct Ewald summation for neutral 3D point charges in a cubic cell with tin-foil boundaries. It includes real/reciprocal/self terms and checks cutoffs, splitting, energy-difference forces and an independent theta integral.
周期像を含むCoulombエネルギーと力を、明示した境界規約で評価したい場合。
小さな中性系で、PME/SPMEと比較する打切り収束済みの基準を用意する場合。
A periodically replicated Coulomb problem with explicitly stated boundary conventions.
A small neutral reference for same-convention PME/SPME energy and force comparisons.
孤立・2次元周期・slab、または中和背景を指定していない非中性系。
有限打切りの値を収束済みの厳密値と扱う場合。実空間と逆空間の誤差を別々に調べる必要があります。
Isolated, two-dimensionally periodic or slab systems, or nonneutral cells without an explicit background model.
Treating finite cutoffs as an exact reference without separate real- and reciprocal-space convergence checks.

note.ja: erfcで減衰する実空間和、Gaussian係数を持つ構造因子の逆格子和、−alpha/sqrt(pi) sum(q²)を加えます。力は各項の位置微分から求め、24成分を中心エネルギー差分と比較します。
note.en: Combine an erfc-screened image sum, Gaussian-damped reciprocal structure factors and the self correction. Differentiate each term and check all 24 force components against central energy differences.

name.ja: この実行例の式と条件
name.en: This execution’s formulation and conditions

note.ja: erfcと逆空間和による主計算とは別に、1/rのGaussian積分と1次元theta関数の積を数値積分します。小さい積分変数ではPoisson変換と中性条件、大きい側では自己項を引いた像和を使い、力はthetaの解析微分から積分します。
note.en: Independently integrate the Gaussian representation of 1/r and products of one-dimensional theta sums. Use a Poisson transform and analytic neutrality cancellation at small integration arguments, and self-subtracted image sums at large arguments. Integrate analytic theta derivatives for forces.

Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。

Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.
3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。
周期像を含む中性点電荷のCoulombエネルギーと力。孤立重力や電子密度のHartree場とは区別します。
Coulomb energy and forces for neutral point charges and periodic images, distinct from isolated gravity or an electron-density Hartree field.
今回の実行例はcardinal B-splineによるEssmann型SPMEです。PME族の採用変種として示し、1993年のLagrange補間による原法を実装したとは呼びません。
The executed example adopts Essmann-style SPME with cardinal B-splines. It is a PME-family variant, not an implementation of the original 1993 Lagrange-interpolation form.
3次元周期Coulomb問題の逆空間評価を格子化し、同条件のEwald和と誤差を比較する場合。
格子密度・補間次数・分割係数を明記して力とエネルギーを評価できる場合。
Meshing the reciprocal contribution of a 3D periodic Coulomb problem for comparison with the same Ewald formulation.
Energy and force checks with explicit mesh density, interpolation order and splitting parameter.
既存のCIC重力PMを、そのまま電荷のPME実装とみなす場合。
格子上の勾配を補間した力を、補間エネルギーの厳密な解析微分と同一視する場合。
自己項・分子内除外・境界項を揃えない別ソフトとの比較。
Equating the existing CIC gravitational PM example with electrostatic PME.
Equating interpolation of grid gradients with exact analytic differentiation of the interpolated energy.
Comparing packages without matching self, intramolecular-exclusion and boundary corrections.

比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。

Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.
3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。
周期像を含む中性点電荷のCoulombエネルギーと力。孤立重力や電子密度のHartree場とは区別します。
Coulomb energy and forces for neutral point charges and periodic images, distinct from isolated gravity or an electron-density Hartree field.
今回の実行例はcardinal B-splineによるEssmann型SPMEです。PME族の採用変種として示し、1993年のLagrange補間による原法を実装したとは呼びません。
The executed example adopts Essmann-style SPME with cardinal B-splines. It is a PME-family variant, not an implementation of the original 1993 Lagrange-interpolation form.
原PMEとの補間差を明らかにし、滑らかなエネルギー・力を同条件で比較したい場合。
補間次数・格子密度・力の評価法を固定し、直接Ewaldの収束値と比較できる場合。
Comparing interpolation choices with original PME while seeking smooth energy and forces.
Checking specified spline order, mesh density and force differentiation against a converged direct-Ewald reference.
「PME」と呼ぶだけで、B-spline次数・窓の補正・FFT規格化・微分法を省略する場合。
解析的な力を用いれば、有限格子で運動量とエネルギーの双方が厳密保存すると仮定する場合。
孤立・slab・非中性系を、同じ3D中性仕様のまま扱う場合。
Leaving spline order, interpolation-window correction, FFT normalization or differentiation unspecified under a generic PME label.
Assuming analytic forces alone guarantee both exact momentum and energy conservation on a finite mesh.
Applying the neutral 3D specification unchanged to isolated, slab or nonneutral systems.

note.en: Tensor-product cardinal splines of order four or six spread the charges. Apply the nodal-spline discrete structure-factor correction and Gaussian Green function through 3D FFTs; analytically differentiate assignment weights for forces.

title.ja: Schrödinger固有値問題
title.en: Schrodinger eigenproblems

keywords: Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2).
原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。

u(0)=u(r_max)=0. Released hydrogenic refinement inputs use r_max=60 bohr; a separate Z=1 1s study uses r_max=4,8,16,32 bohr. Origin and infinity are approximated by regularity and finite-box Dirichlet conditions.
u(0)=u(r_max)=0。公開する水素型の格子検査はr_max=60 bohr。Z=1の1sは別途r_max=4,8,16,32 bohrを比較。原点の正則性と無限遠の減衰を有限箱のDirichlet条件で近似する。
孤立した1電子Coulomb系の束縛エネルギーと規格化軌道を求める。
Find bound-state energies and normalized orbitals of an isolated one-electron Coulomb system.
角運動量を分離した縮約動径方程式。2次中心差分を三重対角固有値解法で解き、E_n=−Z²/(2n²)と解析軌道を参照する。
Angular-momentum-separated reduced radial equation, second-order central differences and a tridiagonal eigensolver, referenced to E_n=-Z^2/(2n^2) and analytic orbitals.
解析解を持つ束縛状態で格子誤差・領域誤差・固有値残差を分けて学ぶ。
公開入力に含まれるZ・(n,l)で規格化、直交性、Zによるエネルギーのスケーリングを調べる。
Separate grid error, domain error and eigenpair residuals on analytically solvable bound states.
Inspect normalization, orthogonality and charge scaling for the released Z and (n,l) cases.
電子間相互作用を含む多体波動関数や分子のエネルギーが必要。
散乱・連続状態、時間発展、強い相対論効果を扱う。
A many-electron interacting wavefunction or molecular energy is required.
Scattering/continuum states, time evolution or strong relativistic effects are required.

keywords: ハートリー・フォック

Atomic units (hbar=m_e=e=4 pi epsilon_0=1): r in bohr, energies/effective potentials in hartree, and normalized reduced orbitals u in bohr^(-1/2). Positive electron-number density n(r) is in bohr^(-3); radial number density p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) is in bohr^(-1), with integral p dr=N. p is not signed charge density. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately.

原子単位系（ℏ=mₑ=e=4πε₀=1）。rはbohr、エネルギー・有効ポテンシャルはhartree、規格化した縮約軌道uはbohr⁻¹ᐟ²。正の電子数密度n(r)はbohr⁻³、動径電子数密度p(r)=4πr²n(r)はbohr⁻¹、∫p dr=N。pは符号付き電荷密度ではありません。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。

Helium reduced orbital: u(0)=u(r_max)=0, baseline r_max=16 bohr with a separate 4/8/12/16-bohr domain study. The Hartree field is finite at the origin and joins N/r outside the density; it is not fixed to zero at r_max. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box.
He縮約軌道にu(0)=u(r_max)=0（基本r_max=16 bohr、別途4/8/12/16 bohrの領域検査）。Hartree場は原点で有限、密度の外ではN/rへ接続し、r_maxで0には固定しません。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。
交換を含む単一行列式近似のHe閉殻基底状態を求める。 別実装のH₂分子RHFも学ぶ。
Find the closed-shell helium ground state in a single-determinant approximation with exchange. A separate H₂ molecular RHF example extends the scope.
同一1s空間軌道を2電子が占有する動径HF。占有軌道上での交換簡約によりv_eff=−2/r+v_H/2。 H₂側の分子積分・行列SCFは別配布版。
Radial HF for two electrons occupying one common 1s spatial orbital; exchange acting on that orbital reduces v_eff to -2/r+v_H/2. Molecular integrals/matrix SCF for H₂ are in a separate edition.
He 1s²で直接項・交換項・二重計数補正の関係を学ぶ。
同じ非相対論RHFモデルの格子解と独立Gaussian基底参照を比較する。
Study Coulomb, exchange and double-counting terms in helium 1s².
Compare the grid solution with an independent Gaussian-basis reference for the same nonrelativistic RHF model.
多軌道、開殻、分子、周期系へ局所交換−v_H/2を流用する。
相関エネルギーや多参照性をこのHF値で説明する。
Reusing local exchange -v_H/2 for multi-orbital, open-shell, molecular or periodic systems.
Using this HF value to describe correlation energy or multireference physics.

name.ja: 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式

note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee.

title.ja: 自己無撞着場反復（SCF）
title.en: Self-consistent field iteration / SCF

keywords: Atomic/molecular examples: Mixing alpha and iteration number are dimensionless. Radial p is in bohr^(-1), integral |p_out-p_in| dr is electron number, and energy changes/normalized orbital residuals are in hartree. Published tolerances belong to this normalization and model. Molecular branch: normalized 3D AO functions in bohr^(-3/2); overlap, AO density matrix and electron count dimensionless; transformed Fock commutator in hartree. Molecular tolerances are stated separately. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.

原子・分子の実行例：混合率αと反復回数は無次元。pはbohr⁻¹、∫|p_out−p_in|drは電子数、エネルギー変化と規格化した軌道残差はhartree。公開公差はこの規格化とモデルに対する値。 分子側：3次元AOはbohr^(−3/2)で規格化。重なり行列・AO密度行列・電子数は無次元、直交化したFock交換子はhartree。分子側の公差は別に記載。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。

Atomic/molecular examples: SCF mixing itself imposes no spatial boundary condition. The supplied helium fixed-point map uses reduced-orbital u(0)=u(r_max)=0 and an isolated finite-origin, N/r Hartree field; see the HF/KS/Hartree records. Separate H2 branch: isolated molecule, analytic whole-space Gaussian integrals; no finite radial box. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.
原子・分子の実行例：SCF混合そのものに空間境界条件はない。与えたHe固定点写像が縮約軌道u(0)=u(r_max)=0と、原点で有限・遠方N/rの孤立Hartree場を規定する。HF・KS・Hartree項目を参照。 別のH₂側は孤立分子の全空間Gaussian解析積分で、有限の動径箱は設けない。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。
指定した電子密度依存ハミルトニアンと密度の自己整合固定点を求め、未収束を識別する。 別実装のH₂分子RHFも学ぶ。
Find a self-consistent fixed point of a specified density-dependent Hamiltonian and identify failure. A separate H₂ molecular RHF example extends the scope.
単純線形密度混合。密度L1差・エネルギー変化・出力密度で再構成した軌道残差のAND条件、履歴保存、反復上限による明示的未収束。 H₂側の分子積分・行列SCFは別配布版。

Simple linear density mixing; joint density-L1, energy-change and output-density-rebuilt orbital-residual criteria, saved histories and explicit iteration-limit failure. Molecular integrals/matrix SCF for H₂ are in a separate edition.
小さなHeモデルで混合率・初期値・停止基準を比較する。
正常終了と数値収束を区別し、反復上限1回の意図的な未収束を扱う。
Compare mixing rates, starts and stopping criteria in a small helium model.
Distinguish process completion from convergence, including an intentional one-iteration failure.
金属・難収束系や汎用分子SCFで、この混合率と公差が常に適切とみなす。
反復が停止した事実だけで安定性・最低エネルギー・物理精度を保証する。
Assuming the same mixing and tolerances are generally suitable for metals, difficult systems or molecular SCF.
Using iteration termination alone to establish stability, minimum energy or physical accuracy.

title.ja: Coulomb・Hartreeポテンシャル
title.en: Coulomb and Hartree potentials

keywords: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。

Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.
孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。
与えた球対称電子数密度が作る孤立系Coulomb反発場とHartreeエネルギーを求める。
Find the isolated repulsive Coulomb field and Hartree energy of a specified spherical electron-number density.
動径密度pに対する内側・外側積分の累積求積。Poisson式は符号と境界の等価な記述で、専用PDE反復解法ではない。
Cumulative inner/outer radial quadrature in p; Poisson's equation provides the equivalent sign/boundary interpretation, not a separate iterative PDE solver.
球対称の滑らかな電子密度でv_HとE_Hを評価する。
解析的指数密度と遠方の電子数/rでCoulomb場の符号・境界・会計を確認する。
Evaluate v_H and E_H for smooth spherical electron densities.
Check sign, boundaries and accounting against analytic exponential density and the N/r far field.
非球対称・周期系にこの1次元Coulomb積分をそのまま適用する。
同じ求積の標本を1回にする処理を、点電荷自己エネルギー除去や交換と混同する。
Applying this one-dimensional Coulomb integral directly to nonspherical or periodic systems.
Confusing quadrature sample counting with point-charge self-energy removal or exchange.

title.ja: LDA・GGA・hybrid汎関数
title.en: LDA, GGA and hybrid functionals

keywords: Atomic/molecular examples: Atomic units: total number density n in bohr^(-3), radial p in bohr^(-1), local v_x in hartree, and integrated E_x in hartree. The energy functional and its derivative use the same density and spin convention. Periodic He: bohr, inverse bohr and hartree per neutral primitive cell; reciprocal-lattice fractional k coordinates.
原子・分子の実行例：原子単位系。全電子数密度nはbohr⁻³、動径密度pはbohr⁻¹、局所v_xと積分したE_xはhartree。エネルギー汎関数とその微分で密度・スピンの規約をそろえる。 周期He：bohr・逆bohr・中性基本セル当たりhartree、逆格子での分率k座標。

Atomic/molecular examples: The local exchange functional itself has no spatial boundary condition. The density/orbital problem supplies the isolated helium box and normalization. Gradient, nonlocal-exchange or periodic-functional boundaries are outside this implementation. Periodic He: three-dimensional Bloch boundaries in the fixed one-atom simple-cubic cell.
原子・分子の実行例：局所交換汎関数自体には空間境界条件はない。密度・軌道の問題が孤立Heの箱と規格化を与える。勾配項・非局所交換・周期系の境界処理は実装対象外。 周期He：固定1原子単純立方セルの3次元Bloch境界。
電子状態計算で不足する交換相関エネルギーを指定し、対応する有効ポテンシャルを整合して求める。
Specify approximate exchange-correlation energy and obtain a consistent effective potential in electronic-structure calculations.
スピン非偏極Dirac交換のみ（LDA_X）。E_c=0、p=4πr²nを介した動径積分でE_xとv_xを同時に返す。
Spin-unpolarized Dirac exchange only (LDA_X), E_c=0; radial integration through p=4 pi r^2 n returns consistent E_x and v_x.
同じ密度・スピン規約でエネルギーと汎関数微分の整合を学ぶ。
交換のみという同一条件で独立実装と照合し、数値誤差とモデル誤差を分ける。
Study consistency between energy and its functional derivative under one density/spin convention.
Compare independent implementations of the same exchange-only model and separate numerical from model errors.
相関を含む汎関数、スピン分極、GGA・meta-GGA・hybridの結果が必要。
HeのLDA_X参照一致を、汎関数全般や分子・固体への精度保証に使う。
Requiring correlation, spin polarization, GGA, meta-GGA or hybrid results.
Using helium LDA_X agreement as a general functional or molecular/solid accuracy guarantee.

name.ja: 3中心H3+の小RHF/MP2/FCI模型
name.en: A tiny three-center H3+ RHF / MP2 / FCI example

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree. Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

name.ja: 電子の定常Schrödinger方程式
name.en: Stationary electronic Schrödinger equation

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules.

name.ja: 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式
name.en: Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、非局所交換を含む。既存のHe局所還元とH2のRHF例を保持する。追加は固定H2/H3+の最小2電子模型で、UHF式は別の対応模型に明示する。一般多中心分子、開殻の大域安定性、完全基底や一般相関法の保証ではない。
note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee.

name.ja: 最小基底H2のRHF/UHF/FCI・2固定幾何
name.en: Minimal-basis H2: RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI

note.ja: 半解析解 H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。 2固定距離のみ。有限基底FCIは連続空間の厳密解ではなく、UHF定常解の一般的な大域最小性は保証しません。角運動量・完全基底・広い解離曲線は未検証。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function. Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree. Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

name.ja: 線形Maxwell電磁場（真空・誘電体）
name.en: Linear Maxwell fields in vacuum and dielectrics

note.ja: 代表式は3D線形電磁場です。今回の実装はz不変の円柱Ez/Hx/Hyに制限した真2D Yee計算です。
note.en: The representative equations describe three-dimensional linear electromagnetics. This implementation is restricted to a z-invariant, genuinely two-dimensional Yee cylinder problem with Ez/Hx/Hy.

name.ja: 受動Lorentz・Ohmic分散Maxwell場
name.en: Passive Lorentz–Ohmic Maxwell fields

note.ja: 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
note.en: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

name.ja: 2D誘電体円柱のMie散乱幅
name.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

caption.ja: 保存した最細格子の実2D散乱電場phasorの実部。 図の中央の白抜きは診断用のr<0.4のマスクで、物理円柱の半径0.25とは区別します。
caption.en: Real part of the actual saved scattered electric phasor on the finest two-dimensional grid. The central white region is a diagnostic mask at r<0.4, distinct from the physical cylinder radius0.25.

note.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
note.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

name.ja: Lorentz分散板へのs/p斜め入射
name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

caption.ja: 保存したp偏光の実電場をky=4の周期y方向へ再構成した場。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved p-polarized electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction at ky=4. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

note.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
note.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

caption.ja: 保存した浅角度の実電場を周期y方向へ再構成。灰色はPML領域です。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved grazing electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction; gray shading marks the PML. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

note.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
note.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

name.ja: 誘電体円柱の外部級数と散乱幅
name.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder

note.ja: 解析解 無損失無限円柱、Ez偏光、c=ε0=μ0=1、半径0.25、ε=2.25、真空波長1。解析場は厳密な円の外部だけです。 Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle. This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

name.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
name.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

note.ja: 解析解 外側真空、ky=4、板[4,5]、ε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。s=Ezとp=Hzをω=5.1/6/6.9で比較します。 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz. This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
note.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

name.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照
name.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

note.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

name.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder

note.ja: 解析解 無損失無限円柱、Ez偏光、c=ε0=μ0=1、半径0.25、ε=2.25、真空波長1。解析場は厳密な円の外部だけです。 Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle. This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

name.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
name.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

note.ja: 解析解 外側真空、ky=4、板[4,5]、ε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。s=Ezとp=Hzをω=5.1/6/6.9で比較します。 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz. This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference vth=omega_p=lambda_D=1,k.5,L4pi,alpha.01,grid32,256spatial strata×128velocity nodes,dt.04,T16,fit[4,12],seeds33001–33004. A separately evolved512-spatial-strata companion changes only particle-space resolution. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference vth=omega_p=lambda_D=1,k.5,L4pi,alpha.01,grid32,256spatial strata×128velocity nodes,dt.04,T16,fit[4,12],seeds33001–33004. A separately evolved512-spatial-strata companion changes only particle-space resolution. Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

summary.ja: 既存配布版：行列から粗視化するAMG：残差と解誤差を分ける: 正方形Poisson問題から得たSPD行列だけを階層構築へ渡し、平滑化集約AMGのV-cycleを実行します。7²・15²・31²未知数で独立疎行列直接解、解析的な離散正弦モード、連続解への2次収束を分けて検査します。 AMGの条件数・異方性・残差と前進誤差: 49・225・961未知数のSPD行列で、条件数と異方性を別々に変えます。解析スペクトル、独立疎行列直接解、DST対角化を比較し、同じ残差でも解誤差が条件数に依存することを確かめます。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Matrix-based AMG: distinguish residual and solution error: Build a smoothed-aggregation hierarchy from an SPD matrix alone and run V-cycles. Problems with 7², 15² and 31² unknowns distinguish independent sparse direct solutions, analytic discrete sine modes and second-order convergence to the continuum solution. AMG: conditioning, anisotropy, residual and forward error: Separate condition number from anisotropy on SPD systems of 49, 225 and 961 unknowns. Compare analytic spectra, independent sparse direct solutions and DST diagonalization, and measure how residual translates to forward error. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

summary.ja: Lanczos・Arnoldi：Ritz値と固有対残差の収束: 32・48次の対称／非対称行列でLanczosとArnoldiを自作し、Krylov次元4・8・16による最大実部の固有対の収束を測ります。行列全体を解く独立LAPACK参照と照合します。 Krylov固有値：クラスター部分空間と非正規感度: 48次のクラスター固有値と強い非正規上三角行列で、次元4/8/16/32のLanczos・Arnoldiを測ります。残差・前進誤差・固有値条件数・不変部分空間を分けます。 追加固定例：明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値、整合質量FEM弦の一般化固有値。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Lanczos and Arnoldi: convergence of Ritz values and eigenpair residuals: Original Lanczos and Arnoldi on symmetric/nonsymmetric 32×32 and 48×48 matrices measure convergence of the largest-real-part eigenpair over Krylov dimensions 4, 8 and 16, against independent full-matrix LAPACK references. Krylov eigenvalues: cluster subspaces and nonnormal sensitivity: Measure Lanczos and Arnoldi with dimensions4/8/16/32 on 48-dimensional clustered symmetric and strongly nonnormal triangular matrices. Distinguish residual, forward error, eigenvalue condition number and invariant subspace. Additional fixed examples: Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues, Consistent-mass FEM string eigenpairs. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

note.ja: 要素からK,Mを組み立て、M内積のK^-1M KrylovとSciPy LOBPCGを比較。小規模な厳密K逆前処理。 LOBPCG初期列は{1,x³,x⁶}。K逆Mの次数+2像を初期spanから独立にし、{1,x,x²}の構造的階数欠落を避ける。 同じMの作用を資格済einsumのLinearOperatorで与え、dense-B adapterを通さない。固有値solver自体はSciPy LOBPCG。
note.en: Elementwise K and M assembly, M-inner-product Krylov iteration on K^-1 M, and actual SciPy LOBPCG with a small exact-K-inverse preconditioner. LOBPCG starts from {1, x^3, x^6}; degree-plus-two images avoid the structural rank defect of {1, x, x^2}. The same M is applied through a qualified einsum LinearOperator, avoiding the dense-B adapter. The eigensolver itself remains SciPy LOBPCG.

summary.ja: Gauss–Legendreと適応求積：厳密次数・推定誤差・予算切れ: Legendreの3項漸化式からGauss節点と重みを構成し、2n−1次までの多項式モーメントと指数関数を検査します。適応Simpsonは指数関数とLorentz型ピークを積分し、解析積分・独立QUADPACKと比較します。 求積：狭いピーク・相殺・端点・誤差推定の盲点: Gauss次数と適応公差を走査し、狭いLorentzピーク、平方根端点、巨大な相殺、零積分、見逃すcompact bumpを解析積分とQUADPACKで検証します。 固定した教育用実行例：領域別QUADPACKと有限Simpson対照、G7/K15と有限区間tanh-sinh、2〜4次元テンソル・Smolyak対照。
summary.en: Gauss–Legendre and adaptive quadrature: exactness, error estimates and budgets: Construct Gaussian nodes/weights from the Legendre recurrence and test polynomial moments through degree 2n−1 and an exponential. Adaptive Simpson integrates exponential and Lorentzian peaks, against analytic integrals and independent QUADPACK. Quadrature: narrow peaks, cancellation, endpoints and estimator blind spots: Vary Gauss order and adaptive tolerance on narrow Lorentz peaks, a square-root endpoint, severe cancellation, a zero integral and a deliberately missed compact bump, using analytic integrals and QUADPACK. Fixed educational executions: QUADPACK dispatch and finite Simpson companions, G7/K15 and finite-interval tanh-sinh, Tensor and Smolyak controls in two to four dimensions.

note.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。
note.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.

name.ja: Haar多重解像度の境界・シフト・閾値
name.en: Haar multiresolution: boundaries, shifts and thresholds

note.ja: 解析解 奇数長の各段で周期型は先頭、対称型は末尾を1点追加し、再構成時に切り戻します。詳細係数のみ閾値0.2を使用。 Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。
note.en: Analytic reference At each odd-length level append the first sample for periodic extension or the last for symmetric extension, then crop during synthesis. Apply threshold 0.2 only to detail coefficients. Limited to Haar, without longer filters or image compression. General symmetric extension is not assumed orthonormal. Shift invariance is not required; shift-dependent differences are retained.

summary.ja: Bratuの合成観測から係数を推定し、2パラメータの随伴勾配、正則化の偏り、観測感度の特異値と識別不能例を検証する。 追加固定例：GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較、既知最小点でのBFGSと3組L-BFGS、雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Fit Bratu coefficients from synthetic observations and verify two-parameter adjoint gradients, regularization bias, data-sensitivity singular values and nonidentifiable observations. Additional fixed examples: Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares, BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima, Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

summary.ja: Gaussian標的のMCMC：分布・自己相関・ESS: 32本のMetropolis連鎖を既知の標準正規分布へ照合し、平均・分散・CDF、自己相関時間、ESSと標本予算依存を記録します。 多峰性MCMC：峰への閉じ込め・偽の安心・大域提案: 同じ2峰密度を、分散初期値の局所MH・同じ峰からの局所MH・対称reflectionを混ぜるMHで比較。期待した混合不良の検出と、実際の峰間移動を分けて検証します。 MCMC診断の独立照合：rank Rhat・bulk/tail ESS・退化条件: 同一鎖の62datasetを別環境ArviZ0.20.0で実計算し、固定recipe・入力・鎖・公式ソースSHAで結びます。通常の有限値照合と、不定値のpolicy差を分けて検査します。 追加固定例：相関2変量Gaussianのjoint標的とMCSE。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Gaussian-target MCMC: distribution, autocorrelation and ESS: Check 32 Metropolis chains against a known standard-normal target; record mean, variance, CDF, autocorrelation time, ESS and sample-budget dependence. Multimodal MCMC: trapping, false reassurance and a global proposal: Compare dispersed local MH, same-mode local MH and symmetry-informed reflection/local MH on the same bimodal target. Separate detecting expected mixing failures from successful finite-budget mode exploration. Independent MCMC diagnostic checks: rank Rhat, bulk/tail ESS and degeneracies: Actually process62 byte-identical datasets with separately installed ArviZ0.20.0, bound by recipe/input/chain/official-source hashes. Separate finite-value agreement from explicit degeneracy-policy differences. Additional fixed examples: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

note.ja: 原著式から独自実装。odd長は中央1標本を落としてsplit、平均順位のBlom式は訂正済みS+1/4、fold後再rank、最大Rhatを採用。bulk ESSはrank split、tail ESSは元の全鎖のType7分位点を先に求めた≤indicatorをsplit。Geyer initial-positive/monotoneと宣言した端点処理・tau≥1/log10(total)を用い、反相関ESSをNへclipしません。
note.en: Original equation-based implementation: split with the odd center dropped, average-tie Blom ranks using corrected S+1/4, re-rank folded deviations, and take the larger Rhat. Bulk ESS uses rank-split draws; tail ESS first determines Type7 quantiles on original full draws, then splits <= indicators. Use initial-positive/monotone pairs, declared endpoint handling and tau>=1/log10(total), without clipping antithetic ESS to N.

note.ja: 解析平均・分散・CDFの指定7点・正側占有と照合。各鎖の占有率と峰間遷移、rank/folded split Rhat、bulk/tail/mean・modeindicator ESS、鎖内だけのACF/ESSを記録。分散trapped鎖はpooled分布が良くてもRhat/多鎖ESSで失敗、same-mode鎖はRhatが良くても既知標的に失敗する対照です。scenario passはこの期待失敗を検出できた意味です。CDF差は指定点最大でKS全域距離・IID検定p値ではありません。
note.en: Compare with analytic moments, seven declared CDF points and positive occupancy. Record per-chain occupancies/transitions, rank/folded split Rhat, bulk/tail/mean and mode-indicator ESS, and within-only ACF/ESS. Dispersed trapped chains can have a good pooled distribution yet fail between-chain diagnostics; same-mode chains can have reassuring Rhat yet fail the known target. A control scenario passes when its intended failure is detected. CDF error is a declared-point maximum, not whole-line KS distance or an IID-test p-value.

caption.ja: 公開コード版を固定条件で実行して作成した計算結果。条件・値・検査結果を添付。
caption.en: Calculated from the public code edition with fixed inputs; inputs, values and checks are linked.

note.ja: 共通実行例では減衰Newton法で前進の境界値問題を解きます。関連する自動微分・感度・随伴・係数推定の検証は各手法の別配布版へ進めます。感度・逆問題（1個または2個の係数）の入力と判定は別であり、共通の前進実行例に合算しません。
note.en: The common example solves the forward boundary-value problem with damped Newton. Related method pages lead to separate editions for automatic differentiation, sensitivities, adjoints and coefficient fitting. Sensitivity and inverse problems with one or two coefficients have separate inputs and acceptance checks; they are not added to the common forward execution entry.

name.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint
name.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay

caption.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: ThomasでB u次=u現在+dt θbを解き、Bの転置を逆順に解きます。16stepごとにcheckpointを保存し、1blockを同じ順で再計算します。full配列を保存・解放した後で別の所有期間を測ります。
note.en: Thomas solves B u_next=u_current+dt theta b; reverse solves use B transpose. Save checkpoints every16steps and replay one block in the original order. Serialize and release the full trajectory before the separate checkpoint ownership window.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度
name.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

caption.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
note.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

name.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
name.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

caption.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

name.ja: 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照
name.en: Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references

note.ja: 解析解 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps. The objective has an h-weighted terminal error and specified quadratic penalties. Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
name.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.ja: 分布Bratu係数の独立dense感度と行列不要VJP
name.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

name.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
name.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. summary.ja: 純吸収平板の離散座標放射輸送: 純吸収の定常放射輸送を角度と空間で離散化し、Beer–Lambert解と積分された出射フラックスで検証します。 放射輸送：空間・角度収束と光子統計: 純吸収平板で特性解・独立適応求積・光子生存率を比較し、離散収支と標本誤差・区間被覆を別々に測ります。 追加固定例：等方散乱平板の反射・透過・吸収。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：Su–Olson1996非平衡拡散、Su–Olson1997角度輸送の独立公開表比較。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。 追加固定例：2D吸収影と保存的M1輸送、2D反向beamとM1閉包の情報損失。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Discrete-ordinate radiation transport through an absorbing slab: Discretize steady pure-absorption transfer in angle and space, checking Beer–Lambert rays and integrated exit flux. Radiation transport: space/angle convergence and photon statistics: Compare characteristics, independent adaptive integration and photon survival in a pure-absorption slab; separate discrete balance, sampling error and interval coverage. Additional fixed examples: Isotropic scattering in a finite slab. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Su–Olson1996 non-equilibrium diffusion, Su–Olson transport with an independently published analytical table. See each release for assumptions and checked scope. Additional fixed examples: Two-dimensional absorber shadow and M1 transport, Opposing beams and information loss in the M1 closure. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Infinite symmetric1D angular transport/material exchange,epsilon1,no elastic scattering,cold initial state. Source Q1 for |x|<.5 and0<tau<10. A separate matched periodic cell-mean companion uses physical x in [0,2*pi), c=epsilon=1, kappa4/8/16, N128/512/2048, Q0, initial I=V=1+.1cos(x), and t=kappa*s for s=0,.0625,.125,.25. Its IC/BC/source differ from the source-driven1997 benchmark; the FV, continuum-angular and diffusion comparisons within this companion use matched inputs. No direct original1997fulltext/tablecomparison claim. TheauthorREADMEdoesnotstate transcriptionversusregeneration. Source-offprofiles,generalscattering,globalcontinuumerrorandangularorderarenotcertified. The addition is a resolved N~kappa^2 semidiscrete periodic control,not fixed-grid AP or an SSPRK2 diffusion-time order certificate. Initial F0 versus nonzero Fick flux is retained;limit gates use final s=.25 only. SciPy sparse expm_multiply is shared;DOP853 qualifies the reference propagator.

note.ja: セル内の非重複ランダム対へ、偶数・奇数粒子数を区別した物理時間のσg衝突確率を適用。エネルギーによる安全上界で事前にsubcycle数を定め、確率clipはしません。壁・流入はflux重み付き分布と実際の残り飛行時間を用います。 開境界のmacro粒子到着数は平均を保つfloor(平均)+Bernoulli(小数部)で分散を下げます。Poisson数揺らぎや熱揺らぎの再現は主張しません。 既存4seedを残して次の8連番seedを追加します。一様順列と安定整数sortは対選択法則を保ちますが、乱数消費と軌道のbit一致は主張しません。
note.en: Disjoint cell-local random pairs with even/odd finite-N physical-time sigma*g acceptance,energy-based safe majorant and predeclared bounded subcycling; no probability caps. Open-reservoir macro counts use unbiased floor(mean)+Bernoulli(fraction) per face/species/half-stream to reduce artificial sampling variance; no Poisson number-fluctuation or thermodynamic-fluctuation reproduction claim. Retain the original four seeds and append the next eight consecutive seeds; uniform permutation/stable integer sorting preserves the ideal within-cell matching law,not RNG consumption or bit-identical trajectories.

summary.ja: 小規模な固定例で、index-1 DAEの後退Euler・Newton法、整合初期化、保存則と拘束ドリフトを比較します。 追加固定例：index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差、Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値、振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Small fixed examples compare backward Euler and Newton for index-one DAEs, consistent initialization, conservation and constraint drift. Additional fixed examples: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE, Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values, Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

method.code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

name.en: Robertson kinetics: ODE and conservation DAE

caption.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。 保存済みの数値場と参照を用いた図です。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。
caption.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references. This preview reads saved numerical fields and references only. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

note.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。 解析Jacobian付き固定BE/Newtonを使い、質量の投影・濃度クリップはしません。
note.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result. Use fixed BE/Newton with analytic Jacobians and no mass projection or concentration clipping.

name.en: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE

caption.ja: 既知の正枝を持つindex-1 DAEで初期化と後退Eulerの誤差・残差を分離します。 保存配列から作図。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。
caption.en: Separate initialization, backward-Euler error and residuals on a known positive index-one DAE branch. Drawn from saved arrays. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

note.ja: 連立Newtonと同じ尺度のArmijo線探索を用い、特異な初期推測は修復せず記録します。
note.en: Use coupled Newton with an Armijo search in the same scaled norm, retaining rather than repairing a singular initial guess.

name.ja: 拘束付き振り子
name.en: Constrained planar pendulum

caption.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。 保存配列から作図。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。
caption.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts. Drawn from saved arrays. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

name.ja: Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差
name.en: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

name.ja: Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値
name.en: Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct. Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity. No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

name.ja: SHAKEとRATTLE：拘束と運動量の違い
name.en: SHAKE and RATTLE: constraints and momentum ownership

note.ja: 半解析解 L=m=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。C=(q·q−1)/2、T=100、h=0.04/0.02/0.01。拘束目標1e−13と粗格子の1e−10比較を固定。 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference L=m=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity. C=(q·q−1)/2, T=100 and h=0.04/0.02/0.01; position targets are fixed at 1e−13, with a coarse 1e−10 companion. Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。

The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

summary.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. note.en: Check independent Fraction rank/covariance,signedf1 baths,the valid projectedOU identity and a wrong-ambientDOF counterexample. Retain220CDF families,signed two-time products and correct/incorrect temperature denominators.

name.ja: 拘束・重心除去と正準統計
name.en: Constraints,centre-of-mass removal and canonical statistics

note.ja: 半解析解 共通の調和ポテンシャル中の1次元3粒子で質量1/2/3、kBT=1。無拘束・COM・COM相対・冗長行の等価拘束で有効自由度3/2/1/1、各1,024標本を比較します。固定線形拘束Cq=0、CM⁻¹p=0を用い、冗長行は同じ接空間上で比較します。 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
note.en: Semi-analytic reference Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas. Dimensionless; masses 1/2/3 and kBT=1. Fixed linear constraints Cq=0 and CM⁻¹p=0; redundant rows are compared on the same tangent space. These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

summary.ja: CSVRの厳密浴：条件付き分布・揺らぎ・運動エネルギー相関: 自由度1・2・6のCSVR浴だけを実装し、厳密な条件付きモーメントと非心χ²分布、正準Gamma分布と運動エネルギー相関を照合します。 CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。 非調和CSVRとLangevin：Boltzmann求積との分布比較: 弱い四次ポテンシャルを持つ2自由度で、CSVRとLangevinの分布・温度とエネルギーの揺らぎ・相関を比較。正準分布を独立なBoltzmann求積から得ます。
summary.en: Exact CSVR bath: conditional laws, fluctuations and kinetic correlation: Implement the bath-only CSVR update for 1, 2 and 6 degrees of freedom; compare exact conditional moments/noncentral-chi-square laws, canonical Gamma fluctuations and kinetic correlations. CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations. Anharmonic CSVR versus Langevin: distribution checks against Boltzmann quadrature: Compare CSVR and Langevin distributions, temperature/energy fluctuations and correlations for two weakly quartic modes. Independent Boltzmann quadrature provides equilibrium references.

note.ja: 半解析解 共通の調和ポテンシャル中の1次元3粒子で質量1/2/3、kBT=1。無拘束・COM・COM相対・冗長行の等価拘束で有効自由度3/2/1/1、各1,024標本を比較します。固定線形拘束Cq=0、CM⁻¹p=0を用い、冗長行は同じ接空間上で比較します。 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。

These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
note.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

note.en: A framework for diffusion-driven pattern onset around a homogeneous reaction equilibrium, not a unique choice of f and g. A spot image or unequal diffusion coefficients alone do not establish a Turing mechanism. Boundary conditions determine the available modes. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. No general pattern selection, 2D, biological calibration or fluid-coupling claim.

note.ja: 22モデル族の文献解説に、ロジスティック増殖・閉鎖SIR、線形反応拡散、Schnakenbergの線形発現・有限振幅の非線形発展・成長後の1次元パターン、空間なしFitzHugh–Nagumoの限定例を接続します。全22族の実装ではありません。 別群small-modelsから、固定した4状態酵素/QSSA、正のLotka–Volterra軌道、SEIR保存則と初期2モード線形化の3例だけを追加します。SEIRはSIRの既存実行範囲とは別です。 別群biology-ode-controls/biology-space-controlsでは、Hodgkin–Huxley、移入–死亡SSA、Fisher特殊速度前線、2次元Schnakenberg、外力付きKeller–Segelの固定例だけを追加します。未達・未解決の目標も保持します。
note.en: The 22-family survey links scoped examples of logistic growth, closed SIR, linear reaction–diffusion, linear Schnakenberg onset, finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth 1D patterns, plus spatially uniform FitzHugh–Nagumo. This does not implement all 22 families. note.ja: Lie–Trotterは拡散h→反応h、Strangは拡散h/2→反応h→拡散h/2。どちらも更新後の状態を次へ渡します。拡散は2次中心FD行列の指数をFFTで厳密適用、反応は同じ陰的中点則・Newton公差2e−13・上限12評価を使用。反応流は厳密解ではなく2次近似です。クリッピング・自動刻み変更・代替解法への切替を行わず、未収束は失敗にします。
note.en: Lie–Trotter uses diffusion(h) then reaction(h); Strang uses diffusion(h/2), reaction(h), diffusion(h/2), always passing the updated state. Both apply the exact exponential of the centered-FD diffusion matrix by FFT and the same implicit-midpoint reaction/Newton tolerance 2e−13 with at most 12 residual evaluations. The reaction flow is a second-order approximation, not exact. No clipping, adaptive steps or fallback; nonconvergence is failure.

note.ja: 専用の2D ENO2／Heunレベルセット移流。任意選択の単純なGodunov再初期化による面積変化も保存し、VOF実装を割り当てません。
note.en: Dedicated2D ENO2/Heun level-set advection. Optional simple Godunov redistancing retains measured area changes; no VOF implementation is assigned.

name.ja: この実行例の参照・検証
name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 解析的な円の中心運動と符号付き距離を参照し、4つの正の共通時刻の最悪値を測定します。界面位置は格子辺上で線形補間したφ=0点の半径誤差、面積は格子中心間を三角形に分けた区分線形φの負領域から計算。初期の幾何学的な面積偏りも残します。|φ厳密|≤2Δx帯のφ誤差と距離勾配、各再初期化による面積変化、N64でのCourant半減も別記録。
note.en: Analytic center motion and signed distance provide the reference. Take worst errors over the four positive common observation times. Interface error samples linearly interpolated grid-edge zeros; area comes from the negative portion of a piecewise-linear triangulation between grid centers, retaining initial geometric bias. Also record phi error and distance-gradient quality in|phi_exact|<=2dx, each redistancing area jump and a separateN64 CFL-halving sensitivity.

name.ja: レベルセット円の2D平行移動：界面・面積・再初期化：解析的符号付き距離参照
name.en: 2D level-set circle translation: interface, area and redistancing: analytic signed-distance reference

note.ja: 解析解 全て無次元、領域[0,1]²、内部φ<0。与えた非圧縮の剛体運動だけを解き、円は境界から離れます。外側2層のゴースト値は各RK段階で解析解を指定します。周期境界ではなく、内部のφは数値更新します。出力時刻0/.25/.5/.75/1、物理Courant数max(|u|+|v|)Δt/Δx≤.35。 円の平行移動と偏心した剛体回転の解析的な中心運動・符号付き距離が参照です。2モードの面積・界面誤差を測り、VOFや二相流の実行とは区別します。
note.en: Analytic reference All quantities are nondimensional on[0,1]², with phi<0 inside. The prescribed divergence-free rigid motion keeps the circle away from the boundary. Two exterior ghost layers receive analytic data at each RK stage; this is not a periodic boundary. Every interior value is numerically advanced. Observe0/.25/.5/.75/1; max(|u|+|v|)dt/dx<=.35. Analytic circle center motion and signed distance provide references for translation and off-center rigid rotation. Interface/area errors of both modes are measured; this is not a VOF or two-phase fluid execution.

name.ja: WENO臨界点：多項式セル平均と解析的周期輸送
name.en: WENO critical points: polynomial cell means and analytic periodic transport

note.ja: 解析解 局所参照はx=0を中心とする5セルの解析平均からh/2を評価する多項式です。通常・一次・二次臨界の3形、h=1/64…1/512を区別します。実際の周期輸送参照は[0,1]、速度1、T1、q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx)のFourier積分セル平均で、別のGauss12点関数求積と照合します。局所多項式と輸送の初期形は異なり、点値や別PDE計算の参照ではありません。 同じ一定速度の周期移流に対する追加参照ですが、cos+.1sin³のセル平均と局所臨界多項式は、従来の単一正弦・CIP表示と異なります。
note.en: Analytic reference Local references integrate polynomials over five cells centered around x=0 and evaluate at h/2. Regular, first-critical and second-critical profiles use h=1/64…1/512. The actual periodic-transport reference is the Fourier-integrated cell mean of q₀=cos(2πx)+.1sin³(2πx) on[0,1], speed1,T1, checked independently by Gauss12 point-function quadrature. Local polynomials differ from the evolved profile; neither point samples nor another PDE calculation are substituted for cell means. An additional constant-speed periodic-transport reference. The cos+.1sin³ cell means and local critical polynomials differ from the historical single-sine/CIP display.

caption.ja: 速度サイズ24の固定例で使う、保存した35×35鞍点行列。
caption.en: The saved 35 x 35 saddle matrix for velocity size 24.

note.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
note.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.

name.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系：独立dense解と理想Schurスペクトル
name.en: Symmetric saddles: independent dense solutions and the ideal-Schur spectrum

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 A=[[H,Bᵀ],[B,0]]、速度サイズ12/24、圧力行数5/11の代数問題。SPD理想Schurは全行列を小さく直接構成し、元の真残差とdense参照解誤差を別に判定。実Stokes境界値問題ではありません。 理想Schurは教育用の稠密制御であり、実Stokes PDEやスケーラブルな近似前処理の完成ではありません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Algebraic saddles A=[[H,B^T],[B,0]] use velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. Explicit dense SPD ideal-Schur controls compare the original residual separately with dense-solution error. This is not a Stokes boundary-value PDE. A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner.

note.ja: 要素からK,Mを組み立て、M内積のK^-1M KrylovとSciPy LOBPCGを比較。小規模な厳密K逆前処理。 LOBPCG初期列は{1,x³,x⁶}。K逆Mの次数+2像を初期spanから独立にし、{1,x,x²}の構造的階数欠落を避ける。 同じMの作用を資格済einsumのLinearOperatorで与え、dense-B adapterを通さない。固有値solver自体はSciPy LOBPCG。

name.ja: 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

note.ja: 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
note.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

note.en: Spatial spread of an invading population or advantageous allele, represented by a reaction–diffusion front. Fisher–KPP is a conventional family name; the independent KPP 1937 original remains an archival follow-up. The exact special speed is not the minimal speed. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Fisher–KPP: a special-speed exact front

name.ja: Schnakenberg反応拡散
name.en: Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion

note.ja: 自己触媒反応の空間拡張。反応平衡と分散関係から模様の発生を検証するための数理モデルです。 限定した実行例：a=0.1,b=0.9、拡散係数0.01/1、長さ2πの1次元周期Schnakenberg系。旧線形発現例を保持し、固定した反射対称の有限振幅初期値の非線形発展と成長後パターンを独立Fourier–Galerkin/Radau参照および空間・時間細分化で比較します。この旧1次元例だけから一般の模様選択、生物実験への較正、流体連成へ広げません。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Schnakenberg：2D境界と初期モード
note.en: A simple autocatalytic kinetic law extended in space, useful for reproducible Turing-onset tests. A mathematical chemical pattern model; matching a visual biological pattern does not calibrate it to a tissue. Scoped executed example: A 1D periodic Schnakenberg system of length 2pi, a=0.1, b=0.9 and diffusivities 0.01/1. Preserve the earlier linear-onset example and compare finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth patterns from fixed reflection-symmetric data with independent Fourier–Galerkin/Radau references and separate spatial/temporal refinement. The earlier 1D case alone makes no general pattern-selection, biological-calibration or fluid-coupling claim. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Schnakenberg:2D boundaries and initial modes

name.ja: Keller–Segel走化性
name.en: Keller–Segel chemotaxis

note.ja: 細胞密度が化学物質の勾配に応答する2場の代表的な縮約系。次元・境界・化学場の動態が重要です。 全モデル族の実装ではありません。今回の固定例：Keller–Segel：連成流束の製造解
note.en: Cell density n drifts up a chemoattractant gradient; τc=0 gives an elliptic chemical subproblem. This is a common two-field reduction of a more detailed original formulation. Blowup thresholds depend on dimension, domain, boundary and chemical dynamics. Not implementation of the entire model family. Fixed cases: Keller–Segel: a manufactured coupled-flux solution

note.en: This authored forced two-field model does not reproduce the full original biological model or demonstrate aggregation, true blow-up or suppression. No clipping is used to manufacture positivity.
