note.ja: 1D1V・固定イオン・無衝突の小規模例です。正のGauss速度重みのfull-f粒子を全て動かします。4シードのSEとt区間は静かな空間シフトに条件付けられ、i.i.d.粒子雑音やN^(-1/2)収束の証明ではありません。速度積分の偏りは別の倍増計算で検査。線形参照は独立した連続モデルの導出で、独立非線形Vlasovエンジンではありません。二流の後期は診断表示で飽和値を合否に用いません。偶数格子のNyquist電荷を別記し、そのモードまでGauss則を満たすとは表示しません。 4シフトのStudent-t区間は名目上の条件付き要約で、真の率に対する被覆率や全誤差を検証したものではありません。 正のGauss速度重みと密度CDF逆写像で共同(x,v)分布を作り、CIC電荷配置→FFT Poisson→同じCIC補間を各kickで再計算するvelocity-Verlet法。Z関数の分散根を枝追跡で確認し、別導出のVolterra初期値問題を刻み半減して固定窓の過渡偏りを検査します。
note.en: Small fixed1D1V collisionless electrons with fixed ions. Every positive-weight Gauss-velocity full-f carrier moves. Seed SE/t intervals are conditional on quiet spatial shifts, not iid particle noise or N^(-1/2) convergence. Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established. Positive Gaussian velocity weights and density-CDF inversion load the joint(x,v) distribution. Recompute CIC deposition, FFT Poisson and matched CIC gathering at every velocity-Verlet kick. Qualify the dielectric root using branch continuation/bracket checks and a separately derived, time-refined Volterra IVP with the same fixed-window estimator.

text.ja: PIC空間演算の独立実装照合 rho=-.5cos(2x) => E=-.25sin(2x), electron a=+.25sin(2x); independent scalar CIC + dense DFT owns its self-consistent field every kick. 周期[0,2π]、256粒子、格子8/16/32、シード35001/35002、dt=.02、T=.24。位置は一様乱数、v=.2 Normal+.1 sin x。6組は別々に進めた12軌道です。 19 pytestと58/58固定判定が合格。6組＝12の自己無撞着軌道を13時刻全てで照合し、最大差は位置8.88e−16・速度3.33e−16・電場8.33e−16・電荷2.89e−15。pytest+mainは0.392秒。最初の小pytestは周期端点の添字不具合で17/18となり、元記録を保持して修正後に全計算を実行しました。 離散演算の独立したコーディング照合です。時間積分法や連続方程式を変えた独立エンジン、連続極限の収束、冷たいプラズマの振動参照の再現を意味しません。既存cold-plasma-picの関連補助検証として扱い、温かい初期速度の軌道を冷たい解と同一視しません。

note.ja: 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
note.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

note.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented. Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

The1997 optical coordinates give a unit exchange coefficient; physical-coordinate controls multiply both exchange terms by kappa. Same-solver controls retain a varying-direction manufactured solution and crossed x/y packets.

note.ja: 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。 解析Jv、残差2評価の中央差分、または方向1本のforward ADを使います。PoissonのThomas右前処理、2回の再直交化とGivensによるGMRES。η0=.3、その後η=clamp(.9(Fk/Fk−1)^1.5,.001,.5)。これはEW Choice 2型の明示的な変形で、原著のsafeguard全体やPETSc既定値ではありません。
note.en: An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee. Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

note.ja: 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
note.en: The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved. Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

name.ja: 微分代数方程式（DAE）
name.en: Differential-algebraic equations / DAE

note.ja: 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim. Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

note.ja: 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
note.en: Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency. Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

text.ja: 酵素反応の保存と準定常近似 \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-10ES+C,&\dot C&=10ES-2C,\\\dot E&=-10ES+2C,&\dot P&=C.\end{aligned};\quad E+C=E_0,\quad S+C+P=1,\quad K_m=\frac{k_{-1}+k_2}{k_1}=0.2;\quad \theta=E_0t,\quad \varepsilon=\frac{E_0}{K_m+S_0}\in\left\{\frac1{120},\frac1{600}\right\};\quad \frac{dS_{\rm MM}}{d\theta}=-\frac{S_{\rm MM}}{0.2+S_{\rm MM}},\quad S_{\rm MM}+0.2\log S_{\rm MM}=1-\theta 閉鎖反応E+S⇌C→E+Pを無次元化し、k₁=10、k₋₁=k₂=1、S₀=1、C₀=P₀=0、E₀=0.01/0.002。Kₘ=0.2、ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120,1/600、θ=E₀t∈[0,0.5]です。
text.en: Enzyme conservation and QSSA \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-10ES+C,&\dot C&=10ES-2C,\\\dot E&=-10ES+2C,&\dot P&=C.\end{aligned};\quad E+C=E_0,\quad S+C+P=1,\quad K_m=\frac{k_{-1}+k_2}{k_1}=0.2;\quad \theta=E_0t,\quad \varepsilon=\frac{E_0}{K_m+S_0}\in\left\{\frac1{120},\frac1{600}\right\};\quad \frac{dS_{\rm MM}}{d\theta}=-\frac{S_{\rm MM}}{0.2+S_{\rm MM}},\quad S_{\rm MM}+0.2\log S_{\rm MM}=1-\theta Use the closed dimensionless reaction E+S⇌C→E+P with k₁=10, k₋₁=k₂=1, S₀=1, C₀=P₀=0 and E₀=0.01 or 0.002. Then Kₘ=0.2, ε=E₀/(Kₘ+S₀)=1/120 or 1/600, and θ=E₀t ranges from 0 to 0.5.

name.ja: L安定なSDIRK2
name.en: L-stable SDIRK2

note.ja: 2つの小εと固定反応定数だけの教育例です。εは尺度比であり、その値だけを厳密なQSSA誤差上界とはしません。θ≥0.02を初期層終了の証明とは呼ばず、生体内の反応・観測値へ外挿しません。 全4状態をSDIRK2のstep doublingで積分し、各段のNewton法では同じ重み付きL∞残差とArmijo条件を使います。縮約Michaelis–Menten式はθ上の別RK4計算で求め、全系の積分誤差と近似モデル誤差を混同しません。
note.en: These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction. Integrate all four states with SDIRK2 step doubling, using the same weighted L∞ residual for Newton convergence and Armijo backtracking. Evolve the reduced Michaelis–Menten equation separately with RK4 in θ, keeping integration error distinct from model-reduction error.

title.ja: Lotka–Volterra不変量と正値性
title.en: Lotka–Volterra invariant and positivity

text.ja: Lotka–Volterra不変量と正値性 \dot x=x(1-y),\quad\dot y=y(x-1),\quad(x(0),y(0))=(1.2,0.8),\quad0\le t\le20;\quad H(x,y)=x-\log x+y-\log y,\quad\frac{dH}{dt}=0\quad(x>0,y>0);\quad \frac{d\log x}{dt}=1-e^{\log y},\quad\frac{d\log y}{dt}=e^{\log x}-1 無次元の捕食者・被食者系x′=x(1−y)、y′=y(x−1)、初期値(1.2,0.8)、0≤t≤20。正の象限で不変量H=x−log x+y−log yを評価します。

title.ja: SEIR保存則と初期線形化
title.en: SEIR conservation and initial linearization

text.ja: SEIR保存則と初期線形化 \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned};\quad \beta=0.6,\quad\sigma=0.3,\quad\gamma=0.2,\quad(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1-2\eta,\eta,\eta,0);\quad S+E+I+R=1,\quad\eta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-5}\};\quad \begin{pmatrix}E_{\rm lin}(t)\\ I_{\rm lin}(t)\end{pmatrix}=\exp\!\left[t\begin{pmatrix}-0.3&0.6\\0.3&-0.2\end{pmatrix}\right]\begin{pmatrix}\eta\\\eta\end{pmatrix} 閉鎖人口S+E+I+R=1、β=0.6、σ=0.3、γ=0.2。η=10⁻⁴/5×10⁻⁵に対し(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1−2η,η,η,0)、0≤t≤20。出生・死亡・外部流入はありません。
text.en: SEIR conservation and initial linearization \begin{aligned}\dot S&=-\beta SI,&\dot E&=\beta SI-\sigma E,\\\dot I&=\sigma E-\gamma I,&\dot R&=\gamma I.\end{aligned};\quad \beta=0.6,\quad\sigma=0.3,\quad\gamma=0.2,\quad(S,E,I,R)(0)=(1-2\eta,\eta,\eta,0);\quad S+E+I+R=1,\quad\eta\in\{10^{-4},5\times10^{-5}\};\quad \begin{pmatrix}E_{\rm lin}(t)\\ I_{\rm lin}(t)\end{pmatrix}=\exp\!\left[t\begin{pmatrix}-0.3&0.6\\0.3&-0.2\end{pmatrix}\right]\begin{pmatrix}\eta\\\eta\end{pmatrix} Use a closed population S+E+I+R=1 with β=0.6, σ=0.3 and γ=0.2. For η=10⁻⁴ or 5×10⁻⁵, start from (1−2η,η,η,0) and evolve to t=20. There are no births, deaths or external inflows.

The early linearization is not an exact solution through t=20, and a single dominant mode does not replace the two-mode solution. Independently compute the nonlinear reference with scaled-deviation Radau/BDF and the early E/I linearization with both modes of the full 2×2 matrix exponential.

text.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴 H(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}I+\begin{pmatrix}-\Delta&gQ\\gQ&\Delta\end{pmatrix},\quad\psi=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^T;\quad E(Q,\theta)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\Delta\cos(2\theta)+gQ\sin(2\theta),\quad E_-(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\sqrt{\Delta^2+g^2Q^2};\quad M\ddot Q=-kQ-g\sin(2\theta),\quad\mu\ddot\theta=-2\Delta\sin(2\theta)-2gQ\cos(2\theta);\quad V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear} 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
text.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling H(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}I+\begin{pmatrix}-\Delta&gQ\\gQ&\Delta\end{pmatrix},\quad\psi=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^T;\quad E(Q,\theta)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\Delta\cos(2\theta)+gQ\sin(2\theta),\quad E_-(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\sqrt{\Delta^2+g^2Q^2};\quad M\ddot Q=-kQ-g\sin(2\theta),\quad\mu\ddot\theta=-2\Delta\sin(2\theta)-2gQ\cos(2\theta);\quad V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear} Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. note.ja: 8回の全固有対計算で824組をraw保存、規格化等の資格判定は選択24組です。節の閾値と位相は診断、HO0.003は固定例の達成目標で証明済み上界ではありません。有限壁と格子感度を相殺から独立に保証しません。 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。 原子単位、ゼロDirichlet端点、一様内点格子。箱[0,1]とHO[-L,L]です。 1次元模型の原子単位でℏ=m=1、HOはω=1。箱[0,1]とHOの有限区間[-L,L]はいずれも同次Dirichlet。
note.en: Eight full solves save824raw pairs; qualification applies to24selected pairs. Thresholded nodes/phase are diagnostics. HO0.003 is a met fixed-case goal, not a proved bound; finite-wall/mesh sensitivities do not certify separate errors. Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules. Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Node counts diagnostic until forward sign qualification. Atomic model units hbar=m=1 and HO omega=1. The box[0,1] and finite HO[-L,L] domains both use homogeneous Dirichlet conditions.

Time evolution of axisymmetric spherical shallow-water balance

text.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称定常釣合いを時間積分 h_t+\frac{\partial_\phi(hv\cos\phi)}{a\cos\phi}=0,\quad u_t+\frac va u_\phi-(2\Omega\sin\phi+u\tan\phi/a)v=0; v_t+\frac va v_\phi+(2\Omega\sin\phi+u\tan\phi/a)u+\frac ga h_\phi=0; u=u_0\cos\phi,\quad v=0,\quad h=h_0-\frac{a\Omega u_0+u_0^2/2}{g}\sin^2\phi a=g=1、Ω=2、u0=0.5、h0=10の無次元軸対称部分問題です。中心差分のprimitive運動量、有限体積の質量、RK4で実際に時間発展させます。標準地球パラメータ、多次元の全球浅水コア、離散厳密釣合い、渦位保存の主張は含みません。
text.en: Time evolution of axisymmetric spherical shallow-water balance h_t+\frac{\partial_\phi(hv\cos\phi)}{a\cos\phi}=0,\quad u_t+\frac va u_\phi-(2\Omega\sin\phi+u\tan\phi/a)v=0; v_t+\frac va v_\phi+(2\Omega\sin\phi+u\tan\phi/a)u+\frac ga h_\phi=0; u=u_0\cos\phi,\quad v=0,\quad h=h_0-\frac{a\Omega u_0+u_0^2/2}{g}\sin^2\phi Axisymmetric nondimensional subproblem with a=g=1, Omega=2, u0=.5 and h0=10. Actual time evolution uses centered primitive momentum, finite-volume mass and RK4.
